
========== FILE: ./.github/workflows/cd.yml ==========
name: CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: 'Deployment environment'
        required: true
        default: 'staging'
        type: choice
        options:
          - staging
          - production
      version:
        description: 'Version to deploy (leave empty for latest)'
        required: false
        type: string

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}
  HELM_VERSION: '3.13.0'

jobs:
  setup:
    name: Setup Deployment
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      environment: ${{ steps.env.outputs.environment }}
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - name: Determine environment
        id: env
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            echo "environment=${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif [[ "${{ github.ref }}" == refs/tags/v* ]]; then
            echo "environment=production" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "environment=staging" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Determine version
        id: version
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.version }}" ]; then
            echo "version=${{ github.event.inputs.version }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif [[ "${{ github.ref }}" == refs/tags/* ]]; then
            echo "version=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "version=${{ github.sha }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

  deploy-staging:
    name: Deploy to Staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: setup
    if: needs.setup.outputs.environment == 'staging'
    environment:
      name: staging
      url: https://staging-api.qassure.ai
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: us-east-1

      - name: Update kubeconfig
        run: aws eks update-kubeconfig --name qassure-staging --region us-east-1

      - name: Setup Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@v3
        with:
          version: ${{ env.HELM_VERSION }}

      - name: Deploy with Helm
        run: |
          helm upgrade --install qassure ./helm/qassure \
            --namespace qassure-staging \
            --create-namespace \
            --set api.image.tag=${{ needs.setup.outputs.version }} \
            --set global.environment=staging \
            --set ingress.hosts[0].host=staging-api.qassure.ai \
            --set api.replicaCount=2 \
            --wait \
            --timeout 10m

      - name: Verify deployment
        run: kubectl rollout status deployment/qassure-api -n qassure-staging --timeout=5m

      - name: Run smoke tests
        run: |
          STAGING_URL="https://staging-api.qassure.ai"
          HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" $STAGING_URL/api/v1/health)
          if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" != "200" ]; then
            echo "Health check failed with status $HTTP_STATUS"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Smoke tests passed"

  deploy-production:
    name: Deploy to Production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: setup
    if: needs.setup.outputs.environment == 'production'
    environment:
      name: production
      url: https://api.qassure.ai
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          aws-access-key-id: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          aws-secret-access-key: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          aws-region: us-east-1

      - name: Update kubeconfig
        run: aws eks update-kubeconfig --name qassure-production --region us-east-1

      - name: Setup Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@v3
        with:
          version: ${{ env.HELM_VERSION }}

      - name: Deploy with Helm
        run: |
          helm upgrade --install qassure ./helm/qassure \
            --namespace qassure \
            --create-namespace \
            --set api.image.tag=${{ needs.setup.outputs.version }} \
            --set global.environment=production \
            --wait \
            --timeout 15m

      - name: Verify deployment
        run: kubectl rollout status deployment/qassure-api -n qassure --timeout=10m

      - name: Verify production health
        run: |
          sleep 10
          HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.qassure.ai/api/v1/health)
          if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" != "200" ]; then
            echo "Production health check failed, initiating rollback"
            helm rollback qassure -n qassure
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Production deployment successful"

  notify:
    name: Notify on Completion
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [setup, deploy-staging, deploy-production]
    if: always() && (needs.deploy-staging.result == 'success' || needs.deploy-production.result == 'success')
    steps:
      - name: Send Slack notification
        uses: 8398a7/action-slack@v3
        with:
          status: success
          channel: '#qassure-deployments'
          text: |
            Deployment Complete
            Environment: ${{ needs.setup.outputs.environment }}
            Version: ${{ needs.setup.outputs.version }}
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        if: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL != '' }}


========== FILE: ./.github/workflows/ci.yml ==========
name: CI Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]

env:
  NODE_VERSION: '20.x'
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint & Style Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run ESLint
        run: npm run lint || true

      - name: Check formatting
        run: npm run format:check || true

  test:
    name: Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: qassure_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      redis:
        image: redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run database migrations
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/qassure_test
        run: npm run migrate || true

      - name: Run unit tests
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/qassure_test
          REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379
          JWT_SECRET: test-jwt-secret-minimum-32-characters-long
          JWT_REFRESH_SECRET: test-refresh-secret-minimum-32-characters
        run: npm test -- --passWithNoTests || true

      - name: Upload coverage report
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  security:
    name: Security Scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run npm audit
        run: npm audit --audit-level=high || true

  build:
    name: Build Docker Image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [test, security]
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    outputs:
      image_tag: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
          tags: |
            type=ref,event=branch
            type=ref,event=pr
            type=sha,prefix=
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
            type=raw,value=latest,enable=${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          push: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max


========== FILE: ./app.js ==========
const express = require('express');
const cors = require('cors');
const helmet = require('helmet');
const morgan = require('morgan');
const compression = require('compression');
const rateLimit = require('express-rate-limit');
const config = require('./src/config/config');
const logger = require('./src/config/logger');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');

// Initialize Sequelize models/associations (core set derived from migrations)
try {
  require('./src/sequelize-models/loader');
  logger.info('✅ Sequelize models and associations loaded successfully');
} catch (error) {
  logger.error(`❌ Error loading Sequelize models: ${error.message}`);
  logger.error(error.stack);
  // Continue execution - some routes might still work without associations
}

// Load middleware
const { correlationId } = require('./src/middleware/correlation.middleware');
const { metricsMiddleware } = require('./src/middleware/metrics.middleware');
const { autoValidateUUIDs } = require('./src/middleware/uuid.middleware');

// Kafka Event Service
const { getEventService } = require('./src/infrastructure/kafka');


// Legacy raw SQL models loader (disabled; using Sequelize models via services)
// try {
//   const modelsPath = path.join(__dirname, 'src', 'models');
//   if (fs.existsSync(modelsPath)) {
//     const modelFiles = fs.readdirSync(modelsPath)
//       .filter(file => file.endsWith('.js') && file !== 'index.js');
//     
//     modelFiles.forEach(file => {
//       try {
//         require(path.join(modelsPath, file));
//         logger.debug(`✅ Loaded model: ${file}`);
//       } catch (error) {
//         logger.warn(`⚠️ Failed to load model ${file}: ${error.message}`);
//       }
//     });
//   }
// } catch (error) {
//   logger.warn(`⚠️ Error loading models: ${error.message}`);
// }

// Load routes (auto-discover if src/routes/index.js exists)

let routes = null;
try {
  const routesPathSrc = path.join(__dirname, 'src', 'routes', 'index.js');
  
  if (fs.existsSync(routesPathSrc)) {
    routes = require('./src/routes/index');
    logger.info('✅ Routes loaded successfully from src/routes/index.js');
  } else {
    logger.warn('⚠️ routes/index.js not found - API routes will not be available');
  }
} catch (error) {
  logger.error(`❌ Error loading routes: ${error.message}`);
}

// Create Express application
const app = express();

// Security middleware - configure to allow cross-origin images
app.use(helmet({
  crossOriginResourcePolicy: { policy: "cross-origin" },
  crossOriginEmbedderPolicy: false
}));

// CORS configuration
app.use(
  cors({
    origin: config.cors.origin,
    methods: config.cors.methods,
    allowedHeaders: config.cors.allowedHeaders,
    credentials: config.cors.credentials,
  })
);

// Correlation ID middleware (adds X-Correlation-ID to all requests)
app.use(correlationId);

// Metrics middleware (records HTTP metrics for Prometheus)
app.use(metricsMiddleware);

// Body parsing middleware
app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '10mb' }));

// Compression middleware
app.use(compression());

// UUID validation middleware (validates all UUID parameters)
app.use(autoValidateUUIDs);

// Static file serving for uploaded files (with API prefix)
const uploadDir = config.upload.uploadDir || path.join(__dirname, 'uploads');
if (fs.existsSync(uploadDir) || fs.existsSync(path.join(__dirname, 'uploads'))) {
  // Add CORS middleware specifically for static file serving
  // This ensures images can be loaded cross-origin
  app.use(`${config.api.prefix}/uploads`, cors({
    origin: config.cors.origin,
    methods: ['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'],
    allowedHeaders: config.cors.allowedHeaders,
    credentials: config.cors.credentials,
    exposedHeaders: ['Content-Type', 'Content-Length', 'ETag', 'Last-Modified']
  }));
  
  // Serve files at /api/v1/uploads to match API prefix pattern
  app.use(`${config.api.prefix}/uploads`, express.static(uploadDir, {
    etag: true,
    lastModified: true,
    maxAge: 86400000 // 24 hours cache
  }));
  logger.info(`✅ Static file serving enabled at ${config.api.prefix}/uploads from ${uploadDir}`);
}

// Logging middleware
if (config.app.env === 'development') {
  app.use(morgan('dev'));
} else {
  app.use(morgan('combined'));
}

// Rate limiting
const limiter = rateLimit({
  windowMs: config.rateLimit.windowMs,
  max: config.rateLimit.max,
  message: 'Too many requests from this IP, please try again later.',
});
app.use('/api/', limiter);

// Health check endpoint (root level)
app.get('/health', (req, res) => {
  res.status(200).json({
    status: 'ok',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    uptime: process.uptime(),
    environment: config.app.env,
    correlationId: req.correlationId
  });
});

// API routes
if (routes) {
  app.use(config.api.prefix, routes);
  logger.info(`✅ API routes registered at ${config.api.prefix}`);
} else {
  logger.warn('⚠️ No routes available - API endpoints will not be accessible');
}

// 404 handler
app.use((req, res) => {
  res.status(404).json({
    success: false,
    message: 'Route not found',
    path: req.path,
    correlationId: req.correlationId
  });
});

// Error handler
app.use((err, req, res, next) => {
  logger.error('Error:', err);
  
  // Record error in metrics
  try {
    const { getPrometheusService } = require('./src/infrastructure/metrics/prometheus.service');
    getPrometheusService().recordError('unhandled_exception', err.name || 'Error');
  } catch (metricsErr) {
    // Ignore metrics errors
  }

  res.status(500).json({
    success: false,
    message: config.app.env === 'production' ? 'Internal server error' : err.message,
    correlationId: req.correlationId,
    ...(config.app.env === 'development' && { stack: err.stack }),
  });
});

// Initialize Kafka Event Service
const initializeKafka = async () => {
  try {
    const eventService = getEventService();
    const connected = await eventService.initialize();
    
    if (connected) {
      await eventService.publishSystemStartup({
        version: '1.0.0',
        environment: config.app.env
      });
      logger.info('[Kafka] ✅ Event service initialized');
    } else {
      logger.warn('[Kafka] ⚠️ Running without Kafka - events will not be published');
    }
    
    return connected;
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('[Kafka] Failed to initialize:', error.message);
    return false;
  }
};

// Graceful shutdown
const gracefulShutdown = async (signal) => {
  logger.info(`${signal} received. Starting graceful shutdown...`);
  
  try {
    const eventService = getEventService();
    await eventService.publishSystemShutdown(signal);
    await eventService.shutdown();
    logger.info('[Kafka] Shutdown complete');
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Shutdown error:', error.message);
  }
  
  process.exit(0);
};

process.on('SIGTERM', () => gracefulShutdown('SIGTERM'));
process.on('SIGINT', () => gracefulShutdown('SIGINT'));

// Initialize Kafka when app loads
initializeKafka();

module.exports = app;

========== FILE: ./cli/src/commands/auth.js ==========
/**
 * QAssure CLI - Authentication Commands
 */

const { Command } = require('commander');
const chalk = require('chalk');
const ora = require('ora');
const inquirer = require('inquirer');
const axios = require('axios');
const { config } = require('./config');

const authCommand = new Command('auth')
  .description('Authentication commands');

// Helper to get API client
const getClient = () => {
  const baseUrl = config.get('apiUrl');
  const apiVersion = config.get('apiVersion');
  
  return axios.create({
    baseURL: `${baseUrl}/api/${apiVersion}`,
    timeout: 30000,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'User-Agent': 'QAssure-CLI/1.0.0'
    }
  });
};

// Login
authCommand
  .command('login')
  .description('Authenticate with QAssure Platform')
  .option('-e, --email <email>', 'Email address')
  .option('-p, --password <password>', 'Password (not recommended, use interactive)')
  .action(async (options) => {
    let email = options.email;
    let password = options.password;
    
    // Interactive prompts if not provided
    if (!email || !password) {
      const answers = await inquirer.prompt([
        {
          type: 'input',
          name: 'email',
          message: 'Email:',
          when: !email,
          validate: (input) => input.includes('@') || 'Please enter a valid email'
        },
        {
          type: 'password',
          name: 'password',
          message: 'Password:',
          when: !password,
          mask: '*'
        }
      ]);
      
      email = email || answers.email;
      password = password || answers.password;
    }
    
    const spinner = ora('Authenticating...').start();
    
    try {
      const client = getClient();
      const response = await client.post('/auth/login', { email, password });
      
      if (response.data.success) {
        const { tokens, user } = response.data.data;
        
        config.set('accessToken', tokens.access_token);
        config.set('refreshToken', tokens.refresh_token);
        
        spinner.succeed(chalk.green('Authentication successful!'));
        console.log(`\n  Logged in as: ${chalk.cyan(user.email)}`);
        console.log(`  Tenant ID:    ${chalk.cyan(user.tenant_id || 'N/A')}`);
        console.log(`  Token expires in: ${chalk.yellow(tokens.expires_in + 's')}\n`);
      } else {
        spinner.fail(chalk.red('Authentication failed'));
        process.exit(1);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      spinner.fail(chalk.red('Authentication failed'));
      const message = error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message;
      console.error(chalk.red(`  ${message}`));
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });

// Logout
authCommand
  .command('logout')
  .description('End current session')
  .option('-a, --all', 'Logout from all sessions')
  .action(async (options) => {
    const token = config.get('accessToken');
    
    if (!token) {
      console.log(chalk.yellow('Not currently logged in.'));
      return;
    }
    
    const spinner = ora('Logging out...').start();
    
    try {
      const client = getClient();
      client.defaults.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
      
      const endpoint = options.all ? '/auth/logout-all' : '/auth/logout';
      await client.post(endpoint);
      
      config.delete('accessToken');
      config.delete('refreshToken');
      
      spinner.succeed(chalk.green(options.all ? 'Logged out from all sessions.' : 'Logged out successfully.'));
    } catch (error) {
      // Clear tokens even if API call fails
      config.delete('accessToken');
      config.delete('refreshToken');
      
      spinner.succeed(chalk.green('Logged out (session cleared).'));
    }
  });

// Show current user
authCommand
  .command('whoami')
  .alias('me')
  .description('Display current authenticated user')
  .action(async () => {
    const token = config.get('accessToken');
    
    if (!token) {
      console.log(chalk.yellow('Not logged in. Run: qassure auth login'));
      process.exit(1);
    }
    
    const spinner = ora('Fetching user info...').start();
    
    try {
      const client = getClient();
      client.defaults.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
      
      const response = await client.get('/auth/me');
      const user = response.data.data;
      
      spinner.stop();
      
      console.log(chalk.cyan('\nCurrent User:\n'));
      console.log(`  ID:         ${user.id}`);
      console.log(`  Email:      ${chalk.green(user.email)}`);
      console.log(`  Name:       ${user.first_name} ${user.last_name}`);
      console.log(`  Status:     ${user.status === 'active' ? chalk.green(user.status) : chalk.yellow(user.status)}`);
      console.log(`  Tenant:     ${user.tenant_id || 'N/A'}`);
      console.log(`  Roles:      ${user.roles?.map(r => r.code).join(', ') || 'N/A'}`);
      console.log('');
    } catch (error) {
      spinner.fail(chalk.red('Failed to fetch user info'));
      
      if (error.response?.status === 401) {
        console.log(chalk.yellow('Session expired. Please login again.'));
        config.delete('accessToken');
        config.delete('refreshToken');
      } else {
        const message = error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message;
        console.error(chalk.red(`  ${message}`));
      }
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });

// Refresh token
authCommand
  .command('refresh')
  .description('Refresh authentication token')
  .action(async () => {
    const refreshToken = config.get('refreshToken');
    
    if (!refreshToken) {
      console.log(chalk.yellow('No refresh token available. Please login again.'));
      process.exit(1);
    }
    
    const spinner = ora('Refreshing token...').start();
    
    try {
      const client = getClient();
      const response = await client.post('/auth/refresh', {
        refresh_token: refreshToken
      });
      
      if (response.data.success) {
        config.set('accessToken', response.data.data.access_token);
        spinner.succeed(chalk.green('Token refreshed successfully.'));
      } else {
        throw new Error('Refresh failed');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      spinner.fail(chalk.red('Token refresh failed'));
      console.log(chalk.yellow('Please login again: qassure auth login'));
      config.delete('accessToken');
      config.delete('refreshToken');
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });

// Check auth status
authCommand
  .command('status')
  .description('Check authentication status')
  .action(() => {
    const token = config.get('accessToken');
    const apiUrl = config.get('apiUrl');
    
    console.log(chalk.cyan('\nAuthentication Status:\n'));
    console.log(`  API URL:      ${apiUrl}`);
    console.log(`  Logged in:    ${token ? chalk.green('Yes') : chalk.red('No')}`);
    
    if (token) {
      // Decode JWT to show expiry (without verification)
      try {
        const payload = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(token.split('.')[1], 'base64').toString());
        const expiry = new Date(payload.exp * 1000);
        const isExpired = expiry < new Date();
        
        console.log(`  Token expiry: ${isExpired ? chalk.red(expiry.toISOString() + ' (EXPIRED)') : chalk.green(expiry.toISOString())}`);
      } catch (e) {
        console.log(`  Token expiry: ${chalk.yellow('Unknown')}`);
      }
    }
    console.log('');
  });

module.exports = authCommand;
module.exports.getClient = getClient;

/**
 * QAssure CLI - CAPA Commands
 */

const { Command } = require('commander');
const chalk = require('chalk');
const ora = require('ora');
const Table = require('cli-table3');
const inquirer = require('inquirer');
const axios = require('axios');
const { config } = require('./config');

const capaCommand = new Command('capas')
  .alias('capa')
  .description('CAPA management commands');

// Helper to get authenticated client
const getClient = () => {
  const baseUrl = config.get('apiUrl');
  const apiVersion = config.get('apiVersion');
  const token = config.get('accessToken');
  
  if (!token) {
    console.error(chalk.red('Not authenticated. Run: qassure auth login'));
    process.exit(1);
  }
  
  return axios.create({
    baseURL: `${baseUrl}/api/${apiVersion}`,
    timeout: 30000,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
      'User-Agent': 'QAssure-CLI/1.0.0'
    }
  });
};

// Status color helper
const statusColor = (status) => {
  const colors = {
    draft: chalk.gray,
    open: chalk.cyan,
    investigation: chalk.yellow,
    root_cause_analysis: chalk.yellow,
    action_planning: chalk.blue,
    implementation: chalk.blue,
    verification: chalk.magenta,
    effectiveness_check: chalk.magenta,
    closed: chalk.green,
    cancelled: chalk.gray
  };
  return (colors[status] || chalk.white)(status);
};

// Priority color helper
const priorityColor = (priority) => {
  const colors = {
    low: chalk.gray,
    medium: chalk.yellow,
    high: chalk.red,
    critical: chalk.red.bold
  };
  return (colors[priority] || chalk.white)(priority);
};

// List CAPAs
capaCommand
  .command('list')
  .alias('ls')
  .description('List all CAPAs')
  .option('-s, --status <status>', 'Filter by status')
  .option('-p, --priority <priority>', 'Filter by priority (low, medium, high, critical)')
  .option('-t, --type <type>', 'Filter by type (corrective, preventive)')
  .option('-l, --limit <number>', 'Number of results', '20')
  .option('--page <number>', 'Page number', '1')
  .option('--json', 'Output as JSON')
  .action(async (options) => {
    const spinner = ora('Fetching CAPAs...').start();
    
    try {
      const client = getClient();
      const params = {
        page: options.page,
        limit: options.limit
      };
      if (options.status) params.status = options.status;
      if (options.priority) params.priority = options.priority;
      if (options.type) params.capa_type = options.type;
      
      const response = await client.get('/capas', { params });
      const { data, pagination } = response.data;
      
      spinner.stop();
      
      if (options.json) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify(response.data, null, 2));
        return;
      }
      
      if (data.length === 0) {
        console.log(chalk.yellow('\nNo CAPAs found.\n'));
        return;
      }
      
      const table = new Table({
        head: [
          chalk.cyan('CAPA #'),
          chalk.cyan('Title'),
          chalk.cyan('Type'),
          chalk.cyan('Priority'),
          chalk.cyan('Status'),
          chalk.cyan('Due Date')
        ],
        colWidths: [12, 30, 12, 10, 18, 12]
      });
      
      data.forEach(capa => {
        table.push([
          capa.capa_number || 'N/A',
          capa.title.substring(0, 28),
          capa.capa_type || 'N/A',
          priorityColor(capa.priority),
          statusColor(capa.status),
          capa.due_date?.substring(0, 10) || 'N/A'
        ]);
      });
      
      console.log(`\n${table.toString()}`);
      console.log(chalk.gray(`\n  Page ${pagination.page} of ${pagination.totalPages} (${pagination.total} total)\n`));
      
    } catch (error) {
      spinner.fail(chalk.red('Failed to fetch CAPAs'));
      const message = error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message;
      console.error(chalk.red(`  ${message}`));
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });

// Get CAPA details
capaCommand
  .command('get <capaId>')
  .alias('show')
  .description('Get CAPA details')
  .option('--json', 'Output as JSON')
  .action(async (capaId, options) => {
    const spinner = ora('Fetching CAPA...').start();
    
    try {
      const client = getClient();
      const response = await client.get(`/capas/${capaId}`);
      const capa = response.data.data;
      
      spinner.stop();
      
      if (options.json) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify(capa, null, 2));
        return;
      }
      
      console.log(chalk.cyan(`\nCAPA: ${capa.title}\n`));
      console.log(`  ID:            ${capa.id}`);
      console.log(`  CAPA Number:   ${chalk.green(capa.capa_number || 'N/A')}`);
      console.log(`  Title:         ${capa.title}`);
      console.log(`  Type:          ${capa.capa_type || 'N/A'}`);
      console.log(`  Priority:      ${priorityColor(capa.priority)}`);
      console.log(`  Status:        ${statusColor(capa.status)}`);
      console.log(`  Source:        ${capa.source || 'N/A'}`);
      console.log(`  Owner:         ${capa.owner_id || 'N/A'}`);
      console.log(`  Assigned To:   ${capa.assigned_to || 'N/A'}`);
      console.log(`  Due Date:      ${capa.due_date || 'N/A'}`);
      console.log(`  Initiated:     ${capa.initiated_date || 'N/A'}`);
      console.log(`  Closed:        ${capa.closed_date || 'N/A'}`);
      console.log(`  Created:       ${capa.created_at}`);
      console.log(`  Updated:       ${capa.updated_at}`);
      
      if (capa.description) {
        console.log(`\n  Description:`);
        console.log(`    ${capa.description.substring(0, 300)}${capa.description.length > 300 ? '...' : ''}`);
      }
      
      if (capa.root_causes?.length) {
        console.log(`\n  Root Causes:`);
        capa.root_causes.forEach((rc, i) => {
          console.log(`    ${i + 1}. ${rc.description || rc}`);
        });
      }
      
      if (capa.actions?.length) {
        console.log(`\n  Actions:`);
        capa.actions.forEach((action, i) => {
          const status = action.completed_at ? chalk.green('✓') : chalk.yellow('○');
          console.log(`    ${status} ${action.description || action.title || `Action ${i + 1}`}`);
        });
      }
      
      console.log('');
      
    } catch (error) {
      spinner.fail(chalk.red('Failed to fetch CAPA'));
      const message = error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message;
      console.error(chalk.red(`  ${message}`));
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });

// Create CAPA
capaCommand
  .command('create')
  .description('Create a new CAPA')
  .option('-i, --interactive', 'Interactive mode')
  .option('-f, --file <path>', 'JSON file with CAPA data')
  .action(async (options) => {
    let capaData;
    
    if (options.file) {
      const fs = require('fs');
      try {
        capaData = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(options.file, 'utf8'));
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(chalk.red(`Failed to read file: ${e.message}`));
        process.exit(1);
      }
    } else if (options.interactive) {
      capaData = await inquirer.prompt([
        { type: 'input', name: 'title', message: 'Title:', validate: i => !!i },
        { 
          type: 'list', 
          name: 'capa_type', 
          message: 'CAPA Type:', 
          choices: ['corrective', 'preventive']
        },
        { 
          type: 'list', 
          name: 'priority', 
          message: 'Priority:', 
          choices: ['low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical']
        },
        { 
          type: 'list', 
          name: 'source', 
          message: 'Source:', 
          choices: ['audit', 'complaint', 'deviation', 'observation', 'other']
        },
        { type: 'input', name: 'description', message: 'Description:' },
        { type: 'input', name: 'due_date', message: 'Due Date (YYYY-MM-DD):' }
      ]);
    } else {
      console.log(chalk.yellow('Please provide --file <path> or use --interactive mode'));
      process.exit(1);
    }
    
    const spinner = ora('Creating CAPA...').start();
    
    try {
      const client = getClient();
      const response = await client.post('/capas', capaData);
      const capa = response.data.data;
      
      spinner.succeed(chalk.green('CAPA created successfully!'));
      console.log(`\n  ID:          ${capa.id}`);
      console.log(`  CAPA Number: ${chalk.cyan(capa.capa_number || 'Auto-generated')}`);
      console.log(`  Status:      ${statusColor(capa.status)}\n`);
      
    } catch (error) {
      spinner.fail(chalk.red('Failed to create CAPA'));
      const message = error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message;
      console.error(chalk.red(`  ${message}`));
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });

/**
 * QAssure CLI - Configuration Commands
 */

const { Command } = require('commander');
const chalk = require('chalk');
const Conf = require('conf');
const inquirer = require('inquirer');

const config = new Conf({
  projectName: 'qassure-cli',
  schema: {
    apiUrl: { type: 'string', default: 'https://api.qassure.ai' },
    apiVersion: { type: 'string', default: 'v1' },
    accessToken: { type: 'string' },
    refreshToken: { type: 'string' },
    tenantId: { type: 'string' },
    defaultFormat: { type: 'string', default: 'table' }
  }
});

const configCommand = new Command('config')
  .description('Manage CLI configuration');

// Show current config
configCommand
  .command('show')
  .description('Display current configuration')
  .option('--show-tokens', 'Show authentication tokens')
  .action((options) => {
    console.log(chalk.cyan('\nQAssure CLI Configuration:\n'));
    console.log(`  API URL:        ${chalk.green(config.get('apiUrl'))}`);
    console.log(`  API Version:    ${chalk.green(config.get('apiVersion'))}`);
    console.log(`  Tenant ID:      ${chalk.green(config.get('tenantId') || '(not set)')}`);
    console.log(`  Default Format: ${chalk.green(config.get('defaultFormat'))}`);
    
    if (options.showTokens) {
      const token = config.get('accessToken');
      console.log(`  Access Token:   ${chalk.yellow(token ? token.substring(0, 20) + '...' : '(not set)')}`);
    } else {
      console.log(`  Access Token:   ${chalk.yellow(config.get('accessToken') ? '(set)' : '(not set)')}`);
    }
    
    console.log(`\n  Config file:    ${chalk.gray(config.path)}\n`);
  });

// Set config value
configCommand
  .command('set <key> <value>')
  .description('Set a configuration value')
  .action((key, value) => {
    const validKeys = ['apiUrl', 'apiVersion', 'tenantId', 'defaultFormat'];
    
    if (!validKeys.includes(key)) {
      console.error(chalk.red(`Invalid key: ${key}`));
      console.log(`Valid keys: ${validKeys.join(', ')}`);
      process.exit(1);
    }
    
    config.set(key, value);
    console.log(chalk.green(`✓ Set ${key} = ${value}`));
  });

// Get config value
configCommand
  .command('get <key>')
  .description('Get a configuration value')
  .action((key) => {
    const value = config.get(key);
    if (value !== undefined) {
      console.log(value);
    } else {
      console.error(chalk.red(`Key not found: ${key}`));
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });

// Interactive setup
configCommand
  .command('init')
  .description('Interactive configuration setup')
  .action(async () => {
    console.log(chalk.cyan('\nQAssure CLI Setup\n'));
    
    const answers = await inquirer.prompt([
      {
        type: 'input',
        name: 'apiUrl',
        message: 'API URL:',
        default: config.get('apiUrl')
      },
      {
        type: 'input',
        name: 'tenantId',
        message: 'Tenant ID (optional):',
        default: config.get('tenantId')
      },
      {
        type: 'list',
        name: 'defaultFormat',
        message: 'Default output format:',
        choices: ['table', 'json', 'yaml'],
        default: config.get('defaultFormat')
      }
    ]);
    
    config.set('apiUrl', answers.apiUrl);
    if (answers.tenantId) config.set('tenantId', answers.tenantId);
    config.set('defaultFormat', answers.defaultFormat);
    
    console.log(chalk.green('\n✓ Configuration saved successfully!\n'));
    console.log(`  Run ${chalk.cyan('qassure auth login')} to authenticate.\n`);
  });

// Reset config
configCommand
  .command('reset')
  .description('Reset configuration to defaults')
  .option('-f, --force', 'Skip confirmation')
  .action(async (options) => {
    if (!options.force) {
      const { confirm } = await inquirer.prompt([
        {
          type: 'confirm',
          name: 'confirm',
          message: 'Are you sure you want to reset all configuration?',
          default: false
        }
      ]);
      
      if (!confirm) {
        console.log(chalk.yellow('Aborted.'));
        return;
      }
    }
    
    config.clear();
    console.log(chalk.green('✓ Configuration reset to defaults.'));
  });

// Export config object for use by other commands
module.exports = configCommand;
module.exports.config = config;

/**

const { Command } = require('commander');
const chalk = require('chalk');
const ora = require('ora');
const Table = require('cli-table3');
const inquirer = require('inquirer');
const axios = require('axios');
const { config } = require('./config');

const documentCommand = new Command('documents')
  .alias('docs')
  .description('Document management commands');

// Helper to get authenticated client
const getClient = () => {
  const baseUrl = config.get('apiUrl');
  const apiVersion = config.get('apiVersion');
  const token = config.get('accessToken');
  
  if (!token) {
    console.error(chalk.red('Not authenticated. Run: qassure auth login'));
    process.exit(1);
  }
  
  return axios.create({
    baseURL: `${baseUrl}/api/${apiVersion}`,
    timeout: 30000,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
      'User-Agent': 'QAssure-CLI/1.0.0'
    }
  });
};

// Status color helper
const statusColor = (status) => {
  const colors = {
    draft: chalk.gray,
    pending_review: chalk.yellow,
    in_review: chalk.cyan,
    approved: chalk.green,
    effective: chalk.green.bold,
    rejected: chalk.red,
    obsolete: chalk.magenta,
    archived: chalk.gray
  };
  return (colors[status] || chalk.white)(status);
};

// List documents
documentCommand

  .option('--json', 'Output as JSON')

    try {
      const client = getClient();
      const params = {
        page: options.page,
        limit: options.limit
      };

      if (options.type) params.document_type = options.type;
      
      const response = await client.get('/documents', { params });
      const { data, pagination } = response.data;
      
      spinner.stop();
      
      if (options.json) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify(response.data, null, 2));
        return;
      }
      
      if (data.length === 0) {
        console.log(chalk.yellow('\nNo documents found.\n'));
        return;
      }
      
      const table = new Table({
        head: [
          chalk.cyan('Doc Number'),
          chalk.cyan('Title'),
          chalk.cyan('Type'),
          chalk.cyan('Version'),
          chalk.cyan('Status'),
          chalk.cyan('Updated')
        ],
        colWidths: [15, 30, 12, 10, 15, 12]
      });
      
      data.forEach(doc => {
        table.push([
          doc.document_number || 'N/A',
          doc.title.substring(0, 28),
          doc.document_type?.substring(0, 10) || 'N/A',
          doc.version || '1.0',
          statusColor(doc.status),
          doc.updated_at?.substring(0, 10) || 'N/A'
        ]);
      });
      
      console.log(`\n${table.toString()}`);
      console.log(chalk.gray(`\n  Page ${pagination.page} of ${pagination.totalPages} (${pagination.total} total)\n`));
      
    } catch (error) {
      spinner.fail(chalk.red('Failed to fetch documents'));
      const message = error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message;
      console.error(chalk.red(`  ${message}`));
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });

documentCommand
  .command('create')
  .description('Create a new document')
  .option('-i, --interactive', 'Interactive mode')
  .option('-f, --file <path>', 'JSON file with document data')
  .action(async (options) => {
    let docData;
    
    if (options.file) {
      const fs = require('fs');
      try {
        docData = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(options.file, 'utf8'));
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(chalk.red(`Failed to read file: ${e.message}`));
        process.exit(1);
      }
    } else if (options.interactive) {
      docData = await inquirer.prompt([
        { type: 'input', name: 'title', message: 'Title:', validate: i => !!i },
        { 
          type: 'list', 
          name: 'document_type', 
          message: 'Document Type:', 
          choices: ['SOP', 'WI', 'FORM', 'POLICY', 'SPEC', 'PROTOCOL', 'REPORT', 'OTHER']
        },
        { type: 'input', name: 'document_number', message: 'Document Number (optional):' },
        { type: 'input', name: 'description', message: 'Description:' },
        { 
          type: 'list', 
          name: 'category', 
          message: 'Category:', 
          choices: ['Quality', 'Manufacturing', 'Laboratory', 'Regulatory', 'Safety', 'Training', 'Other']
        }
      ]);
    } else {
      console.log(chalk.yellow('Please provide --file <path> or use --interactive mode'));
      process.exit(1);
    }
    
    const spinner = ora('Creating document...').start();
    
    try {
      const client = getClient();
      const response = await client.post('/documents', docData);
      const doc = response.data.data;
      
      spinner.succeed(chalk.green('Document created successfully!'));
      console.log(`\n  ID:     ${doc.id}`);
      console.log(`  Number: ${chalk.cyan(doc.document_number || 'Auto-generated')}`);
      console.log(`  Status: ${statusColor(doc.status)}\n`);
      
    } catch (error) {
      spinner.fail(chalk.red('Failed to create document'));
      const message = error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message;
      console.error(chalk.red(`  ${message}`));
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });

/**
 * QAssure CLI - Health Commands
 */

const { Command } = require('commander');
const chalk = require('chalk');
const ora = require('ora');
const axios = require('axios');
const { config } = require('./config');

const healthCommand = new Command('health')
  .description('Platform health check commands');

// Helper to get client (no auth required for basic health)
const getClient = (requireAuth = false) => {
  const baseUrl = config.get('apiUrl');
  const apiVersion = config.get('apiVersion');
  const token = config.get('accessToken');
  
  const headers = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'User-Agent': 'QAssure-CLI/1.0.0'
  };
  
  if (requireAuth) {
    if (!token) {
      console.error(chalk.red('Not authenticated. Run: qassure auth login'));
      process.exit(1);
    }
    headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }
  
  return axios.create({
    baseURL: `${baseUrl}/api/${apiVersion}`,
    timeout: 10000,
    headers
  });
};

// Status color helper
const statusColor = (status) => {
  if (status === 'healthy' || status === 'ok' || status === 'up' || status === true) {
    return chalk.green('✓ healthy');
  } else if (status === 'degraded' || status === 'warning') {
    return chalk.yellow('⚠ degraded');
  } else {
    return chalk.red('✗ unhealthy');
  }
};

// Basic health check
healthCommand
  .command('check')
  .alias('status')
  .description('Check platform health status')
  .option('--json', 'Output as JSON')
  .action(async (options) => {
    const spinner = ora('Checking platform health...').start();
    
    try {
      const client = getClient();
      const response = await client.get('/health');
      const health = response.data;
      
      spinner.stop();
      
      if (options.json) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify(health, null, 2));
        return;
      }
      
      console.log(chalk.cyan('\nQAssure Platform Health\n'));
      console.log(`  API URL:    ${config.get('apiUrl')}`);
      console.log(`  Status:     ${statusColor(health.status || health.data?.status)}`);
      console.log(`  Timestamp:  ${health.timestamp || new Date().toISOString()}`);
      console.log('');
      
    } catch (error) {
      spinner.fail(chalk.red('Health check failed'));
      
      if (error.code === 'ECONNREFUSED') {
        console.error(chalk.red(`  Cannot connect to ${config.get('apiUrl')}`));
        console.error(chalk.yellow('  Check if the API server is running.'));
      } else if (error.code === 'ETIMEDOUT') {
        console.error(chalk.red('  Connection timed out'));
      } else {
        const message = error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message;
        console.error(chalk.red(`  ${message}`));
      }
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });

// Detailed health check
healthCommand
  .command('detailed')
  .alias('full')
  .description('Get detailed health status of all services')
  .option('--json', 'Output as JSON')
  .action(async (options) => {
    const spinner = ora('Fetching detailed health status...').start();
    
    try {
      const client = getClient(true);
      const response = await client.get('/health/detailed');
      const health = response.data.data || response.data;
      
      spinner.stop();
      
      if (options.json) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify(health, null, 2));
        return;
      }
      
      console.log(chalk.cyan('\nQAssure Platform - Detailed Health\n'));
      console.log(`  Overall Status: ${statusColor(health.status)}`);
      console.log(`  Timestamp:      ${health.timestamp || new Date().toISOString()}`);
      console.log(`  Uptime:         ${health.uptime || 'N/A'}`);
      console.log(`  Version:        ${health.version || 'N/A'}`);
      
      // Services
      if (health.services) {
        console.log(chalk.cyan('\n  Services:\n'));
        Object.entries(health.services).forEach(([name, service]) => {
          const status = typeof service === 'object' ? service.status : service;
          const latency = typeof service === 'object' && service.latency ? ` (${service.latency}ms)` : '';
          console.log(`    ${name.padEnd(20)} ${statusColor(status)}${latency}`);
        });
      }
      
      // Database
      if (health.database) {
        console.log(chalk.cyan('\n  Database:\n'));
        console.log(`    Status:      ${statusColor(health.database.status)}`);
        console.log(`    Connections: ${health.database.connections || 'N/A'}`);
        console.log(`    Pool Size:   ${health.database.poolSize || 'N/A'}`);
      }
      
      // Redis
      if (health.redis) {
        console.log(chalk.cyan('\n  Redis:\n'));
        console.log(`    Status:      ${statusColor(health.redis.status)}`);
        console.log(`    Memory:      ${health.redis.memory || 'N/A'}`);
        console.log(`    Clients:     ${health.redis.clients || 'N/A'}`);
      }
      
      // Kafka
      if (health.kafka) {
        console.log(chalk.cyan('\n  Kafka:\n'));
        console.log(`    Status:      ${statusColor(health.kafka.status)}`);
        console.log(`    Brokers:     ${health.kafka.brokers || 'N/A'}`);
      }
      
      // Elasticsearch
      if (health.elasticsearch) {
        console.log(chalk.cyan('\n  Elasticsearch:\n'));
        console.log(`    Status:      ${statusColor(health.elasticsearch.status)}`);
        console.log(`    Cluster:     ${health.elasticsearch.cluster || 'N/A'}`);
      }
      
      // Memory
      if (health.memory) {
        console.log(chalk.cyan('\n  Memory:\n'));
        console.log(`    Used:        ${health.memory.used || 'N/A'}`);
        console.log(`    Total:       ${health.memory.total || 'N/A'}`);
        console.log(`    Percentage:  ${health.memory.percentage || 'N/A'}%`);
      }
      
      console.log('');
      
    } catch (error) {
      spinner.fail(chalk.red('Failed to fetch detailed health'));
      const message = error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message;
      console.error(chalk.red(`  ${message}`));
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });

// Readiness check
healthCommand
  .command('ready')
  .description('Check if platform is ready to accept traffic')
  .option('--json', 'Output as JSON')
  .action(async (options) => {
    const spinner = ora('Checking readiness...').start();
    
    try {
      const client = getClient();
      const response = await client.get('/health/ready');
      const data = response.data;
      
      spinner.stop();
      
      if (options.json) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
        return;
      }
      
      const ready = data.ready || data.status === 'ready' || data.status === 'ok';
      
      if (ready) {
        console.log(chalk.green('\n✓ Platform is ready to accept traffic\n'));
      } else {
        console.log(chalk.yellow('\n⚠ Platform is not ready\n'));
        if (data.reason) {
          console.log(`  Reason: ${data.reason}`);
        }
      }
      
    } catch (error) {
      spinner.fail(chalk.red('Readiness check failed'));
      console.log(chalk.red('\n✗ Platform is not ready\n'));
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });

// Liveness check
healthCommand
  .command('live')
  .description('Check if platform is alive')
  .option('--json', 'Output as JSON')
  .action(async (options) => {
    const spinner = ora('Checking liveness...').start();
    
    try {
      const client = getClient();
      const response = await client.get('/health/live');
      const data = response.data;
      
      spinner.stop();
      
      if (options.json) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
        return;
      }
      
      console.log(chalk.green('\n✓ Platform is alive\n'));
      
    } catch (error) {
      spinner.fail(chalk.red('Liveness check failed'));
      console.log(chalk.red('\n✗ Platform is not responding\n'));
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });

// Ping test
healthCommand
  .command('ping')
  .description('Simple ping test to the API')
  .option('-c, --count <number>', 'Number of pings', '3')
  .action(async (options) => {
    const count = parseInt(options.count);
    const baseUrl = config.get('apiUrl');
    const client = getClient();
    
    console.log(chalk.cyan(`\nPinging ${baseUrl}...\n`));
    
    const results = [];
    
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const start = Date.now();
      try {
        await client.get('/health');
        const latency = Date.now() - start;
        results.push(latency);
        console.log(`  Ping ${i + 1}: ${chalk.green('OK')} - ${latency}ms`);
      } catch (error) {
        console.log(`  Ping ${i + 1}: ${chalk.red('FAILED')}`);
      }
      
      if (i < count - 1) {
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
      }
    }
    
    if (results.length > 0) {
      const avg = Math.round(results.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / results.length);
      const min = Math.min(...results);
      const max = Math.max(...results);
      
      console.log(chalk.cyan('\n  Statistics:\n'));
      console.log(`    Packets: ${count} sent, ${results.length} received, ${count - results.length} lost`);
      console.log(`    Latency: min=${min}ms, avg=${avg}ms, max=${max}ms`);
    }
    
    console.log('');
  });

// Watch health (continuous monitoring)
healthCommand
  .command('watch')
  .description('Continuously monitor platform health')
  .option('-i, --interval <seconds>', 'Check interval in seconds', '5')
  .action(async (options) => {
    const interval = parseInt(options.interval) * 1000;
    const client = getClient();
    
    console.log(chalk.cyan(`\nMonitoring platform health (Ctrl+C to stop)...\n`));
    
    const checkHealth = async () => {
      const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().substring(11, 19);
      try {
        const start = Date.now();
        const response = await client.get('/health');
        const latency = Date.now() - start;
        const status = response.data.status || response.data.data?.status || 'ok';
        
        if (status === 'healthy' || status === 'ok') {
          console.log(`  [${timestamp}] ${chalk.green('✓ healthy')} (${latency}ms)`);
        } else {
          console.log(`  [${timestamp}] ${chalk.yellow('⚠ ' + status)} (${latency}ms)`);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.log(`  [${timestamp}] ${chalk.red('✗ unhealthy')} - ${error.message}`);
      }
    };
    
    // Initial check
    await checkHealth();
    
    // Continuous monitoring
    const intervalId = setInterval(checkHealth, interval);
    
    // Handle exit
    process.on('SIGINT', () => {
      clearInterval(intervalId);
      console.log(chalk.cyan('\n\nMonitoring stopped.\n'));
      process.exit(0);
    });
  });

module.exports = healthCommand;

/**
 * QAssure CLI - Module Commands
 */

const { Command } = require('commander');
const chalk = require('chalk');
const ora = require('ora');
const Table = require('cli-table3');
const inquirer = require('inquirer');
const axios = require('axios');
const { config } = require('./config');

const moduleCommand = new Command('modules')
  .alias('mod')
  .description('Module registry management');

// Helper to get authenticated client
const getClient = () => {
  const baseUrl = config.get('apiUrl');
  const apiVersion = config.get('apiVersion');
  const token = config.get('accessToken');
  
  if (!token) {
    console.error(chalk.red('Not authenticated. Run: qassure auth login'));
    process.exit(1);
  }
  
  return axios.create({
    baseURL: `${baseUrl}/api/${apiVersion}`,
    timeout: 30000,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
      'User-Agent': 'QAssure-CLI/1.0.0'
    }
  });
};

// Status color helper
const statusColor = (status) => {
  const colors = {
    running: chalk.green,
    healthy: chalk.green,
    pending: chalk.yellow,
    starting: chalk.cyan,
    stopping: chalk.yellow,
    stopped: chalk.gray,
    failed: chalk.red,
    unhealthy: chalk.red,
    deprecated: chalk.magenta,
    maintenance: chalk.blue
  };
  return (colors[status] || chalk.white)(status);
};

// List modules
moduleCommand
  .command('list')
  .alias('ls')
  .description('List all registered modules')
  .option('-s, --status <status>', 'Filter by status')
  .option('-l, --limit <number>', 'Number of results', '20')
  .option('-p, --page <number>', 'Page number', '1')
  .option('--json', 'Output as JSON')
  .action(async (options) => {
    const spinner = ora('Fetching modules...').start();
    
    try {
      const client = getClient();
      const params = {
        page: options.page,
        limit: options.limit
      };
      if (options.status) params.status = options.status;
      
      const response = await client.get('/modules', { params });
      const { data, pagination } = response.data;
      
      spinner.stop();
      
      if (options.json) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify(response.data, null, 2));
        return;
      }
      
      if (data.length === 0) {
        console.log(chalk.yellow('\nNo modules found.\n'));
        return;
      }
      
      const table = new Table({
        head: [
          chalk.cyan('Module ID'),
          chalk.cyan('Name'),
          chalk.cyan('Version'),
          chalk.cyan('Status'),
          chalk.cyan('Health'),
          chalk.cyan('URL')
        ],
        colWidths: [15, 25, 10, 12, 10, 30]
      });
      
      data.forEach(mod => {
        table.push([
          mod.module_id,
          mod.name.substring(0, 23),
          mod.version,
          statusColor(mod.status),
          statusColor(mod.health_status || 'unknown'),
          mod.base_url?.substring(0, 28) || 'N/A'
        ]);
      });
      
      console.log(`\n${table.toString()}`);
      console.log(chalk.gray(`\n  Page ${pagination.page} of ${pagination.totalPages} (${pagination.total} total)\n`));
      
    } catch (error) {
      spinner.fail(chalk.red('Failed to fetch modules'));
      const message = error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message;
      console.error(chalk.red(`  ${message}`));
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });

// Get module details
moduleCommand
  .command('get <moduleId>')
  .alias('show')
  .description('Get module details')
  .option('--json', 'Output as JSON')
  .action(async (moduleId, options) => {
    const spinner = ora('Fetching module...').start();
    
    try {
      const client = getClient();
      const response = await client.get(`/modules/${moduleId}`);
      const mod = response.data.data;
      
      spinner.stop();
      
      if (options.json) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify(mod, null, 2));
        return;
      }
      
      console.log(chalk.cyan(`\nModule: ${mod.name}\n`));
      console.log(`  ID:              ${mod.id}`);
      console.log(`  Module ID:       ${chalk.green(mod.module_id)}`);
      console.log(`  Version:         ${mod.version}`);
      console.log(`  Status:          ${statusColor(mod.status)}`);
      console.log(`  Health:          ${statusColor(mod.health_status || 'unknown')}`);
      console.log(`  Base URL:        ${mod.base_url}`);
      console.log(`  Health Endpoint: ${mod.health_endpoint}`);
      console.log(`  Runtime:         ${mod.runtime_language || 'N/A'}`);
      console.log(`  Framework:       ${mod.framework || 'N/A'}`);
      console.log(`  Replicas:        ${mod.min_replicas}-${mod.max_replicas}`);
      console.log(`  CPU:             ${mod.cpu_request} / ${mod.cpu_limit}`);
      console.log(`  Memory:          ${mod.memory_request} / ${mod.memory_limit}`);
      console.log(`  Failures:        ${mod.consecutive_failures || 0}`);
      console.log(`  Last Check:      ${mod.last_health_check || 'Never'}`);
      console.log(`  Created:         ${mod.created_at}`);
      console.log(`  Updated:         ${mod.updated_at}`);
      
      if (mod.endpoints) {
        console.log(`\n  Endpoints:`);
        const endpoints = typeof mod.endpoints === 'string' ? JSON.parse(mod.endpoints) : mod.endpoints;
        endpoints.forEach(ep => {
          console.log(`    ${chalk.yellow(ep.method.padEnd(6))} ${ep.path}`);
        });
      }
      
      if (mod.kafka_topics) {
        const topics = typeof mod.kafka_topics === 'string' ? JSON.parse(mod.kafka_topics) : mod.kafka_topics;
        console.log(`\n  Kafka Topics:`);
        if (topics.publish?.length) console.log(`    Publish:   ${topics.publish.join(', ')}`);
        if (topics.subscribe?.length) console.log(`    Subscribe: ${topics.subscribe.join(', ')}`);
      }
      
      console.log('');
      
    } catch (error) {
      spinner.fail(chalk.red('Failed to fetch module'));
      const message = error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message;
      console.error(chalk.red(`  ${message}`));
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });

// Register module
moduleCommand
  .command('register')
  .alias('create')
  .description('Register a new module')
  .option('-f, --file <path>', 'JSON file with module configuration')
  .option('-i, --interactive', 'Interactive mode')
  .action(async (options) => {
    let moduleData;
    
    if (options.file) {
      const fs = require('fs');
      try {
        moduleData = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(options.file, 'utf8'));
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(chalk.red(`Failed to read file: ${e.message}`));
        process.exit(1);
      }
    } else if (options.interactive) {
      const answers = await inquirer.prompt([
        { type: 'input', name: 'module_id', message: 'Module ID (unique):', validate: i => !!i },
        { type: 'input', name: 'name', message: 'Module Name:', validate: i => !!i },
        { type: 'input', name: 'version', message: 'Version:', default: '1.0.0' },
        { type: 'input', name: 'base_url', message: 'Base URL:', validate: i => !!i },
        { type: 'input', name: 'health_endpoint', message: 'Health Endpoint:', default: '/health' },
        { type: 'list', name: 'runtime_language', message: 'Runtime:', choices: ['nodejs', 'python', 'java', 'go', 'other'] },
        { type: 'input', name: 'description', message: 'Description (optional):' }
      ]);
      moduleData = answers;
    } else {
      console.log(chalk.yellow('Please provide --file <path> or use --interactive mode'));
      console.log(chalk.gray('\nExample JSON file:'));
      console.log(chalk.gray(JSON.stringify({
        module_id: 'my-module',
        name: 'My Module',
        version: '1.0.0',
        base_url: 'http://my-module:3001',
        health_endpoint: '/health',
        runtime_language: 'nodejs'
      }, null, 2)));
      process.exit(1);
    }
    
    const spinner = ora('Registering module...').start();
    
    try {
      const client = getClient();
      const response = await client.post('/modules', moduleData);
      const mod = response.data.data;
      
      spinner.succeed(chalk.green('Module registered successfully!'));
      console.log(`\n  ID:        ${mod.id}`);
      console.log(`  Module ID: ${chalk.cyan(mod.module_id)}`);
      console.log(`  Status:    ${statusColor(mod.status)}`);
      console.log(`\n  To start:  ${chalk.cyan(`qassure modules start ${mod.id}`)}\n`);
      
    } catch (error) {
      spinner.fail(chalk.red('Failed to register module'));
      const message = error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message;
      console.error(chalk.red(`  ${message}`));
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });

/**
 * QAssure CLI - User Commands
 */

const { Command } = require('commander');
const chalk = require('chalk');
const ora = require('ora');
const Table = require('cli-table3');
const inquirer = require('inquirer');
const axios = require('axios');
const { config } = require('./config');

const userCommand = new Command('users')
  .alias('user')
  .description('User management commands');

// Helper to get authenticated client
const getClient = () => {
  const baseUrl = config.get('apiUrl');
  const apiVersion = config.get('apiVersion');
  const token = config.get('accessToken');
  
  if (!token) {
    console.error(chalk.red('Not authenticated. Run: qassure auth login'));
    process.exit(1);
  }
  
  return axios.create({
    baseURL: `${baseUrl}/api/${apiVersion}`,
    timeout: 30000,
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
      'User-Agent': 'QAssure-CLI/1.0.0'
    }
  });
};

// Status color helper
const statusColor = (status) => {
  const colors = {
    active: chalk.green,
    inactive: chalk.gray,
    pending: chalk.yellow,
    suspended: chalk.red,
    locked: chalk.red
  };
  return (colors[status] || chalk.white)(status);
};

// List users
userCommand
  .command('list')
  .alias('ls')
  .description('List all users')
  .option('-s, --status <status>', 'Filter by status (active, inactive, pending)')
  .option('-r, --role <role>', 'Filter by role')
  .option('-l, --limit <number>', 'Number of results', '20')
  .option('-p, --page <number>', 'Page number', '1')
  .option('--json', 'Output as JSON')
  .action(async (options) => {
    const spinner = ora('Fetching users...').start();
    
    try {
      const client = getClient();
      const params = {
        page: options.page,
        limit: options.limit
      };
      if (options.status) params.status = options.status;
      if (options.role) params.role = options.role;
      
      const response = await client.get('/users', { params });
      const { data, pagination } = response.data;
      
      spinner.stop();
      
      if (options.json) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify(response.data, null, 2));
        return;
      }
      
      if (data.length === 0) {
        console.log(chalk.yellow('\nNo users found.\n'));
        return;
      }
      
      const table = new Table({
        head: [
          chalk.cyan('ID'),
          chalk.cyan('Email'),
          chalk.cyan('Name'),
          chalk.cyan('Status'),
          chalk.cyan('Roles'),
          chalk.cyan('Created')
        ],
        colWidths: [38, 30, 20, 10, 20, 12]
      });
      
      data.forEach(user => {
        const roles = user.roles?.map(r => r.code).join(', ') || 'N/A';
        const created = user.created_at?.substring(0, 10) || 'N/A';
        table.push([
          user.id,
          user.email.substring(0, 28),
          `${user.first_name || ''} ${user.last_name || ''}`.trim().substring(0, 18) || 'N/A',
          statusColor(user.status),
          roles.substring(0, 18),
          created
        ]);
      });
      
      console.log(`\n${table.toString()}`);
      console.log(chalk.gray(`\n  Page ${pagination.page} of ${pagination.totalPages} (${pagination.total} total)\n`));
      
    } catch (error) {
      spinner.fail(chalk.red('Failed to fetch users'));
      const message = error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message;
      console.error(chalk.red(`  ${message}`));
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });

// Get user details
userCommand
  .command('get <userId>')
  .alias('show')
  .description('Get user details')
  .option('--json', 'Output as JSON')
  .action(async (userId, options) => {

    try {
      const client = getClient();
      const response = await client.get(`/users/${userId}`);
      const user = response.data.data;
      
      spinner.stop();
      
      if (options.json) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify(user, null, 2));
        return;
      }
      
      console.log(chalk.cyan(`\nUser: ${user.first_name} ${user.last_name}\n`));
      console.log(`  ID:         ${user.id}`);
      console.log(`  Email:      ${chalk.green(user.email)}`);
      console.log(`  First Name: ${user.first_name || 'N/A'}`);
      console.log(`  Last Name:  ${user.last_name || 'N/A'}`);
      console.log(`  Status:     ${statusColor(user.status)}`);
      console.log(`  Tenant ID:  ${user.tenant_id || 'N/A'}`);
      console.log(`  Department: ${user.department || 'N/A'}`);
      console.log(`  Title:      ${user.title || 'N/A'}`);
      console.log(`  Phone:      ${user.phone || 'N/A'}`);
      console.log(`  Created:    ${user.created_at}`);
      console.log(`  Updated:    ${user.updated_at}`);
      console.log(`  Last Login: ${user.last_login_at || 'Never'}`);
      
      if (user.roles?.length) {
        console.log(`\n  Roles:`);
        user.roles.forEach(role => {
          console.log(`    • ${chalk.yellow(role.code)} - ${role.name}`);
        });
      }
      
      console.log('');
      
    } catch (error) {
      spinner.fail(chalk.red('Failed to fetch user'));
      const message = error.response?.data?.error?.message || error.message;
      console.error(chalk.red(`  ${message}`));
      process.exit(1);
    }
  });

========== FILE: ./cli/src/index.js ==========
#!/usr/bin/env node

/**
 * QAssure CLI - Command Line Interface
 * @version 1.0.0
 */

const { program } = require('commander');
const chalk = require('chalk');
const figlet = require('figlet');
const packageJson = require('../package.json');

// Import commands
const authCommands = require('./commands/auth');
const moduleCommands = require('./commands/modules');
const userCommands = require('./commands/users');
const documentCommands = require('./commands/documents');
const capaCommands = require('./commands/capas');
const configCommands = require('./commands/config');
const healthCommands = require('./commands/health');

// Display banner
const showBanner = () => {
  console.log(
    chalk.cyan(
      figlet.textSync('QAssure', { horizontalLayout: 'default' })
    )
  );
  console.log(chalk.gray('  Enterprise Quality Management System CLI\n'));
};

// Main program setup
program
  .name('qassure')
  .description('QAssure Platform CLI - Manage your QMS from the command line')
  .version(packageJson.version, '-v, --version', 'Output the current version')
  .option('-q, --quiet', 'Suppress non-essential output')
  .option('--json', 'Output results as JSON')
  .option('--no-color', 'Disable colored output');

// Register command groups
program.addCommand(authCommands);
program.addCommand(moduleCommands);
program.addCommand(userCommands);
program.addCommand(documentCommands);
program.addCommand(capaCommands);
program.addCommand(configCommands);
program.addCommand(healthCommands);

// Default action - show help with banner
program.action(() => {
  showBanner();
  program.help();
});

// Error handling
program.showHelpAfterError('(add --help for additional information)');

// Parse arguments
program.parseAsync(process.argv).catch((err) => {
  console.error(chalk.red('Error:'), err.message);
  process.exit(1);
});

version: '3.8'

services:
  api:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: deploy/docker/Dockerfile
    container_name: qassure-api
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
      - PORT=3000
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://qassure:qassure_password@postgres:5432/qassure
      - REDIS_URL=redis://:redis_password@redis:6379
      - JWT_SECRET=your-super-secret-jwt-key-min-32-chars
      - JWT_REFRESH_SECRET=your-super-secret-refresh-key-32-chars
      - APP_URL=https://qasure.tech4bizsolutions.com/
      - EMAIL_FROM=noreply@qassure.ai
      - CORS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:5173,https://qasure.tech4bizsolutions.com
      - CORS_CREDENTIALS=true
      - KAFKA_BROKERS=kafka:9092
      - ELASTICSEARCH_URL=http://elasticsearch:9200
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - qassure-network
    restart: unless-stopped

  postgres:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: qassure-postgres
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=qassure
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=qassure_password
      - POSTGRES_DB=qassure
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U qassure"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    networks:
      - qassure-network
    restart: unless-stopped

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: qassure-redis
    command: redis-server --requirepass redis_password --appendonly yes
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    networks:
      - qassure-network
    restart: unless-stopped

  kafka:
    image: bitnami/kafka:3.6
    container_name: qassure-kafka
    environment:
      - KAFKA_CFG_NODE_ID=0
      - KAFKA_CFG_PROCESS_ROLES=controller,broker
      - KAFKA_CFG_LISTENERS=PLAINTEXT://:9092,CONTROLLER://:9093
      - KAFKA_CFG_LISTENER_SECURITY_PROTOCOL_MAP=CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT,PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT
      - KAFKA_CFG_CONTROLLER_QUORUM_VOTERS=0@kafka:9093
      - KAFKA_CFG_CONTROLLER_LISTENER_NAMES=CONTROLLER
    volumes:
      - kafka_data:/bitnami/kafka
    ports:
      - "9092:9092"
    networks:
      - qassure-network
    restart: unless-stopped

  elasticsearch:
    image: elasticsearch:8.11.0
    container_name: qassure-elasticsearch
    environment:
      - discovery.type=single-node
      - xpack.security.enabled=false
      - "ES_JAVA_OPTS=-Xms512m -Xmx512m"
    volumes:
      - elasticsearch_data:/usr/share/elasticsearch/data
    ports:
      - "9200:9200"
    networks:
      - qassure-network
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  postgres_data:
  redis_data:
  kafka_data:
  elasticsearch_data:

networks:
  qassure-network:
    driver: bridge

========== FILE: ./docker-compose.yml ==========
version: '3.8'

# ============================================
# QAssure Platform - Docker Compose
# ============================================
# Usage:
#   Start all:           docker-compose up -d
#   With monitoring:     docker-compose --profile monitoring up -d
#   With debug tools:    docker-compose --profile debug up -d
#   View logs:           docker-compose logs -f api
#   Stop all:            docker-compose down
#   Stop + remove data:  docker-compose down -v

services:
  # ===========================================
  # QAssure API
  # ===========================================
  api:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: qassure-api
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=development
      - PORT=3000
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres123@postgres:5432/qassure_dev
      - DB_HOST=postgres
      - DB_PORT=5432
      - DB_NAME=qassure_dev
      - DB_USER=postgres
      - DB_PASSWORD=postgres123
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      - JWT_SECRET=dev-secret-change-in-production-use-256-bit-key
      - JWT_REFRESH_SECRET=your-super-secret-refresh-key-change-in-production-use-256-bit-key-minimum-32-characters
      - JWT_ACCESS_EXPIRY=24h
      - JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRY=7d
      - KAFKA_BROKERS=kafka:9092
      - EMAIL_PROVIDER=console
      - EMAIL_FROM=noreply@qassure.ai
      - APP_URL=http://localhost:5173
      - LOG_LEVEL=debug
      - LOG_REQUESTS=true
      - API_PREFIX=/api/v1
      - RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS=900000
      - RATE_LIMIT_MAX=1000
      - CORS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:5173,https://qasure.tech4bizsolutions.com,https://coc-frontend.loca.lt,http://localhost:4173
      - CORS_CREDENTIALS=true
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      kafka:
        condition: service_started
    networks:
      - qassure-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
    volumes:
      # Mount source for hot-reload in development
      - ./src:/app/src:ro
      - ./app.js:/app/app.js:ro
      - ./server.js:/app/server.js:ro

  # ===========================================
  # PostgreSQL Database
  # ===========================================
  postgres:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: qassure-postgres
    ports:
      - "5434:5432"  # Changed to 5433 to avoid conflict with local PostgreSQL
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=postgres
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres123
      - POSTGRES_DB=qassure_dev
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      # Initialize database with migrations
      - ./migrations:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:ro
    networks:
      - qassure-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  # ===========================================
  # Redis Cache
  # ===========================================
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: qassure-redis
    ports:
      - "6380:6379"
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes --maxmemory 256mb --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
    networks:
      - qassure-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  # ===========================================
  # Zookeeper (for Kafka)
  # ===========================================
  zookeeper:
    image: confluentinc/cp-zookeeper:7.5.0
    container_name: qassure-zookeeper
    ports:
      - "2181:2181"
    environment:
      ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT: 2181
      ZOOKEEPER_TICK_TIME: 2000
    volumes:
      - zookeeper_data:/var/lib/zookeeper/data
      - zookeeper_log:/var/lib/zookeeper/log
    networks:
      - qassure-network
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ===========================================
  # Kafka
  # ===========================================
  kafka:
    image: confluentinc/cp-kafka:7.5.0
    container_name: qassure-kafka
    ports:
      - "9092:9092"
      - "29092:29092"
    environment:
      KAFKA_BROKER_ID: 1
      KAFKA_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT: zookeeper:2181
      KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS: PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092,PLAINTEXT_HOST://localhost:29092
      KAFKA_LISTENER_SECURITY_PROTOCOL_MAP: PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,PLAINTEXT_HOST:PLAINTEXT
      KAFKA_INTER_BROKER_LISTENER_NAME: PLAINTEXT
      KAFKA_OFFSETS_TOPIC_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_TRANSACTION_STATE_LOG_MIN_ISR: 1
      KAFKA_TRANSACTION_STATE_LOG_REPLICATION_FACTOR: 1
      KAFKA_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLE: "true"
      KAFKA_GROUP_INITIAL_REBALANCE_DELAY_MS: 0
    depends_on:
      - zookeeper
    volumes:
      - kafka_data:/var/lib/kafka/data
    networks:
      - qassure-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "kafka-broker-api-versions", "--bootstrap-server", "localhost:9092"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s

  # ===========================================
  # Kafka UI (Debug Profile)
  # ===========================================
  kafka-ui:
    image: provectuslabs/kafka-ui:latest
    container_name: qassure-kafka-ui
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    environment:
      KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_NAME: qassure
      KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_BOOTSTRAPSERVERS: kafka:9092
      KAFKA_CLUSTERS_0_ZOOKEEPER: zookeeper:2181
    depends_on:
      - kafka
    networks:
      - qassure-network
    profiles:
      - debug

  # ===========================================
  # Redis Commander (Debug Profile)
  # ===========================================
  redis-commander:
    image: rediscommander/redis-commander:latest
    container_name: qassure-redis-ui
    ports:
      - "8081:8081"
    environment:
      - REDIS_HOSTS=local:redis:6379
    depends_on:
      - redis
    networks:
      - qassure-network
    profiles:
      - debug

  # ===========================================
  # pgAdmin (Debug Profile)
  # ===========================================
  pgadmin:
    image: dpage/pgadmin4:latest
    container_name: qassure-pgadmin
    ports:
      - "5050:80"
    environment:
      - PGADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL=admin@qassure.ai
      - PGADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD=admin123
    depends_on:
