  # ===========================================
  # Prometheus (Monitoring Profile)
  # ===========================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v2.47.0
    container_name: qassure-prometheus
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./deploy/prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=15d'
    networks:
      - qassure-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    profiles:
      - monitoring

  # ===========================================
  # Grafana (Monitoring Profile)
  # ===========================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:10.1.0
    container_name: qassure-grafana
    ports:
      - "3001:3000"
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin123
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
    volumes:
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
      - ./deploy/grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    networks:
      - qassure-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    profiles:
      - monitoring


  # ===========================================
  # Elasticsearch (Search & Analytics)
  # ===========================================
  elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.11.0
    container_name: qassure-elasticsearch
    ports:
      - "9200:9200"
      - "9300:9300"
    environment:
      - discovery.type=single-node
      - xpack.security.enabled=false
      - "ES_JAVA_OPTS=-Xms512m -Xmx512m"
      - cluster.name=qassure-cluster
      - bootstrap.memory_lock=true
    ulimits:
      memlock:
        soft: -1
        hard: -1
    volumes:
      - elasticsearch_data:/usr/share/elasticsearch/data
    networks:
      - qassure-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -s http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health | grep -qE 'green|yellow'"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 60s

  # ===========================================
  # Kibana (Elasticsearch UI)
  # ===========================================
  kibana:
    image: docker.elastic.co/kibana/kibana:8.11.0
    container_name: qassure-kibana
    ports:
      - "5601:5601"
    environment:
      - ELASTICSEARCH_HOSTS=http://elasticsearch:9200
    depends_on:
      elasticsearch:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - qassure-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    profiles:
      - monitoring

========== FILE: ./k8s/deployments/api-deployment.yaml ==========
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: qassure-api
  namespace: qassure
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: qassure
    app.kubernetes.io/component: api
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: qassure-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: qassure-api
        app.kubernetes.io/name: qassure
        app.kubernetes.io/component: api
      annotations:
        prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
        prometheus.io/port: "3000"
        prometheus.io/path: "/api/v1/metrics"
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: qassure-api
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
      initContainers:
        - name: wait-for-postgres
          image: busybox:1.36
          command: ['sh', '-c', 'until nc -z postgres-service 5432; do echo waiting for postgres; sleep 2; done']
        - name: wait-for-redis
          image: busybox:1.36
          command: ['sh', '-c', 'until nc -z redis-service 6379; do echo waiting for redis; sleep 2; done']
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: qassure/api:1.0.0
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 3000
              protocol: TCP
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: qassure-config
            - secretRef:
                name: qassure-secrets
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "2000m"
              memory: "2Gi"
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/v1/health
              port: 3000
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/v1/health/detailed
              port: 3000
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/v1/health
              port: 3000
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 30
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
            - name: uploads
              mountPath: /app/uploads
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
        - name: uploads
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: qassure-uploads-pvc
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app: qassure-api
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: docker-registry-secret
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount

    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: memory
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 80
  behavior:

      policies:

          periodSeconds: 60
        - type: Percent
          value: 100
          periodSeconds: 60
      selectPolicy: Max

========== FILE: ./k8s/deployments/redis-deployment.yaml ==========
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: redis
  namespace: qassure
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: qassure
    app.kubernetes.io/component: redis
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis
        app.kubernetes.io/name: qassure
        app.kubernetes.io/component: redis
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: redis:7-alpine
          ports:
            - containerPort: 6379
          command:
            - redis-server
            - --requirepass
            - $(REDIS_PASSWORD)
            - --appendonly
            - "yes"
            - --maxmemory
            - "512mb"
            - --maxmemory-policy
            - "allkeys-lru"
          env:
            - name: REDIS_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: qassure-secrets
                  key: REDIS_PASSWORD
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "256Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "1Gi"
          volumeMounts:
            - name: redis-data
              mountPath: /data
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - redis-cli
                - ping
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 5
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - redis-cli
                - ping
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 3
      volumes:
        - name: redis-data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: redis-pvc
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: redis-pvc
  namespace: qassure
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Gi
  storageClassName: standard

/**
 * QAssure Platform JavaScript SDK Type Definitions
 */

export interface QAssureClientOptions {
  baseUrl?: string;
  apiVersion?: string;
  tenantId?: string;
  timeout?: number;
}

export interface LoginResponse {
  success: boolean;
  data: {
    user: User;
    tokens: {
      access_token: string;
      refresh_token: string;

const axios = require('axios');

// ==================== Exceptions ====================

class QAssureError extends Error {
  constructor(message, statusCode = null, response = null) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'QAssureError';
    this.statusCode = statusCode;
    this.response = response;
  }
}

class AuthenticationError extends QAssureError {
  constructor(message, statusCode, response) {
    super(message, statusCode, response);
    this.name = 'AuthenticationError';
  }
}

class NotFoundError extends QAssureError {
  constructor(message, statusCode, response) {
    super(message, statusCode, response);
    this.name = 'NotFoundError';
  }
}

class ValidationError extends QAssureError {
  constructor(message, statusCode, response) {
    super(message, statusCode, response);
    this.name = 'ValidationError';
  }
}

class InvalidStateTransitionError extends ValidationError {
  constructor(message, statusCode, response) {
    super(message, statusCode, response);
    this.name = 'InvalidStateTransitionError';
  }
}

// ==================== Base Resource ====================

class BaseResource {
  constructor(client) {
    this.client = client;
  }
}

// ==================== Auth Resource ====================

class AuthResource extends BaseResource {
  async login(email, password) {
    const response = await this.client.post('/auth/login', { email, password });
    if (response.success) {
      this.client._accessToken = response.data.access_token;
      this.client._refreshToken = response.data.refresh_token;
    }
    return response;
  }

  async logout() {
    const response = await this.client.post('/auth/logout');
    this.client._accessToken = null;
    this.client._refreshToken = null;
    return response;
  }

  async logoutAll() {
    const response = await this.client.post('/auth/logout-all');
    this.client._accessToken = null;
    this.client._refreshToken = null;
    return response;
  }

  async refresh() {
    const response = await this.client.post('/auth/refresh', {
      refresh_token: this.client._refreshToken
    });
    if (response.success) {
      this.client._accessToken = response.data.access_token;
    }
    return response;
  }

  async me() {
    return this.client.get('/auth/me');
  }

  async changePassword(currentPassword, newPassword) {
    return this.client.post('/auth/change-password', {
      current_password: currentPassword,
      new_password: newPassword
    });
  }

  async forgotPassword(email) {
    return this.client.post('/auth/forgot-password', { email });
  }

  async resetPassword(token, newPassword) {
    return this.client.post('/auth/reset-password', {
      token,
      new_password: newPassword
    });
  }
}

   * Register a new module
   * @param {Object} data - Module configuration

   * @param {string} data.name - Display name
   * @param {string} data.version - Semantic version
   * @param {string} data.base_url - Module service URL
   * @param {string} data.health_endpoint - Health check path
   * @param {Array} data.endpoints - List of API endpoints
   * @param {Object} data.kafka_topics - Pub/sub topics
   */

    return this.client.post('/modules', data);
  }

    return this.client.put(`/modules/${moduleId}`, data);
  }

  async delete(moduleId) {
    return this.client.delete(`/modules/${moduleId}`);
  }

  }

    return this.client.post(`/modules/${moduleId}/stop`, { reason });
  }

  async restart(moduleId, reason = null) {
    return this.client.post(`/modules/${moduleId}/restart`, { reason });
  }

  async setMaintenance(moduleId, reason = null) {
    return this.client.post(`/modules/${moduleId}/maintenance`, { reason });
  }

  async deprecate(moduleId, reason = null) {
    return this.client.post(`/modules/${moduleId}/deprecate`, { reason });
  }

  async deregister(moduleId) {
    return this.client.post(`/modules/${moduleId}/deregister`);
  }

  async updateStatus(moduleId, status, reason = null) {
    return this.client.patch(`/modules/${moduleId}/status`, { status, reason });
  }

  async updateVersion(moduleId, version, changelog = null) {
    return this.client.patch(`/modules/${moduleId}/version`, { version, changelog });

  async healthCheck(moduleId) {
    return this.client.post(`/modules/${moduleId}/health-check`);
  }

    return this.client.get('/modules/stats');
  }

  async states() {
    return this.client.get('/modules/states');

// ==================== File Resource ====================

class FileResource extends BaseResource {
  async upload(filePath, entityType, entityId) {
    const FormData = require('form-data');
    const fs = require('fs');
    const form = new FormData();
    form.append('file', fs.createReadStream(filePath));
    form.append('entity_type', entityType);
    form.append('entity_id', entityId);
    
    const response = await this.client._http.post('/files/upload', form, {
      headers: {
        ...form.getHeaders(),
        Authorization: `Bearer ${this.client._accessToken}`
      }
    });
    return response.data;
  }

  async download(fileId) {
    const response = await this.client._http.get(`/files/${fileId}/download`, {
      responseType: 'arraybuffer'
    });
    return response.data;
  }

  async get(fileId) {
    return this.client.get(`/files/${fileId}`);
  }

  async delete(fileId) {
    return this.client.delete(`/files/${fileId}`);
  }

  async listForEntity(entityType, entityId) {
    return this.client.get(`/files/entity/${entityType}/${entityId}`);
  }
}

    return this.client.get(`/webhooks/${webhookId}`);
  }

  async create(data) {
    return this.client.post('/webhooks', data);
  }

  async update(webhookId, data) {
    return this.client.put(`/webhooks/${webhookId}`, data);
  }

  async delete(webhookId) {
    return this.client.delete(`/webhooks/${webhookId}`);
  }

  async test(webhookId) {
    return this.client.post(`/webhooks/${webhookId}/test`);
  }

  async getDeliveries(webhookId) {
    return this.client.get(`/webhooks/${webhookId}/deliveries`);
  }

  async retryDelivery(deliveryId) {
    return this.client.post(`/webhooks/deliveries/${deliveryId}/retry`);
  }
}

// ==================== Main Client ====================

class QAssureClient {
  /**
   * QAssure Platform API Client
   * 
   * @param {Object} options - Client configuration
   * @param {string} options.baseUrl - API base URL (default: https://api.qassure.ai)
   * @param {string} options.apiVersion - API version (default: v1)
   * @param {string} options.tenantId - Tenant ID for multi-tenant requests
   * @param {number} options.timeout - Request timeout in ms (default: 30000)
   * 
   * @example
   * const client = new QAssureClient({ baseUrl: 'https://api.qassure.ai' });
   * await client.login('user@example.com', 'password');
   * 
   * // List modules
   * const modules = await client.modules.list();
   * 
   * // Register a module
   * const newModule = await client.modules.register({
   *   module_id: 'aich',
   *   name: 'AiCH Module',
   *   version: '1.0.0',
   *   base_url: 'http://aich:3001',
   *   health_endpoint: '/health'
   * });
   * 
   * // Start the module
   * await client.modules.start(newModule.data.id);
   */
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.baseUrl = (options.baseUrl || 'https://api.qassure.ai').replace(/\/$/, '');
    this.apiVersion = options.apiVersion || 'v1';
    this.apiUrl = `${this.baseUrl}/api/${this.apiVersion}`;
    this.tenantId = options.tenantId || null;
    this.timeout = options.timeout || 30000;
    
    this._accessToken = null;
    this._refreshToken = null;
    
    // Setup axios instance
    this._http = axios.create({
      baseURL: this.apiUrl,
      timeout: this.timeout,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Accept': 'application/json',
        'User-Agent': 'QAssure-JavaScript-SDK/1.0.0'
      }
    });
    
    this._setupInterceptors();
    
    // Initialize resource managers
    this.auth = new AuthResource(this);
    this.users = new UserResource(this);
    this.tenants = new TenantResource(this);
    this.roles = new RoleResource(this);
    this.permissions = new PermissionResource(this);
    this.modules = new ModuleResource(this);
    this.apiKeys = new ApiKeyResource(this);
    this.documents = new DocumentResource(this);
    this.capas = new CapaResource(this);
    this.training = new TrainingResource(this);
    this.suppliers = new SupplierResource(this);
    this.workflows = new WorkflowResource(this);
    this.notifications = new NotificationResource(this);
    this.reports = new ReportResource(this);
    this.auditLogs = new AuditLogResource(this);
    this.ai = new AIResource(this);
    this.qms = new QMSResource(this);
    this.files = new FileResource(this);
    this.webhooks = new WebhookResource(this);
    this.health = new HealthResource(this);
  }

  _setupInterceptors() {
    // Request interceptor
    this._http.interceptors.request.use((config) => {
      if (this._accessToken) {
        config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${this._accessToken}`;
      }
      if (this.tenantId) {
        config.headers['X-Tenant-ID'] = this.tenantId;
      }
      return config;
    });

    // Response interceptor
    this._http.interceptors.response.use(
      (response) => response,
      async (error) => {
        if (error.response?.status === 401 && this._refreshToken) {
          try {
            await this.auth.refresh();
            error.config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${this._accessToken}`;
            return this._http.request(error.config);
          } catch (refreshError) {
            throw refreshError;
          }
        }
        throw error;
      }
    );
  }

  _handleResponse(response) {
    return response.data;
  }

  _handleError(error) {
    const response = error.response;
    const data = response?.data || {};
    const message = data.error?.message || error.message;
    const statusCode = response?.status;

    if (statusCode === 400) {
      if (message.includes('Invalid state transition')) {
        throw new InvalidStateTransitionError(message, statusCode, data);
      }
      throw new ValidationError(message, statusCode, data);
    } else if (statusCode === 401) {
      throw new AuthenticationError(message, statusCode, data);
    } else if (statusCode === 404) {
      throw new NotFoundError(message, statusCode, data);
    } else {
      throw new QAssureError(message, statusCode, data);
    }
  }

  async request(method, endpoint, data = null, params = null) {
    try {
      const config = {
        method,
        url: endpoint,
        params
      };
      // Only include data for non-GET requests to avoid body-parser issues
      if (method !== 'GET' && method !== 'DELETE' && data !== null) {
        config.data = data;
      }
      const response = await this._http.request(config);
      return this._handleResponse(response);
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(error);
    }
  }

  async get(endpoint, params = null) {
    return this.request('GET', endpoint, null, params);
  }

  async post(endpoint, data = null) {
    return this.request('POST', endpoint, data);
  }

  async put(endpoint, data = null) {
    return this.request('PUT', endpoint, data);
  }

  async patch(endpoint, data = null) {
    return this.request('PATCH', endpoint, data);
  }

  async delete(endpoint) {
    return this.request('DELETE', endpoint);
  }

  // Convenience methods
  async login(email, password) {
    return this.auth.login(email, password);
  }

  async logout() {
    return this.auth.logout();
  }

  setTokens(accessToken, refreshToken = null) {
    this._accessToken = accessToken;
    if (refreshToken) this._refreshToken = refreshToken;
  }

  // WebSocket connection
  connectWebSocket(options = {}) {
    const wsUrl = this.baseUrl.replace('http', 'ws');
    const ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl, {
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${this._accessToken}`
      }
    });

    ws.on('open', () => {
      if (options.onOpen) options.onOpen();
    });

    ws.on('message', (data) => {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(data.toString());
        if (options.onMessage) options.onMessage(parsed);
      } catch (e) {
        if (options.onMessage) options.onMessage(data);
      }
    });

    ws.on('error', (error) => {
      if (options.onError) options.onError(error);
    });

    ws.on('close', () => {
      if (options.onClose) options.onClose();
    });

    return ws;
  }
}

// Export everything
module.exports = {
  QAssureClient,
  QAssureError,
  AuthenticationError,
  NotFoundError,
  ValidationError,
  InvalidStateTransitionError
};

const { QAssureClient, AuthenticationError, NotFoundError } = require('./src/index.js');

const API_URL = 'http://localhost:3000';

// Correct credentials from seed.js
const TEST_EMAIL = 'superadmin@qassure.ai';
const TEST_PASSWORD = 'Password123!';

console.log('==========================================');
console.log('QAssure JS SDK - Integration Test');
console.log(`API: ${API_URL}`);
console.log('==========================================\n');

let passed = 0;
let failed = 0;
let skipped = 0;

async function test(name, fn, skipOnAuthFail = false) {
  try {
    await fn();
    console.log(`✅ ${name}`);
    passed++;
  } catch (error) {
    if (skipOnAuthFail && (error instanceof AuthenticationError || error.message.includes('401') || error.message.includes('Not logged in'))) {
      console.log(`⏭️  ${name} (skipped - auth required)`);
      skipped++;
    } else {
      console.log(`❌ ${name}`);
      console.log(`   Error: ${error.message}`);
      failed++;
    }
  }
}

========== FILE: ./server.js ==========
const http = require('http');
const app = require('./app');
const config = require('./src/config/config');
const logger = require('./src/config/logger');
const database = require('./src/config/database');
const redisService = require('./src/infrastructure/cache/redis.service');
const { getPermissionService } = require('./src/infrastructure/auth/permission.service');
const { getAuthService } = require('./src/services/auth.service');
const { getElasticsearchService } = require('./src/infrastructure/search/elasticsearch.service');
const { getSocketService } = require('./src/infrastructure/websocket');

// Start server
async function startServer() {
  try {
    // Test database connection
    await database.testConnection();
    
    // Initialize Redis
    try {
      await redisService.connect();
      logger.info('✅ Redis connected successfully');
      
      // Wire Redis to services
      const permissionService = getPermissionService();
      permissionService.setRedisService(redisService);
      
      const authService = getAuthService();
      authService.setRedisService(redisService);
    } catch (redisError) {
      logger.warn('⚠️ Redis connection failed - running without cache:', redisError.message);
    }

    // Initialize Elasticsearch
    try {
      const esService = getElasticsearchService();
      const connected = await esService.connect();
      if (connected) {
        logger.info('✅ Elasticsearch connected successfully');
        
        // Index existing data in background
        indexExistingData(esService).catch(err => {
          logger.warn('Background indexing error:', err.message);
        });
      }
    } catch (esError) {
      logger.warn('⚠️ Elasticsearch connection failed - search will use PostgreSQL:', esError.message);
    }

    // Start HTTP server
    // Create HTTP server and initialize Socket.io
    const httpServer = http.createServer(app);
    const socketService = getSocketService();
    socketService.initialize(httpServer);

    httpServer.listen(config.app.port, config.app.host, () => {
      logger.info(`🚀 Server is running on ${config.app.host}:${config.app.port}`);
      logger.info(`📍 Environment: ${config.app.env}`);
      logger.info(`🌐 API prefix: ${config.api.prefix}`);
    });

    // Handle server errors
    httpServer.on('error', (error) => {
      if (error.syscall !== 'listen') {
        throw error;
      }
      const bind = typeof config.app.port === 'string' ? `Pipe ${config.app.port}` : `Port ${config.app.port}`;
      switch (error.code) {
        case 'EACCES':
          logger.error(`${bind} requires elevated privileges`);
          process.exit(1);
          break;
        case 'EADDRINUSE':
          logger.error(`${bind} is already in use`);
          process.exit(1);
          break;
        default:
          throw error;
      }
    });

    // Graceful shutdown
    const gracefulShutdown = async (signal) => {
      logger.info(`${signal} received. Starting graceful shutdown...`);
      server.close(async () => {
        logger.info('HTTP server closed');
        try {
          // Disconnect Redis
          await redisService.disconnect();
          logger.info('Redis connection closed');
          
          // Disconnect Elasticsearch
          const esService = getElasticsearchService();
          await esService.disconnect();
          logger.info('Elasticsearch connection closed');
          
          await database.close();
          logger.info('Database connection closed');
          logger.info('Graceful shutdown completed');
          process.exit(0);
        } catch (error) {
          logger.error('Error during shutdown:', error);
          process.exit(1);
        }
      });

      // Force close after 10 seconds
      setTimeout(() => {
        logger.error('Forcing shutdown after timeout');
        process.exit(1);
      }, 10000);
    };

    process.on('SIGTERM', () => gracefulShutdown('SIGTERM'));
    process.on('SIGINT', () => gracefulShutdown('SIGINT'));

    process.on('unhandledRejection', (reason, promise) => {
      logger.error('Unhandled Rejection at:', promise, 'reason:', reason);
    });

    process.on('uncaughtException', (error) => {
      logger.error('Uncaught Exception:', error);
      gracefulShutdown('uncaughtException');
    });

  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to start server:', error);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

// Index existing data on startup
async function indexExistingData(esService) {
  const { pool } = require('./src/config/database');
  const tenantId = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'; // Default tenant
  
  logger.info('[Elasticsearch] Starting background indexing of existing data...');
  
  try {
    // Index CAPAs
    const capas = await pool.query(
      `SELECT id, capa_number, title, description, problem_statement, capa_type, 
              priority, status, source, department
       FROM capas WHERE tenant_id = $1`,
      [tenantId]
    );
    if (capas.rows.length > 0) {
      await esService.bulkIndex('capas', capas.rows, tenantId);
      logger.info(`[Elasticsearch] Indexed ${capas.rows.length} CAPAs`);
    }

    // Index Documents
    const docs = await pool.query(
      `SELECT id, document_number, title, description, document_type as category, status, 
              department, current_version_id
       FROM documents WHERE tenant_id = $1`,
      [tenantId]
    );
    if (docs.rows.length > 0) {
      await esService.bulkIndex('documents', docs.rows, tenantId);
      logger.info(`[Elasticsearch] Indexed ${docs.rows.length} documents`);
    }

    // Index Suppliers
    const suppliers = await pool.query(
      `SELECT id, supplier_code, name, legal_name, supplier_type, category, 
              status, risk_level, current_score, score_grade, city, country
       FROM suppliers WHERE tenant_id = $1`,
      [tenantId]
    );
    if (suppliers.rows.length > 0) {
      await esService.bulkIndex('suppliers', suppliers.rows, tenantId);
      logger.info(`[Elasticsearch] Indexed ${suppliers.rows.length} suppliers`);
    }

    // Index Training Courses
    const courses = await pool.query(
      `SELECT id, course_code, title, description, category, course_type as training_type, status
       FROM training_courses WHERE tenant_id = $1`,
      [tenantId]
    );
    if (courses.rows.length > 0) {
      await esService.bulkIndex('training', courses.rows, tenantId);
      logger.info(`[Elasticsearch] Indexed ${courses.rows.length} training courses`);
    }

    logger.info('[Elasticsearch] Background indexing completed');
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('[Elasticsearch] Background indexing error:', error.message);
  }
}

startServer();

require('dotenv').config();

const config = {
  // Application
  app: {
    name: process.env.APP_NAME || '',
    version: process.env.APP_VERSION || '1.0.0',
    env: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',
    port: parseInt(process.env.PORT, 10) || 3000,
    host: process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0',
    url: process.env.APP_URL || 'http://localhost:5173'
  },

  // Database
  database: {
    // Prisma connection (recommended)
    url: process.env.DATABASE_URL || '',
    // Sequelize connection options (alternative - if using Sequelize instead of Prisma)
    host: process.env.DB_HOST || 'localhost',
    port: parseInt(process.env.DB_PORT, 10) || 5432,
    name: process.env.DB_NAME || 'app_db',
    user: process.env.DB_USER || 'postgres',
    password: process.env.DB_PASSWORD || '',
  },

  // JWT Authentication
  jwt: {
    secret: process.env.JWT_SECRET || '',
    expiresIn: process.env.JWT_EXPIRES_IN || '24h',
    refreshExpiresIn: process.env.JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN || '7d'
  },

  // CORS Configuration
  cors: {
    origin: (() => {
      if (!process.env.CORS_ORIGIN) {
        return true; // Allow all origins by default
      }
      
      const allowedOrigins = process.env.CORS_ORIGIN.split(',').map(origin => origin.trim());
      
      // Helper function to normalize URL (remove default ports)
      const normalizeUrl = (urlString) => {
        try {
          const url = new URL(urlString);
          // Remove default ports (443 for https, 80 for http)
          if ((url.protocol === 'https:' && url.port === '443') || 
              (url.protocol === 'http:' && url.port === '80')) {
            url.port = '';
          }
          return url;
        } catch (error) {
          return null;
        }
      };
      
      // Function to check if origin matches allowed origins or their subdomains
      return (origin, callback) => {
        // Allow requests with no origin (e.g., same-origin, Postman)
        if (!origin) {
          return callback(null, true);
        }
        
        // Normalize the request origin
        const normalizedOrigin = normalizeUrl(origin);
        if (!normalizedOrigin) {
          return callback(null, false);
        }
        
        // Check exact match first (with normalization)
        for (const allowedOrigin of allowedOrigins) {
          const normalizedAllowed = normalizeUrl(allowedOrigin);
          if (!normalizedAllowed) continue;
          
          // Exact match (protocol + hostname + port)
          if (normalizedAllowed.protocol === normalizedOrigin.protocol &&
              normalizedAllowed.hostname === normalizedOrigin.hostname &&
              normalizedAllowed.port === normalizedOrigin.port) {
          return callback(null, true);
          }
        }
        
        // Check if origin is a subdomain of any allowed origin
        for (const allowedOrigin of allowedOrigins) {
          try {
            const allowedUrl = normalizeUrl(allowedOrigin);
            if (!allowedUrl) continue;
            
            // Must match protocol
            if (allowedUrl.protocol !== normalizedOrigin.protocol) {
              continue;
            }
            
            // Port matching: if allowed origin has a port, request must match
            // If allowed origin has no port (default), allow any port or no port
            if (allowedUrl.port) {
              if (allowedUrl.port !== normalizedOrigin.port) {
              continue;
              }
            }
            
            // Check if request hostname is the same or a subdomain
            const allowedHostname = allowedUrl.hostname;
            const requestHostname = normalizedOrigin.hostname;
            
            // Exact hostname match
            if (allowedHostname === requestHostname) {
              return callback(null, true);
            }
            
            // Subdomain check: request hostname should end with .allowedHostname
            if (requestHostname.endsWith('.' + allowedHostname)) {
              return callback(null, true);
            }
          } catch (error) {
            // Invalid URL, skip
            continue;
          }
        }
        
        // Origin not allowed
        return callback(null, false);
      };
    })(),
    methods: process.env.CORS_METHODS ? process.env.CORS_METHODS.split(',').map(m => m.trim()) : ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE', 'OPTIONS', 'PATCH'],
    allowedHeaders: process.env.CORS_HEADERS ? process.env.CORS_HEADERS.split(',').map(h => h.trim()) : ['Content-Type', 'Authorization', 'X-Tenant-ID', 'X-Correlation-ID', 'X-API-Key'],
    credentials: process.env.CORS_CREDENTIALS === 'true' || true
  },

  // File Upload
  upload: {
    maxFileSize: parseInt(process.env.MAX_FILE_SIZE, 10) || 10485760, // 10MB
    allowedMimeTypes: process.env.ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES ? process.env.ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES.split(',') : ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'application/pdf'],
    uploadDir: process.env.UPLOAD_DIR || './uploads'
  },

  // Rate Limiting
  rateLimit: {
    windowMs: parseInt(process.env.RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS, 10) || 15 * 60 * 1000, // 15 minutes
    max: parseInt(process.env.RATE_LIMIT_MAX, 10) || 100 // limit each IP to 100 requests per windowMs
  },

  // Logging
  logging: {
    level: process.env.LOG_LEVEL || 'info',
    format: process.env.LOG_FORMAT || 'combined',
    file: process.env.LOG_FILE || './logs/app.log'
  },

  // API
  api: {
    prefix: process.env.API_PREFIX || '/api/v1',
    version: process.env.API_VERSION || 'v1',
    timeout: parseInt(process.env.API_TIMEOUT, 10) || 30000 // 30 seconds
  },

  // External Services

  // Email (if applicable)

  // Redis (if applicable)
};

// Validate required configuration
function validateConfig() {
  const required = [
    'database.url'
  ];

  const missing = required.filter(key => {
    const keys = key.split('.');
    let value = config;
    for (const k of keys) {
      value = value?.[k];
    }
    return !value;
  });

  if (missing.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(`Missing required configuration: ${missing.join(', ')}`);
  }
}

  validateConfig();
}

/**
 * Database Configuration - QAssure Platform
 * Supports both Sequelize and raw SQL queries
 */
require('dotenv').config();
const { Sequelize } = require('sequelize');
const { Pool } = require('pg');

// Get database URL
const databaseUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL;

if (!databaseUrl) {
  console.error('❌ DATABASE_URL not set in .env file');
  process.exit(1);
}

// Sequelize instance for migrations
const sequelize = new Sequelize(databaseUrl, {
  dialect: 'postgres',
  logging: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? console.log : false,
  pool: {
    max: 20,
    min: 0,
    acquire: 30000,
    idle: 10000
  }
});

// Raw pg Pool for direct queries
const pool = new Pool({
  connectionString: databaseUrl,
  max: 20,
  idleTimeoutMillis: 30000,
  connectionTimeoutMillis: 2000,
});

/**
 * Execute raw SQL query
 */
async function query(text, params) {
  const start = Date.now();
  try {
    const result = await pool.query(text, params);
    const duration = Date.now() - start;
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && duration > 100) {
      console.log('[DB] Slow query:', { duration, rows: result.rowCount });
    }
    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[DB] Query error:', error.message);
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Get a client from the pool for transactions
 */
async function getClient() {
  return pool.connect();
}

/**
 * Execute transaction
 */
async function transaction(callback) {
  const client = await getClient();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');
    const result = await callback(client);
    await client.query('COMMIT');
    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    throw error;
  } finally {
    client.release();
  }
}

/**
 * Test database connection
 */
async function testConnection() {
  try {
    const result = await pool.query('SELECT NOW() as now');
    console.log('✅ Database connected:', result.rows[0].now);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Database connection failed:', error.message);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Close all connections
 */
async function close() {
  await pool.end();
  await sequelize.close();
  console.log('✅ Database connections closed');
}

// Handle graceful shutdown
process.on('SIGINT', async () => {
  await close();
  process.exit(0);
});

process.on('SIGTERM', async () => {
  await close();
  process.exit(0);
});

module.exports = {
  sequelize,
  pool,
  query,
  getClient,
  transaction,
  testConnection,
  close
};


========== FILE: ./src/config/logger.js ==========
const winston = require('winston');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const config = require('./config');

// Create logs directory if it doesn't exist
const logsDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'logs');
if (!fs.existsSync(logsDir)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(logsDir, { recursive: true });
}

// Define log format for file output
const fileLogFormat = winston.format.combine(
  winston.format.timestamp({ format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss' }),
  winston.format.errors({ stack: true }),
  winston.format.splat(),
  winston.format.json()
);

// Console format for development
const consoleFormat = winston.format.combine(
  winston.format.colorize(),
  winston.format.timestamp({ format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss' }),
  winston.format.printf(({ timestamp, level, message, stack }) => {
    return `${timestamp} [${level}]: ${stack || message}`;
  })
);

// Get log configuration from environment or config
const logLevel = process.env.LOG_LEVEL || config.logging.level || 'info';
const logFormatType = process.env.LOG_FORMAT || config.logging.format || 'combined';
const logFile = process.env.LOG_FILE || config.logging.file || path.join(logsDir, 'app.log');

// Create logger instance
// Note: File transports always use JSON format for structured logging
// logFormatType is used for console output formatting
const logger = winston.createLogger({
  level: logLevel,
  format: fileLogFormat,
  defaultMeta: { service: config.app.name },
  transports: [
    // Write all logs with importance level of `error` or less to `error.log`
    new winston.transports.File({
      filename: path.join(logsDir, 'error.log'),
      level: 'error',
      maxsize: 5242880, // 5MB
      maxFiles: 5,
    }),
    // Write all logs with importance level of `info` or less to combined log file
    new winston.transports.File({
      filename: logFile,
      maxsize: 5242880, // 5MB
      maxFiles: 5,
    }),
  ],
});

// If we're not in production, log to the console as well
if (config.app.env !== 'production') {
  logger.add(
    new winston.transports.Console({
      format: consoleFormat,
    })
  );
}

module.exports = logger;

const aicompletionService = require('../services/ai_completion_service');
const { 
  CreateAicompletionSchema, 
  UpdateAicompletionSchema,
  AicompletionParamsSchema 
} = require('../validation/ai_completion.schema');

class AicompletionController {
  /**
   * Get all aicompletions
   * GET /api/v1/aicompletions
   */
  async findAll(req, res) {
    try {
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, ...filters } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
      
      const result = await aicompletionService.findAll({
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        where: filters,
        orderBy: [['created_at', 'DESC']]
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: result.hasMore
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: error.message
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get aicompletion by ID
   * GET /api/v1/aicompletions/:id
   */
  async findById(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = AicompletionParamsSchema.parse(req.params);
      
      const aicompletion = await aicompletionService.findById(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: aicompletion
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create new aicompletion
   * POST /api/v1/aicompletions
   */
  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      const validatedData = CreateAicompletionSchema.parse(req.body);
      
      const aicompletion = await aicompletionService.create(validatedData);

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: aicompletion,
        message: 'Aicompletion created successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.name === 'ZodError') {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Validation error',
          details: error.errors
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update aicompletion
   * PUT /api/v1/aicompletions/:id
   */
  async update(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = AicompletionParamsSchema.parse(req.params);
      const validatedData = UpdateAicompletionSchema.parse(req.body);
      
      const aicompletion = await aicompletionService.update(id, validatedData);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: aicompletion,
        message: 'Aicompletion updated successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else if (error.name === 'ZodError') {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Validation error',
          details: error.errors
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Delete aicompletion
   * DELETE /api/v1/aicompletions/:id
   */
  async delete(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = AicompletionParamsSchema.parse(req.params);
      
      await aicompletionService.delete(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        message: 'Aicompletion deleted successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Generate AI completion
   * POST /api/v1/ai/completions
   */
  async createCompletion(req, res) {
    try {

      // Validate request body
      const bodySchema = CreateAicompletionSchema;
      const validatedData = bodySchema.parse(req.body);
      
      // Custom endpoint handler
      // Build service method call with parameters in correct order
      const result = await aicompletionService.createCompletion(validatedData);
      
      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,

const aiprompttemplateService = require('../services/ai_prompt_template_service');
const { 
  CreateAiprompttemplateSchema, 
  UpdateAiprompttemplateSchema,
  AiprompttemplateParamsSchema 
} = require('../validation/ai_prompt_template.schema');

class AiprompttemplateController {
  /**
   * Get all aiprompttemplates
   * GET /api/v1/aiprompttemplates
   */
  async findAll(req, res) {
    try {
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, ...filters } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
      
      const result = await aiprompttemplateService.findAll({
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        where: filters,
        orderBy: [['created_at', 'DESC']]
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: result.hasMore
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: error.message
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get aiprompttemplate by ID
   * GET /api/v1/aiprompttemplates/:id
   */
  async findById(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = AiprompttemplateParamsSchema.parse(req.params);
      
      const aiprompttemplate = await aiprompttemplateService.findById(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: aiprompttemplate
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create new aiprompttemplate
   * POST /api/v1/aiprompttemplates
   */
  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      const validatedData = CreateAiprompttemplateSchema.parse(req.body);
      
      const aiprompttemplate = await aiprompttemplateService.create(validatedData);

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: aiprompttemplate,
        message: 'Aiprompttemplate created successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.name === 'ZodError') {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Validation error',
          details: error.errors
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update aiprompttemplate
   * PUT /api/v1/aiprompttemplates/:id
   */
  async update(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = AiprompttemplateParamsSchema.parse(req.params);
      const validatedData = UpdateAiprompttemplateSchema.parse(req.body);
      
      const aiprompttemplate = await aiprompttemplateService.update(id, validatedData);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: aiprompttemplate,
        message: 'Aiprompttemplate updated successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else if (error.name === 'ZodError') {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Validation error',
          details: error.errors
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Delete aiprompttemplate
   * DELETE /api/v1/aiprompttemplates/:id
   */
  async delete(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = AiprompttemplateParamsSchema.parse(req.params);
      
      await aiprompttemplateService.delete(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        message: 'Aiprompttemplate deleted successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({

        });

/**
 * AI Controller - QAssure Platform
 * HTTP handlers for AI endpoints
 */
const { getAIService } = require('../services/ai.service');

const aiService = getAIService();

/**
 * Create a completion
 * POST /api/v1/ai/completions
 */
const createCompletion = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { messages, model, provider, temperature, max_tokens, top_p, stop } = req.body;

    if (!messages || !Array.isArray(messages) || messages.length === 0) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'INVALID_INPUT',
          message: 'messages array is required and cannot be empty'
        }
      });
    }

    const result = await aiService.createCompletion(
      { messages, model, provider, temperature, max_tokens, top_p, stop },
      {
        userId: req.user?.id,
        tenantId: req.user?.tenantId,
        correlationId: req.correlationId
      }
    );

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: result
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[AIController] createCompletion error:', error.message);
    
    const statusCode = error.code === 'RATE_LIMITED' ? 429 :
                       error.code === 'AUTH_FAILED' ? 401 :
                       error.code === 'NO_PROVIDERS' ? 503 : 500;

    res.status(statusCode).json({
      success: false,
      error: {
        code: error.code || 'AI_ERROR',
        message: error.message,
        provider: error.provider
      }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Get completion by ID
 * GET /api/v1/ai/completions/:id
 */
const getCompletion = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { id } = req.params;
    const tenantId = req.user?.tenantId;

    const completion = await aiService.getCompletion(id, tenantId);

    if (!completion) {
      return res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'NOT_FOUND',
          message: 'Completion not found'
        }
      });
    }

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: completion
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[AIController] getCompletion error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * List completions
 * GET /api/v1/ai/completions
 */
const listCompletions = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const tenantId = req.user?.tenantId;
    const {
      page = 1,
      limit = 20,
      provider,
      model,
      user_id,
      start_date,
      end_date,
      status
    } = req.query;

    const result = await aiService.listCompletions(tenantId, {
      page: parseInt(page),
      limit: Math.min(parseInt(limit), 100),
      provider,
      model,
      userId: user_id,
      startDate: start_date,
      endDate: end_date,
      status
    });

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      ...result
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[AIController] listCompletions error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

/**

const getProviders = async (req, res) => {

/**
 * Playground - test prompts without saving
 * POST /api/v1/ai/playground
 */
const playground = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { messages, model, provider, temperature, max_tokens } = req.body;

    if (!messages || !Array.isArray(messages) || messages.length === 0) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'INVALID_INPUT',
          message: 'messages array is required'
        }
      });
    }

    // Use gateway directly without tracking
    const { getAIGateway } = require('../infrastructure/ai/gateway.service');
    const gateway = getAIGateway();
    await gateway.initialize();

    const result = await gateway.createCompletion({
      messages,
      model,
      provider,
      temperature,
      max_tokens
    });

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: {
        content: result.content,
        provider: result.provider,
        model: result.model,
        usage: result.usage,
        cost: result.cost,
        latency_ms: result.latency_ms
      }
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[AIController] playground error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: {
        code: error.code || 'AI_ERROR',
        message: error.message
      }
    });
  }
};

module.exports = {
  createCompletion,
  getCompletion,
  listCompletions,
  getProviders,
  getProviderHealth,
  getHealthStatus,
  getModels,
  getCostSummary,
  playground
};

   * Get all apikeies
   * GET /api/v1/apikeies
   */
  async findAll(req, res) {
    try {
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, ...filters } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
      
      const result = await apikeyService.findAll({
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        where: filters,
        orderBy: [['created_at', 'DESC']]
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: result.hasMore
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: error.message
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get apikey by ID
   * GET /api/v1/apikeies/:id
   */
  async findById(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = ApikeyParamsSchema.parse(req.params);
      
      const apikey = await apikeyService.findById(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: apikey
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create new apikey
   * POST /api/v1/apikeies
   */
  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      const validatedData = CreateApikeySchema.parse(req.body);
      
      const apikey = await apikeyService.create(validatedData);

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: apikey,
        message: 'Apikey created successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.name === 'ZodError') {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Validation error',
          details: error.errors
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

   * Update apikey

   */
  async update(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = ApikeyParamsSchema.parse(req.params);
      const validatedData = UpdateApikeySchema.parse(req.body);
      
      const apikey = await apikeyService.update(id, validatedData);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: apikey,
        message: 'Apikey updated successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else if (error.name === 'ZodError') {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Validation error',
          details: error.errors
        });
      } else {

        });
      }

      }

========== FILE: ./src/controllers/api_key.controller.js ==========
/**
 * API Key Controller - QAssure Platform
 * Handles API key management endpoints
 */
const { getApiKeyService } = require('../services/api_key.service');

class ApiKeyController {
  constructor() {
    this.apiKeyService = getApiKeyService();
  }

  /**
   * POST /api/v1/api-keys
   * Create new API key
   */
  create = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      // req.body is already validated and transformed by validateCreate middleware
      const { name, description, permissions, expires_at } = req.body;

      const result = await this.apiKeyService.create(
        { name, description, permissions, expires_at },
        req.user.id,
        req.user.tenantId
      );

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/api-keys
   * List API keys
   */
  list = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { page = 1, limit = 20, status } = req.query;

      const result = await this.apiKeyService.list(req.user.tenantId, {
        page: parseInt(page),
        limit: parseInt(limit),
        status
      });

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: result.pagination
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/api-keys/:id
   * Get API key by ID
   */
  getById = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware

      const apiKey = await this.apiKeyService.getById(id, req.user.tenantId);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: apiKey
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * PUT /api/v1/api-keys/:id
   * Update API key
   */
  update = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware
      // req.body is already validated and transformed by validateUpdate middleware
      const { name, description, status } = req.body;

      const result = await this.apiKeyService.update(id, req.user.tenantId, {
        name,
        description,
        status
      });

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result,
        message: 'API key updated successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * POST /api/v1/api-keys/:id/revoke
   * Revoke API key
   */
  revoke = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware

      const result = await this.apiKeyService.revoke(id, req.user.tenantId);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * DELETE /api/v1/api-keys/:id
   * Delete API key permanently
   */
  delete = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware

      const result = await this.apiKeyService.delete(id, req.user.tenantId);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * POST /api/v1/api-keys/:id/regenerate
   * Regenerate API key
   */
  regenerate = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware

      const result = await this.apiKeyService.regenerate(id, req.user.tenantId);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * POST /api/v1/api-keys/validate
   * Validate an API key (for testing)
   */
  validate = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      // req.body is already validated and transformed by validateKey middleware
      const { key } = req.body;

      const result = await this.apiKeyService.validate(key);

      if (!result.valid) {
        return res.status(401).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            code: 'INVALID_API_KEY',
            message: result.error
          }
        });
      }

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          valid: true,
          key_id: result.apiKey.id,
          name: result.apiKey.name,
          tenant_id: result.apiKey.tenantId
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * Handle errors
   */
  _handleError(res, error) {
    console.error('[ApiKeyController] Error:', error);

    if (error.message === 'API key not found') {
      return res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'NOT_FOUND',
          message: error.message
        }
      });
    }

    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: {
        code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
        message: error.message || 'An unexpected error occurred'
      }
    });
  }
}

module.exports = new ApiKeyController();


========== FILE: ./src/controllers/audit_log_controller.js ==========
const auditlogService = require('../services/audit_log_service');
const { formatError, getErrorStatusCode } = require('../utils/errorFormatter');

class AuditlogController {
  /**
   * Get all auditlogs
   * GET /api/v1/auditlogs
   */
  async findAll(req, res) {
    try {
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, orderBy = ['created_at', 'DESC'], ...filters } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

      const result = await auditlogService.findAll({
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        where: filters,
        orderBy: [orderBy],
        include: [
          {
            association: 'user',
            attributes: ['id', 'email', 'first_name', 'last_name']
          },
          {
            association: 'tenant',
            attributes: ['id', 'name']
          }
        ]
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: result.hasMore
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get auditlog by ID
   * GET /api/v1/auditlogs/:id
   */
  async findById(req, res) {
    try {
      const auditlog = await auditlogService.findById(req.params.id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: auditlog
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create new auditlog
   * POST /api/v1/auditlogs
   */
  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      // Auto-populate correlation_id from request context if not provided
      if (!req.body.correlation_id && req.correlationId) {
        req.body.correlation_id = req.correlationId;
      }

      const auditlog = await auditlogService.create(req.body);

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: auditlog,
        message: 'Auditlog created successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse,
        ...(error.errors && { details: error.errors }),
        ...(error.issues && { details: error.issues })
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update auditlog
   * PUT /api/v1/auditlogs/:id
   */
  async update(req, res) {
    try {
      const auditlog = await auditlogService.update(req.params.id, req.body);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: auditlog,
        message: 'Auditlog updated successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse,
        ...(error.errors && { details: error.errors }),
        ...(error.issues && { details: error.issues })
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Delete auditlog
   * DELETE /api/v1/auditlogs/:id
   */
  async delete(req, res) {
    try {
      await auditlogService.delete(req.params.id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        message: 'Auditlog deleted successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get audit log details
   * GET /api/v1/audit/logs/:logId
   */
  async findOne(req, res) {
    try {
      const result = await auditlogService.findOne(req.params.logId);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Export audit logs
   * GET /api/v1/audit/logs/export
   */
  async export(req, res) {
    try {
      const queryParams = {
        format: req.query.format,
        tenantId: req.query.tenantId || undefined,
        startDate: req.query.startDate,
        endDate: req.query.endDate,
      };

      const result = await auditlogService.export(queryParams);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse

/**
 * Auth Controller - QAssure Platform
 * Handles authentication HTTP requests
 */
const { getAuthService, AuthError } = require('../services/auth.service');
const { formatError, getErrorStatusCode } = require('../utils/errorFormatter');

class AuthController {
  constructor() {
    this.authService = getAuthService();
  }

  /**
   * POST /auth/register
   * Register new user
   */
  register = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { email, password, first_name, last_name, firstName, lastName, tenant_id } = req.body;
      
      // Support both camelCase and snake_case
      const finalFirstName = first_name || firstName;
      const finalLastName = last_name || lastName;

      const result = await this.authService.register({
        email,
        password,
        first_name: finalFirstName,
        last_name: finalLastName,
        tenant_id
      });

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * POST /auth/verify-email
   * Verify email with token
   */
  verifyEmail = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { token } = req.body;

      const result = await this.authService.verifyEmail(token);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * POST /auth/resend-verification
   * Resend verification email
   */
  resendVerification = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { email } = req.body;

      const result = await this.authService.resendVerification(email);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * POST /auth/forgot-password
   * Request password reset
   */
  forgotPassword = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { email } = req.body;

      const result = await this.authService.forgotPassword(email);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * POST /auth/reset-password
   * Reset password with token
   */
  resetPassword = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { token, password } = req.body;

      const result = await this.authService.resetPassword(token, password);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * POST /auth/change-password
   * Change password (authenticated)
   */
  changePassword = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { current_password, new_password } = req.body;

      const result = await this.authService.changePassword(
        req.user.id,
        current_password,
        new_password
      );

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * POST /auth/login
   * Login with email and password
   */
  login = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { email, password, tenant_id } = req.body;

      const result = await this.authService.login(email, password, tenant_id);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          user: result.user,
          tenant_id: result.tenantId,
          tenant: result.tenant || null,
          roles: result.roles,
          permissions: result.permissions || [],
          access_token: result.accessToken,
          refresh_token: result.refreshToken,
          token_type: result.tokenType,
          expires_in: result.expiresIn,
          expires_at: result.expiresAt
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * POST /auth/refresh
   * Refresh access token
   */
  refresh = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { refresh_token } = req.body;

      const result = await this.authService.refreshToken(refresh_token);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          access_token: result.accessToken,
          refresh_token: result.refreshToken,
          token_type: result.tokenType,
          expires_in: result.expiresIn,
          expires_at: result.expiresAt
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * POST /auth/logout
   * Logout current session
   */
  logout = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      await this.authService.logout(req.user.sessionId, req.user.id);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        message: 'Logged out successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * POST /auth/logout-all
   * Logout from all sessions
   */
  logoutAll = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      await this.authService.logoutAll(req.user.id);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        message: 'Logged out from all sessions'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * GET /auth/me
   * Get current user info
   */
  me = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          user: {
            id: req.user.id,
            email: req.user.email,
            tenant_id: req.user.tenantId,
            roles: req.user.roles,
            permissions: req.user.permissions
          },
          session: {
            id: req.user.sessionId
          }
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * GET /auth/sessions
   * Get user's active sessions
   */
  sessions = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const sessions = await this.authService.getActiveSessions(req.user.id);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          sessions,
          current_session_id: req.user.sessionId
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * DELETE /auth/sessions/:sessionId
   * Revoke a specific session
   */
  revokeSession = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { sessionId } = req.params;

      await this.authService.logout(sessionId, req.user.id);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        message: 'Session revoked successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * POST /auth/validate
   * Validate current token/session
   */
  validate = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const sessionValid = await this.authService.validateSession(
        req.user.sessionId,
        req.user.id
      );

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          valid: sessionValid.valid,
          user_id: req.user.id,
          tenant_id: req.user.tenantId,
          session: sessionValid.session
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * Handle errors consistently
   */
  _handleError(res, error) {
    console.error('[AuthController] Error:', error);
    const errorResponse = formatError(error);
    res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
      success: false,
      error: errorResponse,
      ...(error.errors && { details: error.errors }),
      ...(error.issues && { details: error.issues })
    });
  }
}

module.exports = new AuthController();

const { getBillingService } = require('../services/billing.service');

class BillingController {

  // =====================================================
  // PRICING PLANS
  // =====================================================

  /**
   * Get all pricing plans
   * GET /api/v1/billing/pricing-plans
   */
  async getPricingPlans(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getBillingService();
      const options = {
        application: req.query.application,
        tier: req.query.tier,
        is_active: req.query.is_active !== 'false',
        is_public: req.query.is_public === 'true' ? true : undefined
      };

      const plans = await service.getPricingPlans(options);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: plans
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Billing] GetPricingPlans error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get pricing plan by ID
   * GET /api/v1/billing/pricing-plans/:id
   */
  async getPricingPlanById(req, res) {
    try {

      if (!plan) {
        return res.status(404).json({
          success: false,

        });

        success: true,
