/**
 * CAPA Controller
 * Handles CAPA management API endpoints
 */

const { getCapaService } = require('../services/capa.service');

class CapaController {

  // ============================================================================
  // CAPA CRUD
  // ============================================================================

  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getCapaService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const createdBy = req.user.id;

      const { title, capa_type } = req.body;
      if (!title || !capa_type) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'title and capa_type are required' }
        });
      }

      const capa = await service.create(tenantId, req.body, createdBy);
      res.status(201).json({ success: true, data: capa });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[CAPA] Create error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'CREATE_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  async list(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getCapaService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { status, capa_type, priority, owner_id, source, search, limit, offset } = req.query;

      const result = await service.list(tenantId, {
        status, capa_type, priority, owner_id, source, search,
        limit: parseInt(limit) || 50,
        offset: parseInt(offset) || 0
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.capas,
        pagination: { total: result.total, limit: result.limit, offset: result.offset }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[CAPA] List error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  async getById(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getCapaService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { id } = req.params;

      const capa = await service.getById(id, tenantId);
      if (!capa) {
        return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'CAPA not found' } });
      }

      res.json({ success: true, data: capa });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[CAPA] Get error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  async update(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getCapaService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const updatedBy = req.user.id;
      const { id } = req.params;

      const capa = await service.update(id, tenantId, req.body, updatedBy);
      res.json({ success: true, data: capa });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[CAPA] Update error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'UPDATE_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // WORKFLOW ACTIONS
  // ============================================================================

  async submit(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getCapaService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const submittedBy = req.user.id;
      const { id } = req.params;

      const capa = await service.submitForInvestigation(id, tenantId, submittedBy);
      res.json({ success: true, data: capa });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[CAPA] Submit error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'SUBMIT_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  async updateStatus(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getCapaService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const updatedBy = req.user.id;
      const { id } = req.params;
      const { status } = req.body;

      if (!status) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'status is required' }
        });
      }

      const capa = await service.updateStatus(id, tenantId, status, updatedBy);
      res.json({ success: true, data: capa });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[CAPA] Status update error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'UPDATE_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // CAPA ACTIONS
  // ============================================================================

  async getActions(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getCapaService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { id } = req.params;

      const actions = await service.getActions(id, tenantId);
      res.json({ success: true, data: actions });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[CAPA] Get actions error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  async addAction(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getCapaService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const createdBy = req.user.id;
      const { id } = req.params;

      const { description, action_type } = req.body;
      if (!description || !action_type) {
        return res.status(400).json({

        });
      }

      res.status(201).json({ success: true, data: action });

      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'CREATE_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  async updateAction(req, res) {

      const updatedBy = req.user.id;
      const { id, actionId } = req.params;

      const action = await service.updateAction(actionId, tenantId, req.body, updatedBy);
      res.json({ success: true, data: action });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[CAPA] Update action error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'UPDATE_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // 8D REPORT
  // ============================================================================

  async get8DReport(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getCapaService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { id } = req.params;

      const report = await service.get8DReport(id, tenantId);
      if (!report) {
        return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: '8D Report not found' } });
      }

      res.json({ success: true, data: report });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[CAPA] Get 8D error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  async update8DSection(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getCapaService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const updatedBy = req.user.id;
      const { id, section } = req.params;

      const report = await service.update8DSection(id, tenantId, section, req.body, updatedBy);
      res.json({ success: true, data: report });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[CAPA] Update 8D section error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'UPDATE_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // DASHBOARD
  // ============================================================================

  async getDashboard(req, res) {
    try {

/**

const dashboardService = require('../services/dashboard.service');
const { formatError, getErrorStatusCode } = require('../utils/errorFormatter');

class DashboardController {
  /**
   * Get dashboard statistics
   * GET /api/v1/dashboard/statistics
   * Super admin only
   */
  async getStatistics(req, res) {
    try {
      const statistics = await dashboardService.getStatistics();

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: statistics
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse
      });
    }
  }
}

const { getDocumentService } = require('../services/document.service');

class DocumentController {

  /**
   * POST /api/v1/documents
   */
  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getDocumentService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const createdBy = req.user.id;

      const { title, document_type } = req.body;

      if (!title || !document_type) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'title and document_type are required' }
        });
      }

      const document = await service.create(tenantId, req.body, createdBy);

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: document
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Document] Create error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'CREATE_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/documents
   */
  async list(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getDocumentService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { status, category_id, document_type, owner_id, search, limit, offset } = req.query;

      const result = await service.list(tenantId, {
        status,
        category_id,
        document_type,
        owner_id,
        search,
        limit: parseInt(limit) || 50,
        offset: parseInt(offset) || 0
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.documents,
        pagination: {
          total: result.total,
          limit: result.limit,
          offset: result.offset
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Document] List error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

/**
 * Electronic Signature Controller
 * FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Compliant Electronic Signatures
 */

const { getElectronicSignatureService, SIGNATURE_ACTIONS } = require('../services/electronic-signature.service');

class ElectronicSignatureController {
  
  /**
   * POST /api/v1/electronic-signatures/sign
   * Create an electronic signature
   */
  async sign(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getElectronicSignatureService();
      const userId = req.user.id;
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;

      const {
        resource_type,
        resource_id,
        resource_name,
        action,
        meaning,
        password,
        pin,
        auth_method,
        signature_order,
        required_signatures,
        workflow_id
      } = req.body;

      const signature = await service.sign({
        userId,
        tenantId,
        resourceType: resource_type,
        resourceId: resource_id,
        resourceName: resource_name,
        action,
        meaning,
        password,
        pin,
        authMethod: auth_method,
        signatureOrder: signature_order,
        requiredSignatures: required_signatures,
        workflowId: workflow_id,
        ipAddress: req.ip,
        userAgent: req.get('User-Agent'),
        deviceInfo: {
          browser: req.get('User-Agent'),
          platform: req.get('Sec-CH-UA-Platform')
        }
      });

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: signature
      });

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[ElectronicSignature] Sign error:', error.message);
      
      // Handle specific errors
      if (error.message.includes('Invalid password') || error.message.includes('Invalid signature PIN')) {
        return res.status(401).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            code: 'AUTHENTICATION_FAILED',
            message: error.message
          }
        });
      }

      if (error.message.includes('already signed')) {
        return res.status(409).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            code: 'DUPLICATE_SIGNATURE',
            message: error.message
          }
        });
      }

      if (error.message.includes('PIN not set')) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            code: 'PIN_NOT_SET',
            message: error.message
          }
        });
      }

      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'SIGNATURE_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * POST /api/v1/electronic-signatures/verify
   * Verify a signature is valid
   */
  async verify(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getElectronicSignatureService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { signature_id } = req.body;

      const result = await service.verify(signature_id, tenantId);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[ElectronicSignature] Verify error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'VERIFICATION_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/electronic-signatures/resource/:resourceType/:resourceId
   * Get signatures for a resource
   */
  async getResourceSignatures(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getElectronicSignatureService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { resourceType, resourceId } = req.params;

      const signatures = await service.getResourceSignatures(resourceType, resourceId, tenantId);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          resource: {
            type: resourceType,
            id: resourceId
          },
          signatures,
          count: signatures.length
        }
      });

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[ElectronicSignature] Get resource signatures error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'FETCH_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/electronic-signatures/history
   * Get current user's signature history
   */
  async getUserHistory(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getElectronicSignatureService();
      const userId = req.user.id;
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;

      const { limit, offset, resource_type, action, start_date, end_date } = req.query;

      const result = await service.getUserSignatures(userId, tenantId, {
        limit: parseInt(limit) || 50,
        offset: parseInt(offset) || 0,
        resourceType: resource_type,
        action,
        startDate: start_date,
        endDate: end_date
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.signatures,
        pagination: {
          total: result.total,
          limit: result.limit,
          offset: result.offset
        }
      });

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[ElectronicSignature] Get history error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'FETCH_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/electronic-signatures/:id
   * Get a specific signature
   */
  async getSignature(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getElectronicSignatureService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { id } = req.params;

      const result = await service.verify(id, tenantId);

      if (!result.valid && result.reason === 'Signature not found') {
        return res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            code: 'NOT_FOUND',
            message: 'Signature not found'
          }
        });
      }

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[ElectronicSignature] Get signature error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'FETCH_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * POST /api/v1/electronic-signatures/:id/invalidate
   * Invalidate a signature (super_admin only)
   */
  async invalidate(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getElectronicSignatureService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const invalidatedBy = req.user.id;
      const { id } = req.params;
      const { reason } = req.body;

      const result = await service.invalidate(id, tenantId, invalidatedBy, reason);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          message: 'Signature invalidated successfully',
          signature_id: id,
          invalidated_at: result.invalidated_at
        }
      });

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[ElectronicSignature] Invalidate error:', error.message);

      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        return res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            code: 'NOT_FOUND',
            message: error.message
          }
        });
      }

      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'INVALIDATION_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * POST /api/v1/electronic-signatures/pin
   * Set or update signature PIN
   */
  async setPin(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getElectronicSignatureService();
      const userId = req.user.id;
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { password, pin } = req.body;

      const result = await service.setPin(userId, tenantId, password, pin);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[ElectronicSignature] Set PIN error:', error.message);

      if (error.message.includes('Invalid password')) {
        return res.status(401).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            code: 'AUTHENTICATION_FAILED',
            message: error.message
          }
        });
      }

      if (error.message.includes('PIN must be')) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
            message: error.message
          }
        });
      }

      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'PIN_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/electronic-signatures/workflow/:workflowId/status
   * Check workflow completion status
   */
  async getWorkflowStatus(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getElectronicSignatureService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { workflowId } = req.params;

      const result = await service.checkWorkflowComplete(workflowId, tenantId);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          workflow_id: workflowId,
          complete: result.complete,
          current_signatures: result.current,
          required_signatures: result.required,
          remaining: result.required ? result.required - result.current : null
        }
      });

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[ElectronicSignature] Workflow status error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'FETCH_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/electronic-signatures/statistics
   * Get signature statistics for compliance reporting
   */
  async getStatistics(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getElectronicSignatureService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { start_date, end_date } = req.query;

      const stats = await service.getStatistics(tenantId, {
        startDate: start_date,
        endDate: end_date
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: stats
      });

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[ElectronicSignature] Statistics error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'STATISTICS_ERROR',
          message: error.message
        }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/electronic-signatures/actions
   * Get available signature actions
   */
  async getActions(req, res) {
    res.json({
      success: true,

      }

  }
}

========== FILE: ./src/controllers/event_log_controller.js ==========
const eventlogService = require('../services/event_log_service');

class EventlogController {
  /**
   * Get all eventlogs
   * GET /api/v1/eventlogs
   */
  async findAll(req, res) {
    try {
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, ...filters } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
      
      const result = await eventlogService.findAll({
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        where: filters,
        orderBy: [['created_at', 'DESC']]
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: result.hasMore
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: error.message
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get eventlog by ID
   * GET /api/v1/eventlogs/:id
   */
  async findById(req, res) {
    try {
      const eventlog = await eventlogService.findById(req.params.id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: eventlog
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,

========== FILE: ./src/controllers/file-attachment.controller.js ==========
/**
 * File Attachment Controller
 * Handles file upload, download, and management endpoints
 */

const { getFileAttachmentService } = require('../services/file-attachment.service');
const path = require('path');

class FileAttachmentController {

  // ============================================================================
  // UPLOAD
  // ============================================================================

  async upload(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getFileAttachmentService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const uploadedBy = req.user.id;
      const { entity_type, entity_id, category, description, tags } = req.body;

      if (!req.file) {
        return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'NO_FILE', message: 'No file uploaded' } });
      }

      if (!entity_type || !entity_id) {
        return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'entity_type and entity_id are required' } });
      }

      const attachment = await service.upload(
        tenantId,
        req.file,
        entity_type,
        entity_id,
        { category, description, tags: tags ? tags.split(',').map(t => t.trim()) : [] },
        uploadedBy
      );

      res.status(201).json({ success: true, data: attachment });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[FileAttachment] Upload error:', error.message);
      res.status(error.message.includes('quota') || error.message.includes('allowed') ? 400 : 500).json({
        success: false, error: { code: 'UPLOAD_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  async uploadMultiple(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getFileAttachmentService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const uploadedBy = req.user.id;
      const { entity_type, entity_id, category, description } = req.body;

      if (!req.files || req.files.length === 0) {
        return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'NO_FILES', message: 'No files uploaded' } });
      }

      if (!entity_type || !entity_id) {
        return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'entity_type and entity_id are required' } });
      }

      const attachments = await service.uploadMultiple(
        tenantId,
        req.files,
        entity_type,
        entity_id,
        { category, description },
        uploadedBy
      );

      res.status(201).json({ success: true, data: attachments });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[FileAttachment] Upload multiple error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'UPLOAD_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Simple upload endpoint - accepts any file and returns browser-accessible URL
   * No database storage - just saves file and returns URL
   */
  async simpleUpload(req, res) {
    try {
      const fs = require('fs');
      const { v4: uuidv4 } = require('uuid');
      const uploadDir = process.env.UPLOAD_DIR || path.join(process.cwd(), 'uploads');
      const { folder } = req.body; // Optional folder name (e.g., 'images', 'documents')

      if (!req.file) {
        return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'NO_FILE', message: 'No file uploaded' } });
      }

      // Validate file size (100MB max)
      const maxSize = 100 * 1024 * 1024; // 100 MB
      if (req.file.size > maxSize) {
        return res.status(400).json({ 
          success: false, 
          error: { code: 'FILE_TOO_LARGE', message: 'File size exceeds 100MB limit' } 
        });
      }

      // Use 'general' as default folder for simple uploads
      const folderName = folder || 'general';
      const ext = path.extname(req.file.originalname).toLowerCase();
      const storedName = `${uuidv4()}${ext}`;
      const folderPath = path.join(uploadDir, folderName);
      const filePath = path.join(folderPath, storedName);
      const relativePath = `${folderName}/${storedName}`;

      // Ensure the folder directory exists
      if (!fs.existsSync(folderPath)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(folderPath, { recursive: true });
      }

      // Save file
      fs.writeFileSync(filePath, req.file.buffer);

      // Construct browser-accessible URL with API prefix
      const baseUrl = req.protocol + '://' + req.get('host');
      const apiPrefix = process.env.API_PREFIX || '/api/v1';
      const fileUrl = `${baseUrl}${apiPrefix}/uploads/${relativePath}`;

      // Format file size
      const formatFileSize = (bytes) => {
        if (bytes === 0) return '0 Bytes';
        const k = 1024;
        const sizes = ['Bytes', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
        const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
        return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2)) + ' ' + sizes[i];
      };

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          original_name: req.file.originalname,
          file_path: relativePath,
          file_url: fileUrl,
          mime_type: req.file.mimetype,
          file_size: req.file.size,
          file_size_formatted: formatFileSize(req.file.size),
          uploaded_at: new Date().toISOString()
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[FileAttachment] Simple upload error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'UPLOAD_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // RETRIEVE
  // ============================================================================

  async getById(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getFileAttachmentService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { id } = req.params;

      const attachment = await service.getById(id, tenantId);
      if (!attachment) {
        return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'File not found' } });
      }

      res.json({ success: true, data: attachment });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[FileAttachment] Get error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  async getByEntity(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getFileAttachmentService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { entity_type, entity_id } = req.params;
      const { category, limit, offset } = req.query;

      const attachments = await service.getByEntity(entity_type, entity_id, tenantId, {
        category,
        limit: parseInt(limit) || 100,
        offset: parseInt(offset) || 0
      });

      res.json({ success: true, data: attachments });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[FileAttachment] Get by entity error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  async list(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getFileAttachmentService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { entity_type, mime_type, category, search, limit, offset } = req.query;

      const attachments = await service.list(tenantId, {
        entity_type,
        mime_type,
        category,
        search,
        limit: parseInt(limit) || 50,
        offset: parseInt(offset) || 0
      });

      res.json({ success: true, data: attachments });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[FileAttachment] List error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // DOWNLOAD
  // ============================================================================

  async download(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getFileAttachmentService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const userId = req.user.id;
      const { id } = req.params;

      const { path: filePath, attachment } = await service.getFilePath(id, tenantId, userId);

      res.setHeader('Content-Type', attachment.mime_type);
      res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename="${encodeURIComponent(attachment.original_name)}"`);
      res.setHeader('Content-Length', attachment.file_size);

      res.sendFile(filePath);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[FileAttachment] Download error:', error.message);
      res.status(error.message === 'File not found' ? 404 : 500).json({
        success: false, error: { code: 'DOWNLOAD_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  async preview(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getFileAttachmentService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const userId = req.user.id;
      const { id } = req.params;

      const { path: filePath, attachment } = await service.getFilePath(id, tenantId, userId);

      // For preview, show inline instead of download
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', attachment.mime_type);
      res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', `inline; filename="${encodeURIComponent(attachment.original_name)}"`);

      res.sendFile(filePath);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[FileAttachment] Preview error:', error.message);
      res.status(error.message === 'File not found' ? 404 : 500).json({
        success: false, error: { code: 'PREVIEW_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // DELETE
  // ============================================================================

  async delete(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getFileAttachmentService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { id } = req.params;
      const { hard } = req.query;

      const deleted = await service.delete(id, tenantId, hard === 'true');
      if (!deleted) {
        return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'File not found' } });
      }

      res.json({ success: true, data: { message: 'File deleted' } });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[FileAttachment] Delete error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'DELETE_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // SHARING
  // ============================================================================

  async createShare(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getFileAttachmentService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const createdBy = req.user.id;
      const { id } = req.params;

      const share = await service.createShare(id, tenantId, req.body, createdBy);
      res.status(201).json({ success: true, data: share });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[FileAttachment] Create share error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'SHARE_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  async accessSharedFile(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getFileAttachmentService();
      const { token } = req.params;

      const share = await service.getByShareToken(token);
      if (!share) {
        return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Share link not found or expired' } });
      }

      const uploadDir = process.env.UPLOAD_DIR || path.join(process.cwd(), 'uploads');
      const filePath = path.join(uploadDir, share.file_path);

      res.setHeader('Content-Type', share.mime_type);
      res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename="${encodeURIComponent(share.original_name)}"`);

      res.sendFile(filePath);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[FileAttachment] Access shared error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'ACCESS_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  async revokeShare(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getFileAttachmentService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { shareId } = req.params;

      const revoked = await service.revokeShare(shareId, tenantId);
      if (!revoked) {
        return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Share not found' } });
      }

      res.json({ success: true, data: { message: 'Share revoked' } });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[FileAttachment] Revoke share error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'REVOKE_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // STORAGE & QUOTA
  // ============================================================================

  async getStorageStats(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getFileAttachmentService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;

const healthcheckService = require('../services/health_check_service');
const { 
  CreateHealthcheckSchema, 
  UpdateHealthcheckSchema,
  HealthcheckParamsSchema 
} = require('../validation/health_check.schema');

class HealthcheckController {
  /**
   * Get all healthchecks
   * GET /api/v1/healthchecks
   */
  async findAll(req, res) {
    try {
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, ...filters } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
      
      const result = await healthcheckService.findAll({
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        where: filters,
        orderBy: [['created_at', 'DESC']]
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: result.hasMore
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: error.message
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get healthcheck by ID
   * GET /api/v1/healthchecks/:id
   */
  async findById(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = HealthcheckParamsSchema.parse(req.params);
      
      const healthcheck = await healthcheckService.findById(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: healthcheck
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create new healthcheck
   * POST /api/v1/healthchecks
   */
  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      const validatedData = CreateHealthcheckSchema.parse(req.body);
      
      const healthcheck = await healthcheckService.create(validatedData);

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: healthcheck,
        message: 'Healthcheck created successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.name === 'ZodError') {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Validation error',
          details: error.errors
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update healthcheck
   * PUT /api/v1/healthchecks/:id
   */
  async update(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = HealthcheckParamsSchema.parse(req.params);
      const validatedData = UpdateHealthcheckSchema.parse(req.body);
      
      const healthcheck = await healthcheckService.update(id, validatedData);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: healthcheck,
        message: 'Healthcheck updated successfully'
      });

========== FILE: ./src/controllers/health_history_controller.js ==========
const healthhistoryService = require('../services/health_history_service');
const { 
  CreateHealthhistorySchema, 
  UpdateHealthhistorySchema,
  HealthhistoryParamsSchema 
} = require('../validation/health_history.schema');

class HealthhistoryController {
  /**
   * Get all healthhistories
   * GET /api/v1/healthhistories
   */
  async findAll(req, res) {
    try {
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, ...filters } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
      
      const result = await healthhistoryService.findAll({
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        where: filters,
        orderBy: [['created_at', 'DESC']]
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: result.hasMore
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: error.message
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get healthhistory by ID
   * GET /api/v1/healthhistories/:id
   */
  async findById(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = HealthhistoryParamsSchema.parse(req.params);
      
      const healthhistory = await healthhistoryService.findById(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: healthhistory
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create new healthhistory
   * POST /api/v1/healthhistories
   */
  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      const validatedData = CreateHealthhistorySchema.parse(req.body);
      
      const healthhistory = await healthhistoryService.create(validatedData);

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: healthhistory,
        message: 'Healthhistory created successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.name === 'ZodError') {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Validation error',
          details: error.errors
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update healthhistory
   * PUT /api/v1/healthhistories/:id
   */
  async update(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = HealthhistoryParamsSchema.parse(req.params);
      const validatedData = UpdateHealthhistorySchema.parse(req.body);
      
      const healthhistory = await healthhistoryService.update(id, validatedData);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: healthhistory,
        message: 'Healthhistory updated successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else if (error.name === 'ZodError') {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Validation error',
          details: error.errors
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Delete healthhistory
   * DELETE /api/v1/healthhistories/:id
   */
  async delete(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = HealthhistoryParamsSchema.parse(req.params);
      
      await healthhistoryService.delete(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        message: 'Healthhistory deleted successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

}

module.exports = new HealthhistoryController();

const { getKnowledgeService } = require('../services/knowledge.service');

const knowledgeService = getKnowledgeService();

// ==================== Collections ====================

/**
 * Create collection
 * POST /api/v1/ai/knowledge/collections
 */
const createCollection = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { name, description, metadata } = req.body;

    if (!name) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: 'Collection name is required' }
      });
    }

    const collection = await knowledgeService.createCollection(
      { name, description, metadata },
      { tenantId: req.user?.tenantId, userId: req.user?.id }
    );

    res.status(201).json({ success: true, data: collection });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[KnowledgeController] createCollection error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * List collections
 * GET /api/v1/ai/knowledge/collections
 */
const listCollections = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { page = 1, limit = 20, status } = req.query;

    const result = await knowledgeService.listCollections(req.user?.tenantId, {
      page: parseInt(page),
      limit: parseInt(limit),
      status
    });

    res.status(200).json({ success: true, ...result });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[KnowledgeController] listCollections error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Get collection
 * GET /api/v1/ai/knowledge/collections/:id
 */
const getCollection = async (req, res) => {

    );

    if (!collection) {
      return res.status(404).json({

      });
    }

    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: collection });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[KnowledgeController] getCollection error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Upload document
 * POST /api/v1/ai/knowledge/documents
 */
const uploadDocument = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { collectionId } = req.body;
    const file = req.file;

    if (!collectionId) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: 'collectionId is required' }
      });
    }

    if (!file) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: 'File is required' }
      });
    }

    const result = await knowledgeService.ingestDocument(
      collectionId,
      file.buffer,
      file.originalname,
      file.mimetype,
      { tenantId: req.user?.tenantId, userId: req.user?.id }
    );

    res.status(202).json({ success: true, data: result });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[KnowledgeController] uploadDocument error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * License Controller
 * API endpoints for license management
 */

const { getLicenseService } = require('../services/license.service');

class LicenseController {
  
  // =====================================================
  // LICENSE CRUD (Super Admin)
  // =====================================================

  /**
   * Create a new license
   * POST /api/v1/licenses
   */
  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getLicenseService();
      const license = await service.create(req.body, req.user.id);

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: license
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[License] Create error:', error.message);
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'CREATE_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * List all licenses
   * GET /api/v1/licenses
   */
  async list(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getLicenseService();
      const options = {
        tenant_id: req.query.tenant_id,
        application: req.query.application,
        status: req.query.status,
        tier: req.query.tier,
        license_type: req.query.license_type,
        search: req.query.search,
        page: parseInt(req.query.page) || 1,
        limit: parseInt(req.query.limit) || 20,
        sort_by: req.query.sort_by,
        sort_order: req.query.sort_order
      };

      const result = await service.list(options);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.licenses,
        pagination: result.pagination
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[License] List error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'LIST_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get license by ID
   * GET /api/v1/licenses/:id
   */
  async getById(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getLicenseService();
      const license = await service.getById(req.params.id);

      if (!license) {
        return res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'License not found' }
        });
      }

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: license
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[License] GetById error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update license
   * PUT /api/v1/licenses/:id
   */
  async update(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getLicenseService();
      const license = await service.update(req.params.id, req.body, req.user.id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: license
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[License] Update error:', error.message);
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'UPDATE_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Revoke license
   * POST /api/v1/licenses/:id/revoke
   */
  async revoke(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getLicenseService();
      const { reason } = req.body;

      const license = await service.revoke(req.params.id, reason, req.user.id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: license,
        message: 'License revoked successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[License] Revoke error:', error.message);
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'REVOKE_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get licenses for a tenant
   * GET /api/v1/licenses/tenant/:tenantId
   */
  async getByTenant(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getLicenseService();
      const licenses = await service.getByTenant(req.params.tenantId);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: licenses
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[License] GetByTenant error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  // =====================================================
  // LICENSE ACTIVATION (Tenant Admin)
  // =====================================================

  /**
   * Activate a license
   * POST /api/v1/licenses/activate
   */
  async activate(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getLicenseService();
      const { license_key, instance_id, device_fingerprint } = req.body;

      const activationData = {
        method: 'manual',
        ip_address: req.ip,
        user_agent: req.get('User-Agent'),
        instance_id,
        device_fingerprint
      };

      const license = await service.activate(
        license_key,
        req.user.tenantId,
        req.user.id,
        activationData
      );

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: license,
        message: 'License activated successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[License] Activate error:', error.message);
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'ACTIVATION_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get my tenant's licenses
   * GET /api/v1/licenses/my
   */
  async getMyLicenses(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getLicenseService();
      const licenses = await service.getByTenant(req.user.tenantId);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: licenses
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[License] GetMyLicenses error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  // =====================================================
  // LICENSE VALIDATION & ENFORCEMENT
  // =====================================================

  /**
   * Validate a license
   * POST /api/v1/licenses/validate
   */
  async validate(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getLicenseService();
      const { license_id } = req.body;

      const isValid = await service.validate(license_id);
      const enforcementLevel = await service.getEnforcementLevel(license_id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          is_valid: isValid,
          enforcement_level: enforcementLevel
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[License] Validate error:', error.message);
      res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Check if feature is allowed
   * POST /api/v1/licenses/check-feature

  async checkFeature(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getLicenseService();

      res.json({
        success: true,

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[License] CheckFeature error:', error.message);

      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get license usage and limits
   * GET /api/v1/licenses/:id/usage
   */
  async getUsage(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getLicenseService();
      
      // Check tenant access
      const license = await service.getById(req.params.id);
      if (!license) {
        return res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'License not found' }
        });
      }

      // Tenant admins can only see their own licenses
      if (req.user.role !== 'Super Admin' && license.tenant_id !== req.user.tenantId) {
        return res.status(403).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Access denied' }
        });
      }

      const limits = await service.checkLimits(req.params.id);
      const usage = await service.getUsage(req.params.id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          license_id: req.params.id,
          limits,
          current_usage: usage,
          enforcement_level: await service.getEnforcementLevel(req.params.id)
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[License] GetUsage error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  // =====================================================

  /**

const moduleService = require('../services/module_service');
const { 
  CreateModuleSchema, 
  UpdateModuleSchema,
  ModuleParamsSchema 
} = require('../validation/module.schema');

class ModuleController {
  /**
   * Get all modules
   * GET /api/v1/modules
   */
  async findAll(req, res) {
    try {
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, ...filters } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
      
      const result = await moduleService.findAll({
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        where: filters,
        orderBy: [['created_at', 'DESC']]
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: result.hasMore
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: error.message
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get module by ID
   * GET /api/v1/modules/:id
   */
  async findById(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = ModuleParamsSchema.parse(req.params);
      
      const module = await moduleService.findById(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: module
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create new module
   * POST /api/v1/modules
   */
  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      const validatedData = CreateModuleSchema.parse(req.body);
      
      const module = await moduleService.create(validatedData);

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: module,
        message: 'Module created successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.name === 'ZodError') {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Validation error',
          details: error.errors
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update module
   * PUT /api/v1/modules/:id
   */
  async update(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = ModuleParamsSchema.parse(req.params);
      const validatedData = UpdateModuleSchema.parse(req.body);
      
      const module = await moduleService.update(id, validatedData);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: module,
        message: 'Module updated successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else if (error.name === 'ZodError') {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Validation error',
          details: error.errors
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Delete module
   * DELETE /api/v1/modules/:id
   */
  async delete(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = ModuleParamsSchema.parse(req.params);

      res.json({
        success: true,

/**
 * Module Controller - QAssure Platform
 * Handles module management HTTP requests
 */
const { getModuleService } = require('../services/module.service');
const { formatError, getErrorStatusCode } = require('../utils/errorFormatter');
const { getModuleLaunchService } = require('../services/module_launch.service');
const { getTenantModuleService } = require('../services/tenant_module.service');
const { getUserModuleService } = require('../services/user_module.service');

class ModuleController {
  constructor() {
    this.moduleService = getModuleService();
    this.moduleLaunchService = getModuleLaunchService();
    this.tenantModuleService = getTenantModuleService();
    this.userModuleService = getUserModuleService();
  }

  // ==================== EXISTING CRUD OPERATIONS ====================

  /**
   * POST /api/v1/modules
   * Register new module
   */
  register = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const module = await this.moduleService.register(
        req.body,
        req.user.id,
        req.user.tenantId
      );

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: module,
        message: 'Module registered successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/modules/available
   * Get available modules for role assignment (only enabled modules for tenant)
   * Returns only modules that are enabled for the current tenant
   * 
   * Query Parameters:
   * - page: Page number (default: 1)
   * - limit: Items per page (default: 100)
   * - orderBy: Sort order as "column,direction" (default: "name,ASC")
   * - status: Filter by module status (e.g., "running", "pending")
   * - health_status: Filter by health status (e.g., "healthy", "unhealthy")
   * - runtime_language: Filter by runtime language (e.g., "nodejs", "python")
   * - framework: Filter by framework (e.g., "express", "django")
   * - search: Search in name, module_id, or description
   */
  getAvailableModules = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      // Get pagination parameters
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, orderBy = 'name,ASC', ...filters } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
      
      // Parse orderBy (format: "column,direction" or ["column", "direction"])
      let parsedOrderBy = ['name', 'ASC'];
      if (orderBy) {
        if (Array.isArray(orderBy)) {
          parsedOrderBy = orderBy;
        } else if (typeof orderBy === 'string') {
          const parts = orderBy.split(',');
          if (parts.length === 2) {
            parsedOrderBy = [parts[0].trim(), parts[1].trim().toUpperCase()];
          }
        }
      }
      
      // Get tenant ID from authenticated user
      const tenantId = req.query.tenant_id || req.user?.tenantId;
      
      if (!tenantId) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'Tenant ID is required' }
        });
      }

      const result = await this.tenantModuleService.getEnabledModulesForTenant(tenantId, {
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        orderBy: parsedOrderBy,
        filters: filters
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: skip + parseInt(limit) < result.total
        },
        meta: result.meta
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/modules
   * List modules
   */
  list = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { status, health_status, runtime_language, search, page, limit, sort_by, sort_order } = req.query;

      const result = await this.moduleService.list(
        {
          tenant_id: req.user.tenantId,
          status,
          health_status,
          runtime_language,
          search
        },
        {
          page: parseInt(page) || 1,
          limit: parseInt(limit) || 20,
          sort_by,
          sort_order
        }
      );

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: result.pagination
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/modules/stats
   * Get module statistics
   */
  getStats = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const stats = await this.moduleService.getStats();

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: stats
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  getStates = async (req, res) => {

   * Deregister module (soft delete)
   */
  deregister = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const result = await this.moduleService.deregister(req.params.id, req.user.id);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * DELETE /api/v1/modules/:id
   * Delete module permanently
   */
  delete = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const result = await this.moduleService.delete(req.params.id, req.user.id);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  // ==================== MODULE LAUNCH & SSO ====================

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/my/modules
   * Get modules accessible by current user
   * For Super Admin: requires ?tenant_id query param
   */
  getMyModules = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { tenant_id } = req.query;
      
      const result = await this.moduleLaunchService.getAccessibleModules(
        req.user,
        tenant_id
      );

      if (!result.success) {
        return res.status(403).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'ACCESS_DENIED', message: result.error }
        });
      }

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        meta: result.meta,
        message: result.message
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * POST /api/v1/modules/:id/launch
   * Generate launch token for module SSO
   * For Super Admin: requires ?tenant_id query param
   */
  launchModule = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { tenant_id } = req.query;
      const moduleId = req.params.id;

      const requestInfo = {
        ip: req.ip || req.connection?.remoteAddress,
        userAgent: req.headers['user-agent']
      };

      const result = await this.moduleLaunchService.generateLaunchToken(
        req.user,
        moduleId,
        tenant_id,
        requestInfo
      );

      if (!result.success) {
        return res.status(403).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'LAUNCH_DENIED', message: result.error }
        });
      }

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * POST /api/v1/modules/verify-launch-token
   * Verify launch token (called by module using API Key)
   * Requires: X-API-Key header (module's API key)
   */
  verifyLaunchToken = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      let { token } = req.body;

      if (!token) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'Token is required in request body' }
        });
      }

      // Trim token to handle any whitespace issues
      if (typeof token === 'string') {
        token = token.trim();
      }

      // Ensure request is authenticated with API Key
      if (!req.user.isApiKey) {
        return res.status(403).json({
          success: false,
          error: { 
            code: 'API_KEY_REQUIRED', 
            message: 'This endpoint requires module API Key authentication (X-API-Key header)' 
          }
        });
      }

      // Ensure API Key is linked to a module
      if (!req.user.moduleId) {
        return res.status(403).json({
          success: false,
          error: { 
            code: 'INVALID_API_KEY', 
            message: 'API Key is not associated with a module' 
          }
        });
      }

      const apiKey = {
        id: req.user.apiKeyId,
        moduleId: req.user.moduleId
      };

      const requestInfo = {
        ip: req.ip || req.connection?.remoteAddress
      };

      const result = await this.moduleLaunchService.verifyLaunchToken(
        token,
        apiKey,
        requestInfo
      );

      if (!result.success) {
        return res.status(401).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'TOKEN_INVALID', message: result.error }
        });
      }

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  // ==================== TENANT MODULE ACCESS (Super Admin) ====================

  /**
   * POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/modules/:moduleId/enable
   * Enable a module for a tenant (Super Admin only)
   */
  enableModuleForTenant = async (req, res) => {
    try {

  };

  /**

   */
  getUsersForModule = async (req, res) => {

      const moduleId = req.params.id;
      const { page, limit } = req.query;

      const result = await this.userModuleService.getUsersForModule(

    }
  };

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/users/:userId/modules
   * Get all modules assigned to a user (Tenant Admin only)
   */
  getModulesForUser = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const { userId } = req.params;

        userId,
        req.user.tenantId
      );

      res.status(200).json(result);
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * POST /api/v1/modules/:id/users/bulk
   * Bulk assign users to a module (Tenant Admin only)
   */
  bulkAssignUsersToModule = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const moduleId = req.params.id;
      const { user_ids, role_id } = req.body;

      if (!user_ids || !Array.isArray(user_ids) || user_ids.length === 0) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'user_ids array is required' }
        });
      }

      const result = await this.userModuleService.bulkAssignUsersToModule(
        user_ids,
        moduleId,
        req.user.tenantId,
        req.user.id,
        role_id
      );

      res.status(200).json(result);
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  /**
   * DELETE /api/v1/modules/:id/users/bulk
   * Bulk remove users from a module (Tenant Admin only)
   */
  bulkRemoveUsersFromModule = async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const moduleId = req.params.id;
      const { user_ids } = req.body;

      if (!user_ids || !Array.isArray(user_ids) || user_ids.length === 0) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'user_ids array is required' }
        });
      }

      const result = await this.userModuleService.bulkRemoveUsersFromModule(
        user_ids,
        moduleId,
        req.user.tenantId,
        req.user.id
      );

      res.status(200).json(result);
    } catch (error) {
      this._handleError(res, error);
    }
  };

  // ==================== ERROR HANDLING ====================

  /**
   * Handle errors
   */
  _handleError(res, error) {
    console.error('[ModuleController] Error:', error.message);

    // Handle specific error cases first
    if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
      return res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: error.message }
      });
    }

    if (error.message.includes('already exists')) {
      return res.status(409).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'CONFLICT', message: error.message }
      });
    }

    if (error.message.includes('Invalid state transition') || error.message.includes('Invalid status')) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'INVALID_TRANSITION', message: error.message }
      });
    }

    if (error.message.includes('Access denied') || error.message.includes('not enabled') || error.message.includes('do not have access')) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: error.message }
      });
    }

    if (error.message.includes('not a member')) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'INVALID_USER', message: error.message }
      });
    }

    // Fallback to formatError for other errors
    const errorResponse = formatError(error);
    res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
      success: false,
      error: errorResponse,
      ...(error.errors && { details: error.errors }),
      ...(error.issues && { details: error.issues })
    });
  }
}

module.exports = new ModuleController();

const { getNotificationService } = require('../services/notification.service');

class NotificationController {

  async getMyNotifications(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getNotificationService();

      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { is_read, category, limit, offset } = req.query;

      const notifications = await service.getForUser(userId, tenantId, {
        is_read: is_read !== undefined ? is_read === 'true' : undefined,
        category,
        limit: parseInt(limit) || 50,
        offset: parseInt(offset) || 0
      });

      res.json({ success: true, data: notifications });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Notification] Get error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // SEND NOTIFICATION (Admin/System)
  // ============================================================================

  async sendNotification(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getNotificationService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { user_id, user_ids, role, template_code, ...data } = req.body;

      let result;

      if (template_code && user_id) {
        result = await service.sendFromTemplate(tenantId, user_id, template_code, data);
      } else if (user_ids && user_ids.length > 0) {
        result = await service.sendToMultiple(tenantId, user_ids, data);
      } else if (role) {
        result = await service.sendByRole(tenantId, role, data);
      } else if (user_id) {
        result = await service.send(tenantId, user_id, data);
      } else {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'Must specify user_id, user_ids, or role' }
        });
      }

      res.status(201).json({ success: true, data: result });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Notification] Send error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'SEND_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }
}

const permissionService = require('../services/permission_service');

class PermissionController {
  /**
   * Get all permissions
   * GET /api/v1/permissions
   */
  async findAll(req, res) {
    try {
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, ...filters } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
      
      const result = await permissionService.findAll({
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        where: filters,
        orderBy: [['created_at', 'DESC']]
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: result.hasMore
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: error.message
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get permission by ID
   * GET /api/v1/permissions/:id
   */
  async findById(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware
      
      const permission = await permissionService.findById(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: permission
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create new permission
   * POST /api/v1/permissions
   */
  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      // req.body is already validated and transformed by validateCreate middleware
      const permission = await permissionService.create(req.body);

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: permission,
        message: 'Permission created successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: error.message
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update permission
   * PUT /api/v1/permissions/:id
   */
  async update(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware
      // req.body is already validated and transformed by validateUpdate middleware
      
      const permission = await permissionService.update(id, req.body);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: permission,
        message: 'Permission updated successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Delete permission
   * DELETE /api/v1/permissions/:id
   */
  async delete(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware
      
      await permissionService.delete(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        message: 'Permission deleted successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get permission details
   * GET /api/v1/permissions/:permissionId
   */
  async findOne(req, res) {
    try {
      // Extract path parameters
      const permissionId = req.params.permissionId;

      // Custom endpoint handler
      // Build service method call with parameters in correct order

      const result = await permissionService.findOne(permissionId);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.name === 'ZodError') {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Validation error',
          details: error.errors
        });
      } else if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

}

/**
 * Project Controller
 * Handles all project-related API endpoints
