const { getProjectService } = require('../services/project.service');

class ProjectController {

  // ============================================================================
  // PROJECT CRUD
  // ============================================================================

  /**
   * POST /api/v1/projects
   * Create a new project
   */
  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getProjectService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const createdBy = req.user.id;

      const project = await service.create(tenantId, req.body, createdBy);

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: project
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Project] Create error:', error.message);
      
      if (error.message.includes('unique_project_code_per_tenant')) {
        return res.status(409).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'DUPLICATE_CODE', message: 'Project code already exists' }
        });
      }

      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'CREATE_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/projects
   * List projects with filtering
   */
  async list(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getProjectService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { status, project_type, owner_id, search, limit, offset, sort_by, sort_order, my_projects } = req.query;

      let result;
      
      if (my_projects === 'true') {
        result = await service.getMyProjects(req.user.id, tenantId, {
          status,
          project_type,
          search,
          limit: parseInt(limit) || 50,
          offset: parseInt(offset) || 0,
          sort_by,
          sort_order
        });
      } else {
        result = await service.list(tenantId, {
          status,
          project_type,
          owner_id,
          search,
          limit: parseInt(limit) || 50,
          offset: parseInt(offset) || 0,
          sort_by,
          sort_order
        });
      }

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.projects,
        pagination: {
          total: result.total,
          limit: result.limit,
          offset: result.offset
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Project] List error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/projects/:id
   * Get project by ID
   */
  async getById(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getProjectService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { id } = req.params;

      const project = await service.getById(id, tenantId);

      if (!project) {
        return res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Project not found' }
        });
      }

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: project

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Project] Get by ID error:', error.message);

        success: false,

      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * PUT /api/v1/projects/:id
   * Update project
   */
  async update(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getProjectService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const updatedBy = req.user.id;
      const { id } = req.params;

      const project = await service.update(id, tenantId, req.body, updatedBy);

      res.json({
        success: true,

    } catch (error) {

      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * DELETE /api/v1/projects/:id
   * Archive project (soft delete)
   */
  async delete(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getProjectService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const deletedBy = req.user.id;
      const { id } = req.params;

      await service.delete(id, tenantId, deletedBy);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        message: 'Project archived successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Project] Delete error:', error.message);
      
      if (error.message === 'Project not found') {
        return res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: error.message }
        });
      }

      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'DELETE_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

/**
 * Prompt Controller - QAssure Platform
 * HTTP handlers for prompt management endpoints
 */
const { getPromptService } = require('../services/prompt.service');

const promptService = getPromptService();

// ==================== CRUD ====================

/**
 * Create prompt
 * POST /api/v1/ai/prompts
 */
const create = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const prompt = await promptService.create(req.body, {
      tenantId: req.user?.tenantId,
      userId: req.user?.id
    });

    res.status(201).json({ success: true, data: prompt });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[PromptController] create error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Get prompt by ID
 * GET /api/v1/ai/prompts/:id
 */
const getById = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const prompt = await promptService.getById(req.params.id, req.user?.tenantId);

    if (!prompt) {
      return res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Prompt not found' }
      });
    }

    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: prompt });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[PromptController] getById error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * List prompts
 * GET /api/v1/ai/prompts
 */
const list = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { page, limit, use_case, status, search, tags } = req.query;

    const result = await promptService.list(req.user?.tenantId, {
      page: parseInt(page) || 1,
      limit: parseInt(limit) || 20,
      useCase: use_case,
      status,
      search,
      tags: tags ? tags.split(',') : undefined
    });

    res.status(200).json({ success: true, ...result });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[PromptController] list error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Update prompt
 * PUT /api/v1/ai/prompts/:id
 */
const update = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const prompt = await promptService.update(
      req.params.id,
      req.user?.tenantId,
      req.body,
      { userId: req.user?.id }
    );

    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: prompt });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[PromptController] update error:', error.message);
    
    if (error.message === 'Prompt not found') {
      return res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: error.message }
      });
    }

    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Update prompt status
 * PATCH /api/v1/ai/prompts/:id/status
 */
const updateStatus = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { status } = req.body;

    if (!status) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: 'Status is required' }
      });
    }

    const prompt = await promptService.updateStatus(
      req.params.id,
      req.user?.tenantId,
      status,
      req.user?.id
    );

    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: prompt });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[PromptController] updateStatus error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Delete prompt
 * DELETE /api/v1/ai/prompts/:id
 */
const remove = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    await promptService.delete(req.params.id, req.user?.tenantId);
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, message: 'Prompt deleted' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[PromptController] delete error:', error.message);

/**
 * Clone prompt

 */
const clone = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { name } = req.body;

    const prompt = await promptService.clone(
      req.params.id,
      req.user?.tenantId,
      name,
      req.user?.id
    );

    res.status(201).json({ success: true, data: prompt });
  } catch (error) {

  }

/**
 * Get specific version
 * GET /api/v1/ai/prompts/:id/versions/:version

  try {
    const version = await promptService.getVersion(
      req.params.id,
      parseInt(req.params.version),
      req.user?.tenantId
    );

    if (!version) {
      return res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Version not found' }
      });
    }

    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: version });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[PromptController] getVersion error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }

/**
 * Rollback to version
 * POST /api/v1/ai/prompts/:id/rollback
 */
const rollback = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { version } = req.body;

    if (!version) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: 'Version is required' }
      });
    }

    const prompt = await promptService.rollback(
      req.params.id,
      parseInt(version),
      req.user?.tenantId,
      req.user?.id
    );

    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: prompt });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[PromptController] rollback error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Execute prompt
 * POST /api/v1/ai/prompts/:id/execute
 */
const execute = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { variables } = req.body;

    const result = await promptService.execute(
      req.params.id,
      variables || {},
      {
        tenantId: req.user?.tenantId,
        userId: req.user?.id
      }
    );

    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: result });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[PromptController] execute error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Test prompt (playground)
 * POST /api/v1/ai/prompts/:id/test
 */
const test = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { variables, model, provider, temperature, max_tokens } = req.body;

    const result = await promptService.test(
      req.params.id,
      variables || {},
      { model, provider, temperature, max_tokens },
      {
        tenantId: req.user?.tenantId,
        userId: req.user?.id
      }
    );

    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: result });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[PromptController] test error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

const qmsconnectionService = require('../services/qms_connection_service');
const {
  CreateQmsconnectionSchema,
  UpdateQmsconnectionSchema,
  QmsconnectionParamsSchema
} = require('../validation/qms_connection.schema');

class QmsconnectionController {
  /**
   * Get all qmsconnections
   * GET /api/v1/qmsconnections
   */
  async findAll(req, res) {
    try {
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, ...filters } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

      const result = await qmsconnectionService.findAll({
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        where: filters,
        orderBy: [['created_at', 'DESC']]
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: result.hasMore
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: error.message
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get qmsconnection by ID
   * GET /api/v1/qmsconnections/:id
   */
  async findById(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = QmsconnectionParamsSchema.parse(req.params);

      const qmsconnection = await qmsconnectionService.findById(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: qmsconnection
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create new qmsconnection
   * POST /api/v1/qmsconnections
   */
  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      // Auto-populate created_by from authenticated user
      const dataToValidate = { ...req.body };
      if (req.user && req.user.id) {
        dataToValidate.created_by = req.user.id;
      }

      const validatedData = CreateQmsconnectionSchema.parse(dataToValidate);

      const qmsconnection = await qmsconnectionService.create(validatedData);

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: qmsconnection,
        message: 'Qmsconnection created successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.name === 'ZodError') {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Validation error',
          details: error.errors
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update qmsconnection
   * PUT /api/v1/qmsconnections/:id
   */
  async update(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = QmsconnectionParamsSchema.parse(req.params);
      const validatedData = UpdateQmsconnectionSchema.parse(req.body);

      const qmsconnection = await qmsconnectionService.update(id, validatedData);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: qmsconnection,
        message: 'Qmsconnection updated successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else if (error.name === 'ZodError') {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Validation error',
          details: error.errors
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  async delete(req, res) {

const qmsentitymappingService = require('../services/qms_entity_mapping_service');
const {
  CreateQmsentitymappingSchema,
  UpdateQmsentitymappingSchema,
  QmsentitymappingParamsSchema
} = require('../validation/qms_entity_mapping.schema');

class QmsentitymappingController {
  /**
   * Get all qmsentitymappings
   * GET /api/v1/qmsentitymappings
   */
  async findAll(req, res) {
    try {
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, ...filters } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

      const result = await qmsentitymappingService.findAll({
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        where: filters,
        orderBy: [['created_at', 'DESC']]
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: result.hasMore
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: error.message
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get qmsentitymapping by ID
   * GET /api/v1/qmsentitymappings/:id
   */

    try {
      const { id } = QmsentitymappingParamsSchema.parse(req.params);

      const qmsentitymapping = await qmsentitymappingService.findById(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,

      });
    } catch (error) {

        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create new qmsentitymapping
   * POST /api/v1/qmsentitymappings
   */
  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      // Auto-populate from authenticated user
      const dataToValidate = { ...req.body };
      if (req.user) {
        if (req.user.id) dataToValidate.created_by = req.user.id;
        if (req.user.tenantId) dataToValidate.tenant_id = req.user.tenantId; // Using tenantId as per prev controller patterns
      }

      const validatedData = CreateQmsentitymappingSchema.parse(dataToValidate);

      const qmsentitymapping = await qmsentitymappingService.create(validatedData);

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: qmsentitymapping,
        message: 'Qmsentitymapping created successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.name === 'ZodError') {
        res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Validation error',
          details: error.errors
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update qmsentitymapping
   * PUT /api/v1/qmsentitymappings/:id
   */
  async update(req, res) {
    try {

const qmssyncconflictService = require('../services/qms_sync_conflict_service');

  CreateQmssyncconflictSchema,
  UpdateQmssyncconflictSchema,
  QmssyncconflictParamsSchema
} = require('../validation/qms_sync_conflict.schema');

class QmssyncconflictController {
  /**
   * Get all qmssyncconflicts
   * GET /api/v1/qmssyncconflicts
   */
  async findAll(req, res) {
    try {
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, ...filters } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

      const result = await qmssyncconflictService.findAll({
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        where: filters,
        orderBy: [['created_at', 'DESC']]
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: result.hasMore
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: error.message
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get qmssyncconflict by ID
   * GET /api/v1/qmssyncconflicts/:id

  async findById(req, res) {
    try {

        });

const syncService = getQMSSyncService();

/**

 * GET /api/v1/qms/supported
 */
const getSupportedSystems = async (req, res) => {

    const systems = connectionService.getSupportedSystems();
    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: systems });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[QMSController] getSupportedSystems error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Get system details
 * GET /api/v1/qms/supported/:systemName
 */
const getSystemDetails = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const system = connectionService.getSystemDetails(req.params.systemName);
    
    if (!system) {
      return res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'QMS system not found' }
      });
    }

    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: system });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[QMSController] getSystemDetails error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

// ==================== Connections (using existing schema) ====================

/**
 * Create connection (matching existing schema)
 * POST /api/v1/qms/connections
 */
const createConnection = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { 
      name, qms_type, base_url, auth_type, auth_config, 
      sync_mode, entity_mappings, field_mappings, status 
    } = req.body;

    // Map to our internal format
    const systemType = qms_type?.toLowerCase().replace('_', '');
    
    const connection = await connectionService.createConnection(
      req.user?.tenantId,
      { 
        systemType: qms_type,
        name, 
        credentials: {
          baseUrl: base_url,
          authType: auth_type,
          ...auth_config
        },
        settings: {
          syncMode: sync_mode,
          entityMappings: entity_mappings,
          fieldMappings: field_mappings
        }
      },
      req.user?.id
    );

    res.status(201).json({ success: true, data: connection });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[QMSController] createConnection error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

 * GET /api/v1/qms/connections

const listConnections = async (req, res) => {

    });
  }

  }

      req.user?.id

    });

// ==================== Conflict Resolution ====================

/**
 * Resolve conflict
 * POST /api/v1/qms/conflicts/:conflictId/resolve
 */
const resolveConflict = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { resolution } = req.body;

    if (!resolution) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: 'resolution is required' }
      });
    }

    const result = await syncService.resolveConflict(
      req.params.conflictId,
      req.user?.tenantId,
      resolution,
      req.user?.id
    );

    res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: result });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[QMSController] resolveConflict error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

/**

const { getReportingService } = require('../services/reporting.service');
const { getElasticsearchService } = require('../infrastructure/search/elasticsearch.service');

class ReportingController {

  // ============================================================================
  // EXECUTIVE DASHBOARD
  // ============================================================================

  async getExecutiveDashboard(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getReportingService();

      console.error('[Reporting] Dashboard error:', error.message);

    }
  }

  // ============================================================================

  // ============================================================================

  async getKPIs(req, res) {

      const service = getReportingService();

    } catch (error) {

  // ============================================================================

  // ============================================================================
  // REPORTS
  // ============================================================================

  async listReports(req, res) {

      const service = getReportingService();

  async executeReport(req, res) {

      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const executedBy = req.user.id;
      const { id } = req.params;
      const parameters = req.body;

      res.json({ success: true, data: result });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Reporting] Execute report error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'EXECUTE_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // GLOBAL SEARCH
  // ============================================================================

  async globalSearch(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getReportingService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { q, limit } = req.query;

      if (!q || q.trim().length < 2) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'Search query must be at least 2 characters' }
        });
      }

      const results = await service.globalSearch(q.trim(), tenantId, {
        limit: parseInt(limit) || 20
      });

      res.json({ success: true, data: results });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Reporting] Search error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'SEARCH_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // ELASTICSEARCH HEALTH
  // ============================================================================

  async getSearchHealth(req, res) {
    try {
      const es = getElasticsearchService();
      const health = await es.healthCheck();
      res.json({ success: true, data: health });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Reporting] Search health error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'HEALTH_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // INDEX MANAGEMENT
  // ============================================================================

  async reindexModule(req, res) {
    try {
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { module } = req.params;

      const validModules = ['documents', 'capas', 'training', 'suppliers'];
      if (!validModules.includes(module)) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'Invalid module. Must be: ' + validModules.join(', ') }
        });
      }

      const es = getElasticsearchService();
      if (!es.isConnected) {
        return res.status(503).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'Elasticsearch is not connected' }
        });
      }

      // Get data from PostgreSQL
      const { pool } = require('../config/database');
      let query, indexType;

      switch (module) {
        case 'capas':
          query = 'SELECT id, capa_number, title, description, problem_statement, capa_type, priority, status FROM capas WHERE tenant_id = $1';
          indexType = 'capas';
          break;
        case 'documents':
          query = 'SELECT id, document_number, title, description, document_type as category, status FROM documents WHERE tenant_id = $1';
          indexType = 'documents';
          break;
        case 'suppliers':
          query = 'SELECT id, supplier_code, name, supplier_type, category, status, current_score, score_grade FROM suppliers WHERE tenant_id = $1';
          indexType = 'suppliers';
          break;
        case 'training':
          query = 'SELECT id, course_code, title, description, category, status FROM training_courses WHERE tenant_id = $1';
          indexType = 'training';
          break;
      }

      const result = await pool.query(query, [tenantId]);
      
      if (result.rows.length > 0) {
        await es.bulkIndex(indexType, result.rows, tenantId);
      }

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          module,
          indexed_count: result.rows.length,
          message: `Successfully indexed ${result.rows.length} ${module}`
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Reporting] Reindex error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'REINDEX_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // AUDIT LOGS
  // ============================================================================

  async getAuditLogs(req, res) {
    try {
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { user_id, action, entity_type, start_date, end_date, page, limit } = req.query;

      const es = getElasticsearchService();
      
      if (es.isConnected) {
        const results = await es.searchAuditLogs(tenantId, {
          userId: user_id,
          action,
          entityType: entity_type,
          startDate: start_date,
          endDate: end_date,
          page: parseInt(page) || 1,
          limit: parseInt(limit) || 50
        });
        return res.json({ success: true, data: results });
      }

      // Fallback to PostgreSQL audit_logs table
      const { pool } = require('../config/database');
      const result = await pool.query(
        `SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE tenant_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT $2`,
        [tenantId, parseInt(limit) || 50]
      );

      res.json({ success: true, data: { hits: result.rows, total: result.rows.length } });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Reporting] Audit logs error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }
}

module.exports = new ReportingController();


========== FILE: ./src/controllers/role_controller.js ==========
const roleService = require('../services/role_service');
const { formatError, getErrorStatusCode } = require('../utils/errorFormatter');
const { getPermissionService } = require('../infrastructure/auth/permission.service');

class RoleController {
  /**
   * Get all roles
   * GET /api/v1/roles
   */
  async findAll(req, res) {
    try {
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, orderBy = ['created_at', 'DESC'], ...filters } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
      
      // Check if user is super admin
      let isSuperAdmin = req.user?.isSuperAdmin;
      if (!isSuperAdmin && req.user?.id) {
        const permissionService = getPermissionService();
        isSuperAdmin = await permissionService.isSuperAdmin(req.user.id);
      }
      
      // Build where clause - if not super admin, filter by authenticated user's tenant_id
      const where = { ...filters };
      if (!isSuperAdmin) {
        // Use the authenticated user's tenant_id from the token
        if (req.user?.tenantId) {
          where.tenant_id = req.user.tenantId;
        }
      }
      // Super admin can see all roles (no tenant_id filter)
      
      const result = await roleService.findAll({
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        where: where,
        orderBy: [orderBy]
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: result.hasMore
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get role by ID
   * GET /api/v1/roles/:id
   */
  async findById(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware
      
      const role = await roleService.findById(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: role
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create new role
   * POST /api/v1/roles
   */
  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      // req.body is already validated and transformed by validateCreate middleware
      // Get tenant_id from authenticated user if not provided in body
      const tenantId = req.body.tenant_id || req.user?.tenantId;
      const role = await roleService.create(req.body, tenantId);

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: role,
        message: 'Role created successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse,
        ...(error.errors && { details: error.errors }),
        ...(error.issues && { details: error.issues })
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update role
   * PUT /api/v1/roles/:id
   */
  async update(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware
      // req.body is already validated and transformed by validateUpdate middleware
      // Only update tenant_id if explicitly provided in body
      const role = await roleService.update(id, req.body);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: role,
        message: 'Role updated successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse,
        ...(error.errors && { details: error.errors }),
        ...(error.issues && { details: error.issues })
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Delete role
   * DELETE /api/v1/roles/:id
   */
  async delete(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware
      
      await roleService.delete(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        message: 'Role deleted successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get role details
   * GET /api/v1/roles/:roleId
   */
  async findOne(req, res) {
    try {
      // Extract path parameters
      const roleId = req.params.roleId;

      // Custom endpoint handler
      // Build service method call with parameters in correct order

      const result = await roleService.findOne(roleId);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse,
        ...(error.errors && { details: error.errors })
      });
    }
  }

}

  }

      const { filename } = req.params;
      
      const deleted = await exportService.deleteExport(filename);
      
      if (!deleted) {

      res.json({ success: true, data: { message: 'Export deleted' } });

const { getPasswordPolicyService } = require('../services/password-policy.service');

  // PASSWORD POLICY ENDPOINTS

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/security/password-policy
   * Get password policy for current tenant
   */

      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;

      const policy = await service.getPolicy(tenantId);

      });

  /**
   * PUT /api/v1/security/password-policy

  /**
   * POST /api/v1/security/access-reviews
   * Create a new access review campaign
   */
  async createAccessReview(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getAccessReviewService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const createdBy = req.user.id;

      const {
        name,
        description,
        review_type,
        scope_type,
        scope_criteria,
        frequency,
        start_date,
        due_date,
        reviewer_id,
        reviewer_role,
        auto_revoke_on_overdue,
        auto_revoke_after_days
      } = req.body;

      if (!name || !start_date || !due_date) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'name, start_date, and due_date are required' }
        });
      }

      const review = await service.createReview({
        tenantId,
        name,
        description,
        reviewType: review_type,
        scopeType: scope_type,
        scopeCriteria: scope_criteria,
        frequency,
        startDate: start_date,
        dueDate: due_date,
        reviewerId: reviewer_id,
        reviewerRole: reviewer_role,
        autoRevokeOnOverdue: auto_revoke_on_overdue,
        autoRevokeAfterDays: auto_revoke_after_days,
        createdBy
      });

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: review
      });

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Security] Create access review error:', error.message);
      
      if (error.message.includes('does not exist')) {
        return res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: error.message }
        });
      }
      
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'CREATE_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

        }

      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'APPLY_ERROR', message: error.message }

const sessionService = require('../services/session_service');

class SessionController {
  /**
   * Get all sessions
   * GET /api/v1/sessions
   */
  async findAll(req, res) {
    try {
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, ...filters } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
      
      const result = await sessionService.findAll({
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        where: filters,
        orderBy: [['created_at', 'DESC']]
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: result.hasMore
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: error.message
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get session by ID
   * GET /api/v1/sessions/:id
   */
  async findById(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware
      
      const session = await sessionService.findById(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: session
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create new session
   * POST /api/v1/sessions
   */
  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      // req.body is already validated and transformed by validateCreate middleware
      const data = { ...req.body };
      
      // If user_id is not provided, use the authenticated user's ID
      if (!data.user_id && req.user?.id) {
        data.user_id = req.user.id;
      }
      
      // If tenant_id is not provided, use the authenticated user's tenant_id
      if (!data.tenant_id && req.user?.tenantId) {
        data.tenant_id = req.user.tenantId;
      }
      
      const session = await sessionService.create(data);

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: session,
        message: 'Session created successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('does not exist')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update session
   * PUT /api/v1/sessions/:id
   */
  async update(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware
      // req.body is already validated and transformed by validateUpdate middleware
      
      const session = await sessionService.update(id, req.body);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: session,
        message: 'Session updated successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Delete session
   * DELETE /api/v1/sessions/:id
   */
  async delete(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware
      
      await sessionService.delete(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        message: 'Session deleted successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get session details
   * GET /api/v1/sessions/:sessionId
   */
  async findOne(req, res) {
    try {
      // Extract path parameters
      const sessionId = req.params.sessionId;

      // Custom endpoint handler
      // Build service method call with parameters in correct order

      const result = await sessionService.findOne(sessionId);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Revoke session
   * DELETE /api/v1/sessions/:sessionId
   */
  async revoke(req, res) {
    try {
      // Extract path parameters
      const sessionId = req.params.sessionId;

      // Custom endpoint handler
      // Build service method call with parameters in correct order

      const result = await sessionService.revoke(sessionId);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Revoke all user sessions
   * DELETE /api/v1/sessions/user/:userId
   */
  async revokeUserSessions(req, res) {
    try {
      // Extract path parameters
      const userId = req.params.userId;

      // Custom endpoint handler
      // Build service method call with parameters in correct order

      const result = await sessionService.revokeUserSessions(userId);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.message.includes('not found')) {
        res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      } else {
        res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          error: error.message
        });
      }
    }
  }

}

const { getSupplierService } = require('../services/supplier.service');

class SupplierController {

  // ============================================================================
  // SUPPLIER CRUD
  // ============================================================================

  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getSupplierService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const createdBy = req.user.id;

      const { name } = req.body;
      if (!name) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'name is required' }
        });
      }

      const supplier = await service.create(tenantId, req.body, createdBy);
      res.status(201).json({ success: true, data: supplier });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Supplier] Create error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'CREATE_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  async list(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getSupplierService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { status, category, supplier_type, risk_level, search, limit, offset } = req.query;

      const result = await service.list(tenantId, {
        status, category, supplier_type, risk_level, search,
        limit: parseInt(limit) || 50,
        offset: parseInt(offset) || 0
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.suppliers,
        pagination: { total: result.total, limit: result.limit, offset: result.offset }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Supplier] List error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  async getById(req, res) {
    try {

      const { id } = req.params;

      if (!supplier) {

/**
 * System Configuration Controller
 * Handles settings, branding, security policies, feature flags, webhooks
 */

const { getSystemConfigService } = require('../services/system-config.service');

class SystemConfigController {

  // ============================================================================
  // SYSTEM SETTINGS
  // ============================================================================

  async getSettings(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getSystemConfigService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { category } = req.query;

      const settings = await service.getSettings(tenantId, category);
      res.json({ success: true, data: settings });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[SystemConfig] Get settings error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  async getSetting(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getSystemConfigService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { category, key } = req.params;

      const setting = await service.getSetting(tenantId, category, key);
      if (setting === null) {
        return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Setting not found' } });
      }

      res.json({ success: true, data: { value: setting } });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[SystemConfig] Get setting error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  async updateSetting(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getSystemConfigService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const userId = req.user.id;
      const { category, key } = req.params;
      const { value } = req.body;

      const setting = await service.updateSetting(tenantId, category, key, value, userId);
      res.json({ success: true, data: setting });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[SystemConfig] Update setting error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'UPDATE_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

  async updateSettingsBulk(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getSystemConfigService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const userId = req.user.id;
      const { settings } = req.body;

      if (!Array.isArray(settings)) {
        return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'settings must be an array' } });
      }

      const results = await service.updateSettingsBulk(tenantId, settings, userId);
      res.json({ success: true, data: results });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[SystemConfig] Bulk update error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'UPDATE_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

      res.json({ success: true, data: template });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[SystemConfig] Get email template error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }

const tenantService = require('../services/tenant_service');
const {
  UpdateTenantSchema
} = require('../validation/tenant.schema');
const { formatError, getErrorStatusCode } = require('../utils/errorFormatter');
const { Op } = require('sequelize');

class TenantController {
  /**
   * Get all tenants
   * GET /api/v1/tenants
   */
  async findAll(req, res) {
    try {
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, orderBy = ['created_at', 'DESC'], ...filters } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
      
      // Exclude current tenant from the list
      const whereClause = {
        ...filters,
        ...(req.user?.tenantId && { id: { [Op.ne]: req.user.tenantId } })
      };
      
      const result = await tenantService.findAll({
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        where: whereClause,
        orderBy: [orderBy]
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: result.hasMore
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get tenant by ID
   * GET /api/v1/tenants/:id
   */
  async findById(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware
      
      const tenant = await tenantService.findById(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: tenant
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create new tenant
   * POST /api/v1/tenants
   */
  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      // req.body is already validated and transformed by validateCreate middleware
      const tenant = await tenantService.create(req.body);

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: tenant,
        message: 'Tenant created successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse,
        ...(error.errors && { details: error.errors }),
        ...(error.issues && { details: error.issues })
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update tenant
   * PUT /api/v1/tenants/:id
   */
  async update(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware
      // req.body is already validated and transformed by validateUpdate middleware
      
      const tenant = await tenantService.update(id, req.body);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: tenant,
        message: 'Tenant updated successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse,
        ...(error.errors && { details: error.errors }),
        ...(error.issues && { details: error.issues })
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Delete tenant
   * DELETE /api/v1/tenants/:id
   */
  async delete(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware
      
      await tenantService.delete(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        message: 'Tenant deleted successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get tenant details
   * GET /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId
   */
  async findOne(req, res) {
    try {
      // Extract path parameters
      const tenantId = req.params.tenantId;

      // Custom endpoint handler
      // Build service method call with parameters in correct order

      const result = await tenantService.findOne(tenantId);

      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse,
        ...(error.errors && { details: error.errors })
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update tenant status
   * PUT /api/v1/tenants/:tenantId/status
   */
  async updateStatus(req, res) {
    try {
      // Extract path parameters
      const tenantId = req.params.tenantId;

      // Validate request body
      const bodySchema = UpdateTenantSchema;
      const validatedData = bodySchema.parse(req.body);
      
      // Custom endpoint handler
      // Build service method call with parameters in correct order
      const result = await tenantService.updateStatus(tenantId, validatedData);
      
      res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: result
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse,
        ...(error.errors && { details: error.errors })
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get tenant theme by domain
   * GET /api/v1/tenants/theme?domain=example.com
   * Public endpoint - no authentication required
   */
  async getThemeByDomain(req, res) {
    try {
      const { domain } = req.query;

            message: 'Domain parameter is required'

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: theme
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse
      });
    }
  }

}

  async createCourse(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getTrainingService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const createdBy = req.user.id;

      const { course_code, title, course_type } = req.body;
      if (!course_code || !title || !course_type) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'course_code, title, and course_type are required' }
        });
      }

      const course = await service.createCourse(tenantId, req.body, createdBy);
      res.status(201).json({ success: true, data: course });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Training] Create course error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'CREATE_ERROR', message: error.message } });
    }
  }

    try {

      const result = await service.listCourses(tenantId, {
        status, category, course_type, search,
        limit: parseInt(limit) || 50,
        offset: parseInt(offset) || 0

========== FILE: ./src/controllers/user_controller.js ==========
const userService = require('../services/user_service');
const { 
  CreateUserSchema,
  TenantIdParamsSchema,
} = require('../validation/user.schema');
const { formatError, getErrorStatusCode } = require('../utils/errorFormatter');
const { getPermissionService } = require('../infrastructure/auth/permission.service');

// Helper to remove sensitive fields from user data
const sanitizeUser = (user) => {
  if (!user) return user;
  const { password_hash, ...safeUser } = user.toJSON ? user.toJSON() : user;
  return safeUser;
};

const sanitizeUsers = (users) => {
  return users.map(sanitizeUser);
};

class UserController {
  /**
   * Get all users
   * GET /api/v1/users
   */
  async findAll(req, res) {
    try {
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, orderBy = ['created_at', 'DESC'], ...filters } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
      
      // Check if user is super admin
      let isSuperAdmin = req.user?.isSuperAdmin;
      if (!isSuperAdmin && req.user?.id) {
        const permissionService = getPermissionService();
        isSuperAdmin = await permissionService.isSuperAdmin(req.user.id);
      }
      
      // Build where clause - if not super admin, filter by authenticated user's tenant_id
      const where = { ...filters };
      if (!isSuperAdmin) {
        // Use the authenticated user's tenant_id from the token
        if (req.user?.tenantId) {
          where.tenant_id = req.user.tenantId;
        }
      }
      // Super admin can see all users (no tenant_id filter)

      const result = await userService.findAll({
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        where: where,
        orderBy: [orderBy]
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: sanitizeUsers(result.data),
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: result.hasMore
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get user by ID
   * GET /api/v1/users/:id
   */
  async findById(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware
      
      const user = await userService.findById(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: sanitizeUser(user)
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get users by tenant_id
   * GET /api/v1/users/tenant/:tenant_id
   */
  async findByTenantId(req, res) {
    try {
      const { tenant_id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, orderBy = ['created_at', 'DESC'] } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
      
      const result = await userService.findByTenantId(tenant_id, {
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        orderBy: [orderBy]
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: sanitizeUsers(result.data),
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: result.hasMore
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create new user with tenant and role assignment
   * POST /api/v1/users
   */
  async create(req, res) {
    try {
      // req.body is already validated and transformed by validateCreate middleware
      // Get tenant_id from authenticated user if not provided in body
      const tenantId = req.body.tenant_id || req.user?.tenantId;
      // Add assigned_by from the authenticated user
      const userData = {
        ...req.body,
        assigned_by: req.user?.id || null,
        tenant_id: tenantId
      };
      
      const user = await userService.create(userData);

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: sanitizeUser(user),
        message: 'User created successfully with tenant and role assignment'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse,
        ...(error.errors && { details: error.errors }),
        ...(error.issues && { details: error.issues })
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update user
   * PUT /api/v1/users/:id
   */
  async update(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; 
      
      // Add assigned_by from authenticated user if not provided
      const updateData = {
        ...req.body,
        assigned_by: req.body.assigned_by || req.user?.id || null
      };
      
      const user = await userService.update(id, updateData);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: sanitizeUser(user),
        message: 'User updated successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse,
        ...(error.errors && { details: error.errors }),
        ...(error.issues && { details: error.issues })
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Delete user
   * DELETE /api/v1/users/:id
   */
  async delete(req, res) {
    try {

      await userService.delete(id);

      res.json({
        success: true,
        message: 'User deleted successfully'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({

      });

const userroleService = require('../services/user_role_service');
const { formatError, getErrorStatusCode } = require('../utils/errorFormatter');

class UserroleController {
  /**
   * Get all userroles
   * GET /api/v1/userroles
   */
  async findAll(req, res) {
    try {
      const { page = 1, limit = 100, ...filters } = req.query;
      const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
      
      const result = await userroleService.findAll({
        skip: parseInt(skip),
        take: parseInt(limit),
        where: filters,
        orderBy: [['created_at', 'DESC']]
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.data,
        pagination: {
          page: parseInt(page),
          limit: parseInt(limit),
          total: result.total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
          hasMore: result.hasMore
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const errorResponse = formatError(error);
      res.status(getErrorStatusCode(errorResponse)).json({
        success: false,
        error: errorResponse
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get userrole by ID
   * GET /api/v1/userroles/:id
   */
  async findById(req, res) {
    try {
      const { id } = req.params; // Already validated by validateParams middleware

      res.json({
        success: true,

      });
    } catch (error) {

          success: false,
        error: errorResponse
        });
    }
  }

  /**

/**
 * Webhook Controller - QAssure Platform

const { getWebhookService } = require('../services/webhook.service');

const webhookService = getWebhookService();

/**
 * Create webhook
 * POST /api/v1/webhooks
 */
const create = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const webhook = await webhookService.create(
      req.user?.tenantId,
      req.body,
      req.user?.id
    );

    res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      data: webhook,
      message: 'Webhook created. Please save the secret - it will not be shown again.'
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[WebhookController] create error:', error.message);
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'CREATE_FAILED', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * List webhooks
 * GET /api/v1/webhooks
 */
const list = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { status, eventType, page, limit } = req.query;

    const result = await webhookService.list(req.user?.tenantId, {
      status,
      eventType,
      page: parseInt(page) || 1,
      limit: parseInt(limit) || 20
    });

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      ...result
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[WebhookController] list error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'LIST_FAILED', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Get webhook by ID
 * GET /api/v1/webhooks/:id
 */
const getById = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const webhook = await webhookService.getById(
      req.params.id,
      req.user?.tenantId
    );

    if (!webhook) {
      return res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Webhook not found' }
      });
    }

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: webhook
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[WebhookController] getById error:', error.message);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'GET_FAILED', message: error.message }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Update webhook
 * PUT /api/v1/webhooks/:id
 */
const update = async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const webhook = await webhookService.update(
      req.params.id,
      req.user?.tenantId,
      req.body,
      req.user?.id
    );

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,

    });

      error: { code: 'UPDATE_FAILED', message: error.message }
    });
  }

/**
 * Workflow Controller
 * Handles workflow definitions, instances, and tasks
 */

const { getWorkflowDefinitionService } = require('../services/workflow-definition.service');
const { getWorkflowEngineService } = require('../services/workflow-engine.service');
const { getWorkflowTaskService } = require('../services/workflow-task.service');

class WorkflowController {

  // ============================================================================
  // WORKFLOW DEFINITIONS
  // ============================================================================

  /**
   * POST /api/v1/workflows/definitions
   */
  async createDefinition(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getWorkflowDefinitionService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const createdBy = req.user.id;

      const definition = await service.create(tenantId, req.body, createdBy);

      res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: definition
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Workflow] Create definition error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'CREATE_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/workflows/definitions
   */
  async listDefinitions(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getWorkflowDefinitionService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { entity_type, status, limit, offset } = req.query;

      const result = await service.list(tenantId, {
        entityType: entity_type,
        status,
        limit: parseInt(limit) || 50,
        offset: parseInt(offset) || 0
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: result.definitions,
        pagination: {
          total: result.total,
          limit: result.limit,
          offset: result.offset
        }
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Workflow] List definitions error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }

  /**
   * GET /api/v1/workflows/definitions/:id
   */
  async getDefinition(req, res) {
    try {
      const service = getWorkflowDefinitionService();
      const tenantId = req.user.tenantId;
      const { id } = req.params;

      const definition = await service.getById(id, tenantId);

      if (!definition) {
        return res.status(404).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Workflow definition not found' }
        });
      }

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: definition
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Workflow] Get definition error:', error.message);
      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'FETCH_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }

      const performedBy = req.user.id;
      const { id } = req.params;

      const instance = await service.transition({
        tenantId,
        instanceId: id,
        taskId: task_id,
        action,
        comments,
        signature: password ? { password, pin, ipAddress: req.ip, userAgent: req.get('User-Agent') } : null,
        performedBy
      });

      res.json({
        success: true,
        data: instance
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Workflow] Transition error:', error.message);

      if (error.message.includes('signature required')) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'SIGNATURE_REQUIRED', message: error.message }
        });
      }

      if (error.message.includes('not assigned')) {
        return res.status(403).json({
          success: false,
          error: { code: 'NOT_AUTHORIZED', message: error.message }
        });
      }

      res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'TRANSITION_ERROR', message: error.message }
      });
    }
  }
