/**
 * Anthropic Provider - QAssure Platform
 * Integration with Anthropic Claude API
 */
const Anthropic = require('@anthropic-ai/sdk');
const { BaseAIProvider } = require('./base-provider');
const { AIProviderError } = require('./openai.provider');

class AnthropicProvider extends BaseAIProvider {
  constructor(config = {}) {
    super(config);
    this.name = 'anthropic';
    this.displayName = 'Anthropic Claude';
    this.client = null;
    
    this.models = [
      'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',
      'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022',
      'claude-3-5-haiku-20241022',
      'claude-3-opus-20240229',
      'claude-3-sonnet-20240229',
      'claude-3-haiku-20240307'
    ];
    
    this.defaultModel = 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514';
    
    // Pricing per 1K tokens (USD)
    this.pricing = {
      'claude-sonnet-4-20250514': { input: 0.003, output: 0.015 },
      'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022': { input: 0.003, output: 0.015 },
      'claude-3-5-haiku-20241022': { input: 0.0008, output: 0.004 },
      'claude-3-opus-20240229': { input: 0.015, output: 0.075 },
      'claude-3-sonnet-20240229': { input: 0.003, output: 0.015 },
      'claude-3-haiku-20240307': { input: 0.00025, output: 0.00125 }
    };
  }

  /**
   * Initialize the Anthropic client
   */
  async initialize() {
    const apiKey = this.config.apiKey || process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY;
    
    if (!apiKey) {
      console.warn('[Anthropic] No API key configured - provider disabled');
      this.isEnabled = false;
      return false;
    }

    try {
      this.client = new Anthropic({
        apiKey,
        timeout: this.config.timeout || 60000,
        maxRetries: this.config.maxRetries || 2
      });
      
      this.isEnabled = true;
      console.log('[Anthropic] ✅ Provider initialized');
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Anthropic] ❌ Failed to initialize:', error.message);
      this.isEnabled = false;
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Health check - verify API connectivity
   */
  async healthCheck() {
    if (!this.isEnabled || !this.client) {
      return { healthy: false, error: 'Provider not initialized' };
    }

    try {
      const start = Date.now();
      
      // Simple completion to verify connectivity
      await this.client.messages.create({
        model: 'claude-3-haiku-20240307',
        max_tokens: 10,
        messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hi' }]
      });
      
      const latency = Date.now() - start;
      
      return {
        healthy: true,
        latency_ms: latency,
        provider: this.name
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        healthy: false,
        error: error.message,
        provider: this.name
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create a chat completion
   */
  async createCompletion(options) {
    if (!this.isEnabled || !this.client) {
      throw new Error('Anthropic provider is not enabled');
    }

    const errors = this.validateOptions(options);
    if (errors.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(`Validation failed: ${errors.join(', ')}`);
    }

    const model = options.model || this.defaultModel;
    const start = Date.now();

    try {
      // Convert messages to Anthropic format
      const { system, messages } = this._convertMessages(options.messages);

      const requestParams = {
        model,
        max_tokens: options.max_tokens || 2048,
        messages,
        temperature: options.temperature ?? 0.7,
        top_p: options.top_p ?? 1,
        stop_sequences: options.stop || undefined
      };

      // Add system message if present
      if (system) {
        requestParams.system = system;
      }

      const response = await this.client.messages.create(requestParams);

      const latency = Date.now() - start;
      const inputTokens = response.usage?.input_tokens || 0;
      const outputTokens = response.usage?.output_tokens || 0;
      const cost = this.calculateCost(model, inputTokens, outputTokens);

      return this.formatResponse({
        id: response.id,
        content: response.content[0]?.text || '',
        usage: {
          prompt_tokens: inputTokens,
          completion_tokens: outputTokens,
          total_tokens: inputTokens + outputTokens
        },
        finish_reason: response.stop_reason
      }, {
        model,
        cost,
        latency_ms: latency
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Anthropic] Completion error:', error.message);
      throw this._handleError(error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create a streaming completion
   */
  async createStreamingCompletion(options, onChunk) {
    if (!this.isEnabled || !this.client) {
      throw new Error('Anthropic provider is not enabled');
    }

    const model = options.model || this.defaultModel;
    const start = Date.now();
    let fullContent = '';

    try {
      const { system, messages } = this._convertMessages(options.messages);

      const requestParams = {
        model,
        max_tokens: options.max_tokens || 2048,
        messages,
        temperature: options.temperature ?? 0.7,
        stream: true
      };

      if (system) {
        requestParams.system = system;
      }

      const stream = await this.client.messages.stream(requestParams);

      for await (const event of stream) {
        if (event.type === 'content_block_delta') {
          const content = event.delta?.text || '';
          fullContent += content;
          
          if (onChunk && content) {
            onChunk({
              content,
              done: false
            });
          }
        }
      }

      const latency = Date.now() - start;
      
      if (onChunk) {
        onChunk({
          content: '',
          done: true,
          fullContent,
          latency_ms: latency
        });
      }

      return {
        content: fullContent,
        model,
        provider: this.name,
        latency_ms: latency
      };
    } catch (error) {
      throw this._handleError(error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Convert OpenAI-style messages to Anthropic format
   */
  _convertMessages(messages) {
    let system = null;
    const convertedMessages = [];

    for (const msg of messages) {
      if (msg.role === 'system') {
        system = msg.content;
      } else {
        convertedMessages.push({
          role: msg.role === 'assistant' ? 'assistant' : 'user',
          content: msg.content
        });
      }
    }

    // Anthropic requires alternating user/assistant messages
    // and must start with user message
    const validatedMessages = this._validateMessageOrder(convertedMessages);

    return { system, messages: validatedMessages };
  }

  /**
   * Ensure messages alternate and start with user
   */
  _validateMessageOrder(messages) {
    if (messages.length === 0) {
      return [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }];
    }

    const validated = [];
    let lastRole = null;

    for (const msg of messages) {
      // Skip consecutive messages of same role
      if (msg.role === lastRole) {
        // Merge content for same role
        validated[validated.length - 1].content += '\n' + msg.content;
        continue;
      }
      
      // If first message is assistant, prepend empty user message
      if (validated.length === 0 && msg.role === 'assistant') {
        validated.push({ role: 'user', content: '...' });
      }
      
      validated.push(msg);
      lastRole = msg.role;
    }

    return validated;
  }

  /**
   * Create embeddings (Anthropic doesn't support embeddings directly)
   */
  async createEmbedding(input) {
    throw new AIProviderError(
      'NOT_SUPPORTED',
      'Anthropic does not support embeddings. Use OpenAI or another provider.',
      this.name
    );
  }

  /**
   * Handle and transform errors
   */
  _handleError(error) {
    if (error.status === 429) {
      return new AIProviderError('RATE_LIMITED', 'Anthropic rate limit exceeded', this.name);
    }
    if (error.status === 401) {
      return new AIProviderError('AUTH_FAILED', 'Anthropic authentication failed', this.name);
    }
    if (error.status === 503 || error.status === 529) {
      return new AIProviderError('SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE', 'Anthropic service unavailable', this.name);
    }
    if (error.code === 'ECONNREFUSED' || error.code === 'ETIMEDOUT') {
      return new AIProviderError('CONNECTION_FAILED', 'Failed to connect to Anthropic', this.name);
    }
    
    return new AIProviderError('PROVIDER_ERROR', error.message, this.name);
  }
}

module.exports = { AnthropicProvider };


========== FILE: ./src/infrastructure/ai/base-provider.js ==========
/**
 * Base AI Provider - QAssure Platform
 * Abstract base class for all AI providers
 */

class BaseAIProvider {
  constructor(config = {}) {
    this.name = 'base';
    this.displayName = 'Base Provider';
    this.config = config;
    this.isEnabled = false;
    this.models = [];
    this.defaultModel = null;
  }

  /**
   * Initialize the provider
   */
  async initialize() {
    throw new Error('Method initialize() must be implemented');
  }

  /**
   * Check if provider is healthy
   */
  async healthCheck() {
    throw new Error('Method healthCheck() must be implemented');
  }

  /**
   * Create a chat completion
   */
  async createCompletion(options) {
    throw new Error('Method createCompletion() must be implemented');
  }

  /**
   * Create embeddings
   */
  async createEmbedding(text) {
    throw new Error('Method createEmbedding() must be implemented');
  }

  /**
   * Get available models
   */
  getModels() {
    return this.models;
  }

  /**
   * Get default model
   */
  getDefaultModel() {
    return this.defaultModel;
  }

  /**
   * Calculate cost for tokens
   */
  calculateCost(model, inputTokens, outputTokens) {
    const pricing = this.getPricing(model);
    if (!pricing) return 0;
    
    const inputCost = (inputTokens / 1000) * pricing.input;
    const outputCost = (outputTokens / 1000) * pricing.output;
    return inputCost + outputCost;
  }

  /**
   * Get pricing for a model (per 1K tokens)
   */
  getPricing(model) {
    return this.pricing?.[model] || null;
  }

  /**
   * Get provider info
   */
  getInfo() {
    return {
      name: this.name,
      displayName: this.displayName,
      isEnabled: this.isEnabled,
      models: this.models,
      defaultModel: this.defaultModel
    };
  }

  /**
   * Validate completion options
   */
  validateOptions(options) {
    const errors = [];
    
    if (!options.messages || !Array.isArray(options.messages)) {
      errors.push('messages must be an array');
    }
    
    if (options.messages?.length === 0) {
      errors.push('messages cannot be empty');
    }
    
    if (options.temperature !== undefined) {
      if (options.temperature < 0 || options.temperature > 2) {
        errors.push('temperature must be between 0 and 2');
      }
    }
    
    if (options.max_tokens !== undefined) {
      if (options.max_tokens < 1) {
        errors.push('max_tokens must be at least 1');
      }
    }
    
    return errors;
  }

  /**
   * Format response to standard structure
   */
  formatResponse(rawResponse, metadata = {}) {
    return {
      id: rawResponse.id || `${this.name}_${Date.now()}`,
      provider: this.name,
      model: metadata.model || this.defaultModel,
      content: rawResponse.content || '',
      usage: {
        prompt_tokens: rawResponse.usage?.prompt_tokens || 0,
        completion_tokens: rawResponse.usage?.completion_tokens || 0,
        total_tokens: rawResponse.usage?.total_tokens || 0
      },
      cost: metadata.cost || 0,
      latency_ms: metadata.latency_ms || 0,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      raw: rawResponse
    };
  }
}

module.exports = { BaseAIProvider };

/**
 * Text Chunker Service - QAssure Platform
 * Splits documents into chunks for embedding
 */

class ChunkerService {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.chunkSize = options.chunkSize || 512;      // tokens (approx 4 chars per token)
    this.chunkOverlap = options.chunkOverlap || 50;  // overlap between chunks
    this.minChunkSize = options.minChunkSize || 100;
    this.separators = options.separators || ['\n\n', '\n', '. ', '! ', '? ', '; ', ', ', ' '];
  }

  /**
   * Split text into chunks
   */
  chunk(text, options = {}) {
    const chunkSize = options.chunkSize || this.chunkSize;
    const chunkOverlap = options.chunkOverlap || this.chunkOverlap;
    const charLimit = chunkSize * 4; // Approximate chars per chunk

    if (!text || text.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    // If text is smaller than chunk size, return as single chunk
    if (text.length <= charLimit) {
      return [{
        content: text,
        index: 0,
        start: 0,
        end: text.length,
        charCount: text.length,
        tokenEstimate: Math.ceil(text.length / 4)
      }];
    }

    const chunks = [];
    let start = 0;
    let index = 0;

    while (start < text.length) {
      let end = start + charLimit;

      // Don't exceed text length
      if (end >= text.length) {
        end = text.length;
      } else {
        // Find best split point
        end = this.findSplitPoint(text, start, end);
      }

      const chunkText = text.slice(start, end).trim();
      
      if (chunkText.length >= this.minChunkSize) {
        chunks.push({
          content: chunkText,
          index,
          start,
          end,
          charCount: chunkText.length,
          tokenEstimate: Math.ceil(chunkText.length / 4)
        });
        index++;
      }

      // Move start position with overlap
      const overlapChars = chunkOverlap * 4;
      start = end - overlapChars;
      
      // Ensure we make progress
      if (start <= chunks[chunks.length - 1]?.start) {
        start = end;
      }
    }

    return chunks;
  }

  /**
   * Find best split point near target position
   */
  findSplitPoint(text, start, targetEnd) {
    const searchStart = Math.max(start, targetEnd - 200);
    const searchEnd = Math.min(text.length, targetEnd + 100);
    const searchText = text.slice(searchStart, searchEnd);

    // Try each separator in order of preference
    for (const separator of this.separators) {
      const lastIndex = searchText.lastIndexOf(separator);
      if (lastIndex !== -1) {
        const splitPoint = searchStart + lastIndex + separator.length;
        if (splitPoint > start + this.minChunkSize) {
          return splitPoint;
        }
      }
    }

    // No good split point found, use target
    return targetEnd;
  }

  /**
   * Chunk by paragraphs
   */
  chunkByParagraphs(text, options = {}) {
    const maxChunkSize = (options.chunkSize || this.chunkSize) * 4;
    const paragraphs = text.split(/\n\n+/);
    const chunks = [];
    let currentChunk = '';
    let index = 0;

    for (const paragraph of paragraphs) {
      const trimmed = paragraph.trim();
      if (!trimmed) continue;

      if (currentChunk.length + trimmed.length + 2 <= maxChunkSize) {
        currentChunk += (currentChunk ? '\n\n' : '') + trimmed;
      } else {
        if (currentChunk) {
          chunks.push({
            content: currentChunk,
            index: index++,
            charCount: currentChunk.length,
            tokenEstimate: Math.ceil(currentChunk.length / 4)
          });
        }
        
        // If single paragraph is too large, split it
        if (trimmed.length > maxChunkSize) {
          const subChunks = this.chunk(trimmed, options);
          for (const subChunk of subChunks) {
            subChunk.index = index++;
            chunks.push(subChunk);
          }
          currentChunk = '';
        } else {
          currentChunk = trimmed;
        }
      }
    }

    // Add remaining chunk
    if (currentChunk) {
      chunks.push({
        content: currentChunk,
        index: index++,
        charCount: currentChunk.length,
        tokenEstimate: Math.ceil(currentChunk.length / 4)
      });
    }

    return chunks;
  }

  /**
   * Chunk by sentences
   */
  chunkBySentences(text, options = {}) {
    const maxChunkSize = (options.chunkSize || this.chunkSize) * 4;
    const sentenceRegex = /[^.!?]+[.!?]+/g;
    const sentences = text.match(sentenceRegex) || [text];
    const chunks = [];
    let currentChunk = '';
    let index = 0;

    for (const sentence of sentences) {
      const trimmed = sentence.trim();
      if (!trimmed) continue;

      if (currentChunk.length + trimmed.length + 1 <= maxChunkSize) {
        currentChunk += (currentChunk ? ' ' : '') + trimmed;
      } else {
        if (currentChunk) {
          chunks.push({
            content: currentChunk,
            index: index++,
            charCount: currentChunk.length,
            tokenEstimate: Math.ceil(currentChunk.length / 4)
          });
        }
        currentChunk = trimmed;
      }
    }

    if (currentChunk) {
      chunks.push({
        content: currentChunk,
        index: index++,
        charCount: currentChunk.length,
        tokenEstimate: Math.ceil(currentChunk.length / 4)
      });
    }

    return chunks;
  }

  /**
   * Add metadata to chunks
   */
  addMetadata(chunks, metadata = {}) {
    return chunks.map(chunk => ({
      ...chunk,
      metadata: {
        ...metadata,
        chunkIndex: chunk.index,
        totalChunks: chunks.length
      }
    }));
  }

  /**
   * Estimate tokens for text
   */
  estimateTokens(text) {
    return Math.ceil(text.length / 4);
  }
}

// Singleton
let instance = null;
const getChunkerService = () => {
  if (!instance) {
    instance = new ChunkerService();
  }
  return instance;
};

module.exports = { ChunkerService, getChunkerService };

/**
 * Document Processor - QAssure Platform
 * Extracts text from PDF, DOCX, and text files
 */
const fs = require('fs').promises;
const path = require('path');
const pdfParse = require('pdf-parse');
const mammoth = require('mammoth');

class DocumentProcessor {
  constructor() {
    this.supportedTypes = ['.pdf', '.docx', '.doc', '.txt', '.md', '.json'];
    this.maxFileSize = 50 * 1024 * 1024; // 50MB
  }

  /**
   * Process a document and extract text
   */
  async process(filePath) {
    const ext = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
    const fileName = path.basename(filePath);

    if (!this.supportedTypes.includes(ext)) {
      throw new Error(`Unsupported file type: ${ext}`);
    }

    const stats = await fs.stat(filePath);
    if (stats.size > this.maxFileSize) {
      throw new Error(`File too large: ${stats.size} bytes (max: ${this.maxFileSize})`);
    }

    let text = '';
    let metadata = {
      fileName,
      fileType: ext,
      fileSize: stats.size,
      processedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    switch (ext) {
      case '.pdf':
        const pdfResult = await this.processPDF(filePath);
        text = pdfResult.text;
        metadata = { ...metadata, ...pdfResult.metadata };
        break;

      case '.docx':
      case '.doc':
        const docResult = await this.processDOCX(filePath);
        text = docResult.text;
        metadata = { ...metadata, ...docResult.metadata };
        break;

      case '.txt':
      case '.md':
        text = await this.processText(filePath);
        break;

      case '.json':
        text = await this.processJSON(filePath);
        break;
    }

    return {
      text: this.cleanText(text),
      metadata,
      charCount: text.length,
      wordCount: this.countWords(text)
    };
  }

  /**
   * Process PDF file
   */
  async processPDF(filePath) {
    const buffer = await fs.readFile(filePath);
    const data = await pdfParse(buffer);

    return {
      text: data.text,
      metadata: {
        pageCount: data.numpages,
        pdfInfo: data.info,
        pdfVersion: data.version
      }
    };
  }

  /**
   * Process DOCX file
   */
  async processDOCX(filePath) {
    const buffer = await fs.readFile(filePath);
    const result = await mammoth.extractRawText({ buffer });

    return {
      text: result.value,
      metadata: {
        warnings: result.messages
      }
    };
  }

  /**
   * Process plain text file
   */
  async processText(filePath) {
    return await fs.readFile(filePath, 'utf-8');
  }

  /**
   * Process JSON file
   */
  async processJSON(filePath) {
    const content = await fs.readFile(filePath, 'utf-8');
    const json = JSON.parse(content);
    return JSON.stringify(json, null, 2);
  }

  /**
   * Process buffer directly
   */
  async processBuffer(buffer, mimeType, fileName = 'document') {
    let text = '';
    let metadata = {
      fileName,
      fileType: mimeType,
      fileSize: buffer.length,
      processedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    switch (mimeType) {
      case 'application/pdf':
        const pdfData = await pdfParse(buffer);
        text = pdfData.text;
        metadata.pageCount = pdfData.numpages;
        break;

      case 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document':
      case 'application/msword':
        const docResult = await mammoth.extractRawText({ buffer });
        text = docResult.value;
        break;

      case 'text/plain':
      case 'text/markdown':
        text = buffer.toString('utf-8');
        break;

      case 'application/json':
        text = buffer.toString('utf-8');
        break;

      default:
        throw new Error(`Unsupported mime type: ${mimeType}`);
    }

    return {
      text: this.cleanText(text),
      metadata,
      charCount: text.length,
      wordCount: this.countWords(text)
    };
  }

  /**
   * Clean extracted text
   */
  cleanText(text) {
    return text
      .replace(/\r\n/g, '\n')           // Normalize line endings
      .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')       // Remove excessive newlines
      .replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ')          // Normalize spaces
      .replace(/^\s+|\s+$/gm, '')       // Trim lines
      .trim();
  }

  /**
   * Count words in text
   */
  countWords(text) {
    return text.split(/\s+/).filter(word => word.length > 0).length;
  }

  /**
   * Check if file type is supported
   */
  isSupported(filePath) {
    const ext = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
    return this.supportedTypes.includes(ext);
  }

  /**
   * Get supported file types
   */
  getSupportedTypes() {
    return this.supportedTypes;
  }
}

// Singleton
let instance = null;
const getDocumentProcessor = () => {
  if (!instance) {
    instance = new DocumentProcessor();
  }
  return instance;
};

module.exports = { DocumentProcessor, getDocumentProcessor };

/**
 * Embedding Service - QAssure Platform
 * Generates text embeddings using OpenAI
 */
const { getAIGateway } = require('./gateway.service');

class EmbeddingService {
  constructor() {
    this.gateway = null;
    this.defaultModel = 'text-embedding-3-small';
    this.dimensions = 1536;
  }

  /**
   * Initialize the embedding service
   */
  async initialize() {
    this.gateway = getAIGateway();
    await this.gateway.initialize();
    console.log('[EmbeddingService] ✅ Initialized');
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Generate embeddings for text
   */
  async embed(text, options = {}) {
    if (!this.gateway) {
      await this.initialize();
    }

    const model = options.model || this.defaultModel;

    try {
      const result = await this.gateway.createEmbedding(text, { model });
      return {
        embedding: result.embeddings[0],
        model: result.model,
        usage: result.usage
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[EmbeddingService] Error:', error.message);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Generate embeddings for multiple texts
   */
  async embedBatch(texts, options = {}) {
    if (!this.gateway) {
      await this.initialize();
    }

    const model = options.model || this.defaultModel;

    try {
      const result = await this.gateway.createEmbedding(texts, { model });
      return {
        embeddings: result.embeddings,
        model: result.model,
        usage: result.usage
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[EmbeddingService] Batch error:', error.message);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Calculate cosine similarity between two vectors
   */
  cosineSimilarity(vecA, vecB) {
    if (vecA.length !== vecB.length) {
      throw new Error('Vectors must have same dimensions');
    }

    let dotProduct = 0;
    let normA = 0;
    let normB = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < vecA.length; i++) {
      dotProduct += vecA[i] * vecB[i];
      normA += vecA[i] * vecA[i];
      normB += vecB[i] * vecB[i];
    }

    normA = Math.sqrt(normA);
    normB = Math.sqrt(normB);

    if (normA === 0 || normB === 0) {
      return 0;
    }

    return dotProduct / (normA * normB);
  }

  /**
   * Find most similar embeddings
   */
  findSimilar(queryEmbedding, embeddings, topK = 5) {
    const similarities = embeddings.map((emb, index) => ({
      index,
      score: this.cosineSimilarity(queryEmbedding, emb.embedding),
      ...emb
    }));

    return similarities
      .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
      .slice(0, topK);
  }
}

// Singleton
let instance = null;
const getEmbeddingService = () => {
  if (!instance) {
    instance = new EmbeddingService();
  }
  return instance;
};

module.exports = { EmbeddingService, getEmbeddingService };

/**
 * AI Gateway Service - QAssure Platform
 * Orchestrates multiple AI providers with routing, fallback, and cost tracking
 */
const { OpenAIProvider, AIProviderError } = require('./openai.provider');
const { AnthropicProvider } = require('./anthropic.provider');
const { getEventService } = require('../kafka');

class AIGatewayService {
  constructor() {
    this.providers = new Map();
    this.defaultProvider = null;
    this.fallbackOrder = [];
    this.initialized = false;
    this.eventService = null;
  }

  /**
   * Initialize all configured providers
   */
  async initialize() {
    if (this.initialized) return true;

    console.log('[AIGateway] Initializing providers...');

    // Initialize OpenAI
    const openai = new OpenAIProvider();
    if (await openai.initialize()) {
      this.providers.set('openai', openai);
    }

    // Initialize Anthropic
    const anthropic = new AnthropicProvider();
    if (await anthropic.initialize()) {
      this.providers.set('anthropic', anthropic);
    }

    // Set default provider and fallback order
    if (this.providers.has('openai')) {
      this.defaultProvider = 'openai';
      this.fallbackOrder = ['openai', 'anthropic'];
    } else if (this.providers.has('anthropic')) {
      this.defaultProvider = 'anthropic';
      this.fallbackOrder = ['anthropic'];
    }

    // Get event service for publishing
    try {
      this.eventService = getEventService();
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[AIGateway] Event service not available');
    }

    this.initialized = true;
    console.log(`[AIGateway] ✅ Initialized with ${this.providers.size} provider(s)`);
    console.log(`[AIGateway] Default: ${this.defaultProvider}, Fallback: ${this.fallbackOrder.join(' → ')}`);

    return this.providers.size > 0;
  }

  /**
   * Get all available providers
   */
  getProviders() {
    const providers = [];
    for (const [name, provider] of this.providers) {
      providers.push({
        name,
        ...provider.getInfo()
      });
    }
    return providers;
  }

  /**
   * Get a specific provider
   */
  getProvider(name) {
    return this.providers.get(name);
  }

  /**
   * Get all available models across providers
   */
  getAllModels() {
    const models = [];
    for (const [providerName, provider] of this.providers) {
      for (const model of provider.models) {
        models.push({
          id: model,
          provider: providerName,
          isDefault: model === provider.defaultModel,
          pricing: provider.getPricing(model)
        });
      }
    }
    return models;
  }

  /**
   * Health check all providers
   */
  async healthCheck() {
    const results = {};
    
    for (const [name, provider] of this.providers) {
      results[name] = await provider.healthCheck();
    }

    const healthyCount = Object.values(results).filter(r => r.healthy).length;
    
    return {
      healthy: healthyCount > 0,
      providers: results,
      healthyCount,
      totalCount: this.providers.size
    };
  }

  /**
   * Create a completion with automatic provider selection and fallback
   */
  async createCompletion(options, context = {}) {
    if (!this.initialized) {
      await this.initialize();
    }

    if (this.providers.size === 0) {
      throw new AIProviderError('NO_PROVIDERS', 'No AI providers available', 'gateway');
    }

    // Determine provider order
    let providerOrder = [...this.fallbackOrder];
    
    // If specific provider requested, try it first
    if (options.provider && this.providers.has(options.provider)) {
      providerOrder = [options.provider, ...providerOrder.filter(p => p !== options.provider)];
    }

    // If specific model requested, find its provider
    if (options.model) {
      const modelProvider = this._findProviderForModel(options.model);
      if (modelProvider) {
        providerOrder = [modelProvider, ...providerOrder.filter(p => p !== modelProvider)];
      }
    }

    // Try each provider in order
    const errors = [];
    
    for (const providerName of providerOrder) {
      const provider = this.providers.get(providerName);
      if (!provider || !provider.isEnabled) continue;

      try {
        console.log(`[AIGateway] Trying provider: ${providerName}`);
        
        const result = await provider.createCompletion({
          ...options,
          model: options.model || provider.defaultModel
        });

        // Record success metrics
        this._recordCompletion(result, context);

        return {
          ...result,
          fallbackUsed: providerName !== providerOrder[0]
        };
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn(`[AIGateway] Provider ${providerName} failed:`, error.message);
        errors.push({ provider: providerName, error: error.message });
        
        // Don't fallback for validation errors
        if (error.code === 'VALIDATION_ERROR') {
          throw error;
        }
        
        // Continue to next provider
      }
    }

    // All providers failed
    throw new AIProviderError(
      'ALL_PROVIDERS_FAILED',
      `All providers failed: ${errors.map(e => `${e.provider}: ${e.error}`).join('; ')}`,
      'gateway'
    );
  }

  /**
   * Create a streaming completion
   */
  async createStreamingCompletion(options, onChunk, context = {}) {
    if (!this.initialized) {
      await this.initialize();
    }

    const providerName = options.provider || this.defaultProvider;
    const provider = this.providers.get(providerName);

    if (!provider || !provider.isEnabled) {
      throw new AIProviderError('PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE', `Provider ${providerName} is not available`, 'gateway');
    }

    return provider.createStreamingCompletion(options, onChunk);
  }

  /**
   * Create embeddings
   */
  async createEmbedding(input, options = {}) {
    if (!this.initialized) {
      await this.initialize();
    }

    // OpenAI is preferred for embeddings
    const providerName = options.provider || 'openai';
    const provider = this.providers.get(providerName);

    if (!provider || !provider.isEnabled) {
      throw new AIProviderError('PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE', `Provider ${providerName} is not available for embeddings`, 'gateway');
    }

    return provider.createEmbedding(input, options.model);
  }

  /**
   * Calculate estimated cost for a request
   */
  estimateCost(provider, model, inputTokens, outputTokens) {
    const prov = this.providers.get(provider);
    if (!prov) return 0;
    return prov.calculateCost(model, inputTokens, outputTokens);
  }

  /**
   * Find which provider offers a specific model
   */
  _findProviderForModel(model) {
    for (const [name, provider] of this.providers) {
      if (provider.models.includes(model)) {
        return name;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * Record completion for metrics and events
   */
  async _recordCompletion(result, context) {
    try {
      // Publish event if available
      if (this.eventService) {
        await this.eventService.producer.publish('qassure.ai.events', {
          type: 'ai.completion.success',
          data: {
            provider: result.provider,
            model: result.model,
            tokens: result.usage.total_tokens,
            cost: result.cost,
            latency_ms: result.latency_ms,
            tenantId: context.tenantId,
            userId: context.userId
          },
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // Don't fail completion for event publishing errors
      console.warn('[AIGateway] Failed to record completion event:', err.message);
    }
  }
}

// Singleton
let instance = null;
const getAIGateway = () => {
  if (!instance) {
    instance = new AIGatewayService();
  }
  return instance;
};

module.exports = { AIGatewayService, getAIGateway };

/**
 * OpenAI Provider - QAssure Platform
 * Integration with OpenAI API
 */
const OpenAI = require('openai');
const { BaseAIProvider } = require('./base-provider');

class OpenAIProvider extends BaseAIProvider {
  constructor(config = {}) {
    super(config);
    this.name = 'openai';
    this.displayName = 'OpenAI';
    this.client = null;
    
    this.models = [
      'gpt-4o',
      'gpt-4o-mini',
      'gpt-4-turbo',
      'gpt-4',
      'gpt-3.5-turbo',
      'gpt-3.5-turbo-16k'
    ];
    
    this.defaultModel = 'gpt-4o-mini';
    
    // Pricing per 1K tokens (USD)
    this.pricing = {
      'gpt-4o': { input: 0.005, output: 0.015 },
      'gpt-4o-mini': { input: 0.00015, output: 0.0006 },
      'gpt-4-turbo': { input: 0.01, output: 0.03 },
      'gpt-4': { input: 0.03, output: 0.06 },
      'gpt-3.5-turbo': { input: 0.0005, output: 0.0015 },
      'gpt-3.5-turbo-16k': { input: 0.003, output: 0.004 }
    };
    
    // Embedding models
    this.embeddingModels = ['text-embedding-ada-002', 'text-embedding-3-small', 'text-embedding-3-large'];
    this.defaultEmbeddingModel = 'text-embedding-3-small';
  }

  /**
   * Initialize the OpenAI client
   */
  async initialize() {
    const apiKey = this.config.apiKey || process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;
    
    if (!apiKey) {
      console.warn('[OpenAI] No API key configured - provider disabled');
      this.isEnabled = false;
      return false;
    }

    try {
      this.client = new OpenAI({
        apiKey,
        timeout: this.config.timeout || 60000,
        maxRetries: this.config.maxRetries || 2
      });
      
      this.isEnabled = true;
      console.log('[OpenAI] ✅ Provider initialized');
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[OpenAI] ❌ Failed to initialize:', error.message);
      this.isEnabled = false;
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Health check - verify API connectivity
   */
  async healthCheck() {
    if (!this.isEnabled || !this.client) {
      return { healthy: false, error: 'Provider not initialized' };
    }

    try {
      const start = Date.now();
      await this.client.models.list();
      const latency = Date.now() - start;
      
      return {
        healthy: true,
        latency_ms: latency,
        provider: this.name
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        healthy: false,
        error: error.message,
        provider: this.name
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create a chat completion
   */
  async createCompletion(options) {
    if (!this.isEnabled || !this.client) {
      throw new Error('OpenAI provider is not enabled');
    }

    const errors = this.validateOptions(options);
    if (errors.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(`Validation failed: ${errors.join(', ')}`);
    }

    const model = options.model || this.defaultModel;
    const start = Date.now();

    try {
      const response = await this.client.chat.completions.create({
        model,
        messages: options.messages,
        temperature: options.temperature ?? 0.7,
        max_tokens: options.max_tokens || 2048,
        top_p: options.top_p ?? 1,
        frequency_penalty: options.frequency_penalty ?? 0,
        presence_penalty: options.presence_penalty ?? 0,
        stop: options.stop || null,
        stream: false
      });

      const latency = Date.now() - start;
      const usage = response.usage || {};
      const cost = this.calculateCost(model, usage.prompt_tokens || 0, usage.completion_tokens || 0);

      return this.formatResponse({
        id: response.id,
        content: response.choices[0]?.message?.content || '',
        usage: {
          prompt_tokens: usage.prompt_tokens || 0,
          completion_tokens: usage.completion_tokens || 0,
          total_tokens: usage.total_tokens || 0
        },
        finish_reason: response.choices[0]?.finish_reason
      }, {
        model,
        cost,
        latency_ms: latency
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[OpenAI] Completion error:', error.message);
      throw this._handleError(error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create a streaming completion
   */
  async createStreamingCompletion(options, onChunk) {
    if (!this.isEnabled || !this.client) {
      throw new Error('OpenAI provider is not enabled');
    }

    const model = options.model || this.defaultModel;
    const start = Date.now();
    let fullContent = '';

    try {
      const stream = await this.client.chat.completions.create({
        model,
        messages: options.messages,
        temperature: options.temperature ?? 0.7,
        max_tokens: options.max_tokens || 2048,
        stream: true
      });

      for await (const chunk of stream) {
        const content = chunk.choices[0]?.delta?.content || '';
        fullContent += content;
        
        if (onChunk && content) {
          onChunk({
            content,
            done: false
          });
        }
      }

      const latency = Date.now() - start;
      
      if (onChunk) {
        onChunk({
          content: '',
          done: true,
          fullContent,
          latency_ms: latency
        });
      }

      return {
        content: fullContent,
        model,
        provider: this.name,
        latency_ms: latency
      };
    } catch (error) {
      throw this._handleError(error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create embeddings
   */
  async createEmbedding(input, model = null) {
    if (!this.isEnabled || !this.client) {
      throw new Error('OpenAI provider is not enabled');
    }

    const embeddingModel = model || this.defaultEmbeddingModel;

    try {
      const response = await this.client.embeddings.create({
        model: embeddingModel,
        input: Array.isArray(input) ? input : [input]
      });

      return {
        embeddings: response.data.map(d => d.embedding),
        model: embeddingModel,
        usage: response.usage,
        provider: this.name
      };
    } catch (error) {
      throw this._handleError(error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Handle and transform errors
   */
  _handleError(error) {
    if (error.status === 429) {
      return new AIProviderError('RATE_LIMITED', 'OpenAI rate limit exceeded', this.name);
    }
    if (error.status === 401) {
      return new AIProviderError('AUTH_FAILED', 'OpenAI authentication failed', this.name);
    }
    if (error.status === 503) {
      return new AIProviderError('SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE', 'OpenAI service unavailable', this.name);
    }
    if (error.code === 'ECONNREFUSED' || error.code === 'ETIMEDOUT') {
      return new AIProviderError('CONNECTION_FAILED', 'Failed to connect to OpenAI', this.name);
    }
    
    return new AIProviderError('PROVIDER_ERROR', error.message, this.name);
  }
}

/**
 * AI Provider Error
 */
class AIProviderError extends Error {
  constructor(code, message, provider) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'AIProviderError';
    this.code = code;
    this.provider = provider;
  }
}

module.exports = { OpenAIProvider, AIProviderError };

/**
 * Vector Store Service - QAssure Platform
 * Manages vector storage using Pinecone
 */
const { Pinecone } = require('@pinecone-database/pinecone');
const crypto = require('crypto');

class VectorStoreService {
  constructor() {
    this.client = null;
    this.index = null;
    this.indexName = process.env.PINECONE_INDEX_NAME || 'qassure-knowledge';
    this.namespace = process.env.PINECONE_NAMESPACE || 'default';
    this.initialized = false;
  }

  /**
   * Initialize Pinecone connection
   */
  async initialize() {
    if (this.initialized) return true;

    const apiKey = process.env.PINECONE_API_KEY;

    if (!apiKey) {
      console.warn('[VectorStore] No Pinecone API key configured - using in-memory fallback');
      this.useInMemory = true;
      this.inMemoryStore = new Map();
      this.initialized = true;
      return true;
    }

    try {
      this.client = new Pinecone({ apiKey });
      this.index = this.client.index(this.indexName);
      this.initialized = true;
      console.log('[VectorStore] ✅ Connected to Pinecone');
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[VectorStore] ❌ Failed to connect:', error.message);
      // Fallback to in-memory
      this.useInMemory = true;
      this.inMemoryStore = new Map();
      this.initialized = true;
      return true;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Upsert vectors into the store
   */
  async upsert(vectors, namespace = null) {
    if (!this.initialized) await this.initialize();

    const ns = namespace || this.namespace;

    if (this.useInMemory) {
      return this._inMemoryUpsert(vectors, ns);
    }

    try {
      const records = vectors.map(v => ({
        id: v.id || crypto.randomUUID(),
        values: v.embedding,
        metadata: v.metadata || {}
      }));

      // Batch upsert (Pinecone limit is 100 per request)
      const batchSize = 100;
      for (let i = 0; i < records.length; i += batchSize) {
        const batch = records.slice(i, i + batchSize);
        await this.index.namespace(ns).upsert(batch);
      }

      console.log(`[VectorStore] Upserted ${records.length} vectors to namespace: ${ns}`);
      return { success: true, count: records.length };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[VectorStore] Upsert error:', error.message);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Query similar vectors
   */
  async query(embedding, options = {}) {
    if (!this.initialized) await this.initialize();

    const {
      topK = 5,
      namespace = this.namespace,
      filter = null,
      includeMetadata = true,
      includeValues = false,
      minScore = 0.0
    } = options;

    if (this.useInMemory) {
      return this._inMemoryQuery(embedding, { topK, namespace, minScore });
    }

    try {
      const queryResponse = await this.index.namespace(namespace).query({
        vector: embedding,
        topK,
        filter,
        includeMetadata,
        includeValues
      });

      const results = queryResponse.matches
        .filter(match => match.score >= minScore)
        .map(match => ({
          id: match.id,
          score: match.score,
          metadata: match.metadata,
          values: match.values
        }));

      return results;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[VectorStore] Query error:', error.message);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Delete vectors by ID
   */
  async delete(ids, namespace = null) {
    if (!this.initialized) await this.initialize();

    const ns = namespace || this.namespace;

    if (this.useInMemory) {
      return this._inMemoryDelete(ids, ns);
    }

    try {
      await this.index.namespace(ns).deleteMany(ids);
      console.log(`[VectorStore] Deleted ${ids.length} vectors from namespace: ${ns}`);
      return { success: true, count: ids.length };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[VectorStore] Delete error:', error.message);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Delete all vectors in a namespace
   */
  async deleteAll(namespace = null) {
    if (!this.initialized) await this.initialize();

    const ns = namespace || this.namespace;

    if (this.useInMemory) {
      this.inMemoryStore.delete(ns);
      return { success: true };
    }

    try {
      await this.index.namespace(ns).deleteAll();
      console.log(`[VectorStore] Deleted all vectors in namespace: ${ns}`);
      return { success: true };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[VectorStore] DeleteAll error:', error.message);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Delete vectors by filter (metadata)
   */
  async deleteByFilter(filter, namespace = null) {
    if (!this.initialized) await this.initialize();

    const ns = namespace || this.namespace;

    if (this.useInMemory) {
      return this._inMemoryDeleteByFilter(filter, ns);
    }

    try {
      await this.index.namespace(ns).deleteMany({ filter });
      console.log(`[VectorStore] Deleted vectors by filter in namespace: ${ns}`);
      return { success: true };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[VectorStore] DeleteByFilter error:', error.message);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get index stats
   */
  async getStats() {
    if (!this.initialized) await this.initialize();

    if (this.useInMemory) {
      return this._inMemoryStats();
    }

    try {
      const stats = await this.index.describeIndexStats();
      return {
        totalVectors: stats.totalRecordCount,
        namespaces: stats.namespaces,
        dimension: stats.dimension
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[VectorStore] Stats error:', error.message);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Fetch vectors by ID
   */
  async fetch(ids, namespace = null) {
    if (!this.initialized) await this.initialize();

    const ns = namespace || this.namespace;

    if (this.useInMemory) {
      return this._inMemoryFetch(ids, ns);
    }

    try {
      const response = await this.index.namespace(ns).fetch(ids);
      return Object.values(response.records || {});
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[VectorStore] Fetch error:', error.message);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  // ==================== In-Memory Fallback ====================

  _inMemoryUpsert(vectors, namespace) {
    if (!this.inMemoryStore.has(namespace)) {
      this.inMemoryStore.set(namespace, new Map());
    }

    const ns = this.inMemoryStore.get(namespace);
    
    for (const v of vectors) {
      const id = v.id || crypto.randomUUID();
      ns.set(id, {
        id,
        values: v.embedding,
        metadata: v.metadata || {}
      });
    }

    console.log(`[VectorStore] In-memory upserted ${vectors.length} vectors to namespace: ${namespace}`);
    return { success: true, count: vectors.length };
  }

  _inMemoryQuery(embedding, options) {
    const { topK, namespace, minScore } = options;
    
    if (!this.inMemoryStore.has(namespace)) {
      return [];
    }

    const ns = this.inMemoryStore.get(namespace);
    const results = [];

    for (const [id, record] of ns) {
      const score = this._cosineSimilarity(embedding, record.values);
      if (score >= minScore) {
        results.push({
          id,
          score,
          metadata: record.metadata
        });
      }
    }

    return results
      .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
      .slice(0, topK);
  }

  _inMemoryDelete(ids, namespace) {
    if (!this.inMemoryStore.has(namespace)) {
      return { success: true, count: 0 };
    }

    const ns = this.inMemoryStore.get(namespace);
    let count = 0;
    
    for (const id of ids) {
      if (ns.delete(id)) count++;
    }

    return { success: true, count };
  }

  _inMemoryDeleteByFilter(filter, namespace) {
    if (!this.inMemoryStore.has(namespace)) {
      return { success: true, count: 0 };
    }

    const ns = this.inMemoryStore.get(namespace);
    let count = 0;

    for (const [id, record] of ns) {
      if (this._matchesFilter(record.metadata, filter)) {
        ns.delete(id);
        count++;
      }
    }

    return { success: true, count };
  }

  _inMemoryFetch(ids, namespace) {
    if (!this.inMemoryStore.has(namespace)) {
      return [];
    }

    const ns = this.inMemoryStore.get(namespace);
    return ids
      .map(id => ns.get(id))
      .filter(Boolean);
  }

  _inMemoryStats() {
    let totalVectors = 0;
    const namespaces = {};

    for (const [ns, store] of this.inMemoryStore) {
      namespaces[ns] = { recordCount: store.size };
      totalVectors += store.size;
    }

    return {
      totalVectors,
      namespaces,
      dimension: 1536,
      inMemory: true
    };
  }

  _cosineSimilarity(vecA, vecB) {
    if (!vecA || !vecB || vecA.length !== vecB.length) return 0;

    let dotProduct = 0;
    let normA = 0;
    let normB = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < vecA.length; i++) {
      dotProduct += vecA[i] * vecB[i];
      normA += vecA[i] * vecA[i];
      normB += vecB[i] * vecB[i];
    }

    normA = Math.sqrt(normA);
    normB = Math.sqrt(normB);

    return normA && normB ? dotProduct / (normA * normB) : 0;
  }

  _matchesFilter(metadata, filter) {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(filter)) {
      if (metadata[key] !== value) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
}

// Singleton
let instance = null;
const getVectorStoreService = () => {
  if (!instance) {
    instance = new VectorStoreService();
  }
  return instance;
};

module.exports = { VectorStoreService, getVectorStoreService };

/**
 * JWT Service - QAssure Platform
 * Handles token generation, verification, and refresh
 */
const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');
const crypto = require('crypto');

class JWTService {
  constructor() {
    this.secret = process.env.JWT_SECRET;
    this.refreshSecret = process.env.JWT_REFRESH_SECRET;
    this.expiresIn = process.env.JWT_EXPIRES_IN || '24h';
    this.refreshExpiresIn = process.env.JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRES_IN || '7d';
    this.issuer = process.env.JWT_ISSUER || 'qassure.ai';
    this.audience = process.env.JWT_AUDIENCE || 'qassure-platform';
    
    if (!this.secret || this.secret.length < 32) {
      throw new Error('JWT_SECRET must be at least 32 characters');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Generate access token
   * @param {Object} payload - User data to encode
   * @returns {Object} - { accessToken, expiresAt }
   */
  generateAccessToken(payload) {
    const {
      userId,
      email,
      tenantId,
      roles = [],
      permissions = [],
      sessionId
    } = payload;

    const tokenPayload = {
      sub: userId,
      email,
      tid: tenantId,
      roles,
      permissions,
      sid: sessionId || crypto.randomUUID(),
      type: 'access'
    };

    const token = jwt.sign(tokenPayload, this.secret, {
      expiresIn: this.expiresIn,
      issuer: this.issuer,
      audience: this.audience,
      algorithm: 'HS256'
    });

    const decoded = jwt.decode(token);
    
    return {
      accessToken: token,
      expiresAt: new Date(decoded.exp * 1000).toISOString(),
      expiresIn: decoded.exp - decoded.iat
    };
  }

  /**
   * Generate refresh token
   * @param {Object} payload - Minimal user data
   * @returns {Object} - { refreshToken, expiresAt }
   */
  generateRefreshToken(payload) {
    const { userId, tenantId, sessionId } = payload;

    const tokenPayload = {
      sub: userId,
      tid: tenantId,
      sid: sessionId || crypto.randomUUID(),
      type: 'refresh',
      jti: crypto.randomUUID() // Unique token ID for revocation
    };

    const token = jwt.sign(tokenPayload, this.refreshSecret, {
      expiresIn: this.refreshExpiresIn,
      issuer: this.issuer,
      audience: this.audience,
      algorithm: 'HS256'
    });

    const decoded = jwt.decode(token);

    return {
      refreshToken: token,
      expiresAt: new Date(decoded.exp * 1000).toISOString(),
      tokenId: tokenPayload.jti
    };
  }

  /**
   * Generate both access and refresh tokens
   * @param {Object} user - User object from database
   * @param {Array} roles - User roles
   * @param {Array} permissions - User permissions
   * @returns {Object} - Complete token pair
   */
  generateTokenPair(user, roles = [], permissions = []) {
    const sessionId = crypto.randomUUID();
    
    const access = this.generateAccessToken({
      userId: user.id,
      email: user.email,
      tenantId: user.tenant_id,
      roles,
      permissions,
      sessionId
    });

    const refresh = this.generateRefreshToken({
      userId: user.id,
      tenantId: user.tenant_id,
      sessionId
    });

    return {
      accessToken: access.accessToken,
      refreshToken: refresh.refreshToken,
      tokenType: 'Bearer',
      expiresIn: access.expiresIn,
      expiresAt: access.expiresAt,
      refreshExpiresAt: refresh.expiresAt,
      sessionId,
      tokenId: refresh.tokenId
    };
  }

  /**
   * Verify access token
   * @param {string} token - JWT token to verify
   * @returns {Object} - Decoded payload or throws error
   */
  verifyAccessToken(token) {
    try {
      const decoded = jwt.verify(token, this.secret, {
        issuer: this.issuer,
        audience: this.audience,
        algorithms: ['HS256']
      });

      if (decoded.type !== 'access') {
        throw new Error('Invalid token type');
      }

      return {
        valid: true,
        payload: {
          userId: decoded.sub,
          email: decoded.email,
          tenantId: decoded.tid,
          roles: decoded.roles || [],
          permissions: decoded.permissions || [],
          sessionId: decoded.sid,
          issuedAt: new Date(decoded.iat * 1000),
          expiresAt: new Date(decoded.exp * 1000)
        }
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        error: this._mapJWTError(error)
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Verify refresh token
   * @param {string} token - Refresh token to verify
   * @returns {Object} - Decoded payload or throws error
   */
  verifyRefreshToken(token) {
    try {
      const decoded = jwt.verify(token, this.refreshSecret, {
        issuer: this.issuer,
        audience: this.audience,
        algorithms: ['HS256']
      });

      if (decoded.type !== 'refresh') {
        throw new Error('Invalid token type');
      }

      return {
        valid: true,
        payload: {
          userId: decoded.sub,
          tenantId: decoded.tid,
          sessionId: decoded.sid,
          tokenId: decoded.jti,
          issuedAt: new Date(decoded.iat * 1000),
          expiresAt: new Date(decoded.exp * 1000)
        }
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        error: this._mapJWTError(error)
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Decode token without verification (for debugging)
   * @param {string} token - JWT token
   * @returns {Object} - Decoded payload
   */
  decodeToken(token) {
    return jwt.decode(token, { complete: true });
  }

  /**
   * Extract token from Authorization header
   * @param {string} authHeader - Authorization header value
   * @returns {string|null} - Token or null
   */
  extractToken(authHeader) {
    if (!authHeader) return null;
    
    const parts = authHeader.split(' ');
    if (parts.length !== 2 || parts[0] !== 'Bearer') {
      return null;
    }
    
    return parts[1];
  }

  /**
   * Check if token is about to expire (within threshold)
   * @param {string} token - JWT token
   * @param {number} thresholdSeconds - Seconds before expiry to consider "expiring"
   * @returns {boolean}
   */
  isTokenExpiring(token, thresholdSeconds = 300) {
    try {
      const decoded = jwt.decode(token);
      if (!decoded || !decoded.exp) return true;
      
      const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
      return (decoded.exp - now) <= thresholdSeconds;
    } catch {
      return true;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Map JWT errors to user-friendly messages
   */
  _mapJWTError(error) {
    const errorMap = {
      'TokenExpiredError': { code: 'TOKEN_EXPIRED', message: 'Token has expired' },
      'JsonWebTokenError': { code: 'INVALID_TOKEN', message: 'Invalid token' },
      'NotBeforeError': { code: 'TOKEN_NOT_ACTIVE', message: 'Token not yet active' }
    };

    return errorMap[error.name] || { 
      code: 'TOKEN_ERROR', 
      message: error.message 
    };
  }
}

// Singleton instance
let instance = null;

const getJWTService = () => {
  if (!instance) {
    instance = new JWTService();
  }
  return instance;
};

module.exports = { JWTService, getJWTService };

/**
 * Permission Service - QAssure Platform
 * Handles RBAC permission checking with Redis caching
 */
const database = require('../../config/database');

class PermissionService {
  constructor() {
    // In-memory fallback cache
    this.localCache = new Map();
    this.cacheTTL = 5 * 60; // 5 minutes in seconds
    this.redisService = null;
  }

  /**
   * Initialize Redis connection (called after Redis is ready)
   */
  setRedisService(redisService) {
    this.redisService = redisService;
    console.log('[PermissionService] Redis caching enabled');
  }

  /**
   * Get from cache (Redis first, then local)
   */
  async getFromCache(key) {
    // Try Redis first
    if (this.redisService?.isConnected) {
      try {
        const cached = await this.redisService.get(key);
        if (cached) return cached;
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[PermissionService] Redis get error:', err.message);
      }
    }

    // Fallback to local cache
    const local = this.localCache.get(key);
    if (local && local.expiresAt > Date.now()) {
      return local.data;
    }
    return null;
  }

  /**
   * Set to cache (both Redis and local)
   */
  async setToCache(key, data) {
    // Set in Redis
    if (this.redisService?.isConnected) {
      try {
        await this.redisService.set(key, data, this.cacheTTL);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[PermissionService] Redis set error:', err.message);
      }
    }

    // Also set in local cache as fallback
    this.localCache.set(key, {
      data,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (this.cacheTTL * 1000)
    });
  }

  /**
   * Get all permissions for a user within a tenant
   * @param {string} userId - User UUID
   * @param {string} tenantId - Tenant UUID
   * @returns {Promise<Array>} - List of permission strings
   */
  async getUserPermissions(userId, tenantId) {
    const cacheKey = `permissions:${userId}:${tenantId}`;
    
    // Check cache first
    const cached = await this.getFromCache(cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
      return cached;
    }

    try {
      // Get permissions through user_roles -> roles -> permissions
      const query = `
        SELECT DISTINCT p.resource, p.action
        FROM user_roles ur
        JOIN permissions p ON p.role_id = ur.role_id
        WHERE ur.user_id = $1
          AND (ur.tenant_id = $2 OR ur.tenant_id IS NULL)
          AND (ur.expires_at IS NULL OR ur.expires_at > NOW())
      `;
      
      const result = await database.query(query, [userId, tenantId]);
      
      // Build permission strings
      const permissionSet = new Set();
      result.rows.forEach(row => {
        permissionSet.add(`${row.resource}:${row.action}`);
      });

      const permissions = Array.from(permissionSet);

      // Cache the result
      await this.setToCache(cacheKey, permissions);

      return permissions;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[PermissionService] Error fetching permissions:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get user's roles for a tenant
   * @param {string} userId - User UUID
   * @param {string} tenantId - Tenant UUID
   * @returns {Promise<Array>} - List of role names
   */
  async getUserRoles(userId, tenantId) {
    const cacheKey = `roles:${userId}:${tenantId}`;
    
    // Check cache first
    const cached = await this.getFromCache(cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
      return cached;
    }

    try {
      const query = `
        SELECT r.name, r.code
        FROM user_roles ur
        JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id
        WHERE ur.user_id = $1
          AND (ur.tenant_id = $2 OR ur.tenant_id IS NULL)
          AND (ur.expires_at IS NULL OR ur.expires_at > NOW())
      `;
      
      const result = await database.query(query, [userId, tenantId]);
      const roles = result.rows.map(r => r.code || r.name);
      
      // Cache the result
      await this.setToCache(cacheKey, roles);
      
      return roles;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[PermissionService] Error fetching roles:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Check if user has a specific permission
   */
  async hasPermission(userId, tenantId, resource, action) {
    const permissions = await this.getUserPermissions(userId, tenantId);
    const requiredPermission = `${resource}:${action}`;

    // Check for exact match
    if (permissions.includes(requiredPermission)) return true;

    // Check for wildcard permissions
    if (permissions.includes('*:*')) return true;
    if (permissions.includes(`${resource}:*`)) return true;
    if (permissions.includes(`*:${action}`)) return true;

    return false;
  }

  /**
   * Check if user has ANY of the specified permissions
   */
  async hasAnyPermission(userId, tenantId, permissionsToCheck) {
    for (const { resource, action } of permissionsToCheck) {
      if (await this.hasPermission(userId, tenantId, resource, action)) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  /**
   * Check if user has ALL of the specified permissions
   */
  async hasAllPermissions(userId, tenantId, permissionsToCheck) {
    for (const { resource, action } of permissionsToCheck) {
      if (!(await this.hasPermission(userId, tenantId, resource, action))) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Check if user has a specific role
   */
  async hasRole(userId, tenantId, roleName) {
    const roles = await this.getUserRoles(userId, tenantId);
    return roles.includes(roleName);
  }

  /**
   * Check if user has any of the specified roles
   */
  async hasAnyRole(userId, tenantId, roleNames) {
    const userRoles = await this.getUserRoles(userId, tenantId);
    return roleNames.some(role => userRoles.includes(role));
  }

  /**
   * Check if user is a super admin (platform level)
   */
  async isSuperAdmin(userId) {
    const cacheKey = `superadmin:${userId}`;
    
    const cached = await this.getFromCache(cacheKey);
    if (cached !== null) {
      return cached;
    }

    try {
      const query = `
        SELECT ur.id FROM user_roles ur
        JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id
        WHERE ur.user_id = $1
          AND r.code = 'super_admin'
          AND (ur.expires_at IS NULL OR ur.expires_at > NOW())
        LIMIT 1
      `;
      const result = await database.query(query, [userId]);
      const isSuperAdmin = result.rows.length > 0;
      
      await this.setToCache(cacheKey, isSuperAdmin);
      
      return isSuperAdmin;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[PermissionService] Error checking super admin:', error);
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Check if user is a tenant admin
   */
  async isTenantAdmin(userId, tenantId) {
    return this.hasRole(userId, tenantId, 'tenant_admin');
  }

  /**
   * Clear permission cache for a user
   */
  async clearCache(userId, tenantId = null) {
    // Clear from Redis
    if (this.redisService?.isConnected) {
      try {
        if (tenantId) {
          await this.redisService.delete(`permissions:${userId}:${tenantId}`);
          await this.redisService.delete(`roles:${userId}:${tenantId}`);
        } else {
          await this.redisService.deletePattern(`permissions:${userId}:*`);
          await this.redisService.deletePattern(`roles:${userId}:*`);
        }
        await this.redisService.delete(`superadmin:${userId}`);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[PermissionService] Redis clear error:', err.message);
      }
    }

    // Clear from local cache
    if (tenantId) {
      this.localCache.delete(`permissions:${userId}:${tenantId}`);
      this.localCache.delete(`roles:${userId}:${tenantId}`);
    } else {
      for (const key of this.localCache.keys()) {
        if (key.includes(userId)) {
          this.localCache.delete(key);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Clear all caches (use when roles/permissions are updated)
   */
  async clearAllCache() {
    // Clear Redis
    if (this.redisService?.isConnected) {
      try {
        await this.redisService.deletePattern('permissions:*');
        await this.redisService.deletePattern('roles:*');
        await this.redisService.deletePattern('superadmin:*');
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[PermissionService] Redis clear all error:', err.message);
      }
    }

    // Clear local cache
    this.localCache.clear();
  }

  getCacheStats() {
    return {
      localCacheSize: this.localCache.size,
      ttlSeconds: this.cacheTTL,
      redisEnabled: this.redisService?.isConnected || false
    };
  }
}

// Singleton
let instance = null;
const getPermissionService = () => {
  if (!instance) {
    instance = new PermissionService();
  }
  return instance;
};

module.exports = { PermissionService, getPermissionService };

/**
 * Redis Service - QAssure Platform
 * Handles caching for sessions, permissions, and general data
 */
const Redis = require('ioredis');

class RedisService {
  constructor() {
    this.client = null;
    this.subscriber = null;
    this.isConnected = false;
    this.reconnectAttempts = 0;
    this.maxReconnectAttempts = 10;
  }

  /**
   * Initialize Redis connection
   */
  async connect() {
    if (this.client && this.isConnected) {
      return this.client;
    }

    const redisUrl = process.env.REDIS_URL || 'redis://localhost:6379';
    
    const options = {
      maxRetriesPerRequest: 3,
      retryDelayOnFailover: 100,
      enableReadyCheck: true,
      lazyConnect: false,
      showFriendlyErrorStack: process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production',
      retryStrategy: (times) => {
        if (times > this.maxReconnectAttempts) {
          console.error('[Redis] Max reconnection attempts reached');
          return null;
        }
        const delay = Math.min(times * 100, 3000);
        console.log(`[Redis] Retrying connection in ${delay}ms (attempt ${times})`);
        return delay;
      }
    };

    this.client = new Redis(redisUrl, options);

    this.client.on('connect', () => {
      console.log('[Redis] ✅ Connected successfully');
      this.isConnected = true;
      this.reconnectAttempts = 0;
    });

    this.client.on('ready', () => {
      console.log('[Redis] ✅ Ready to accept commands');
    });

    this.client.on('error', (err) => {
      console.error('[Redis] ❌ Connection error:', err.message);
      this.isConnected = false;
    });

    this.client.on('close', () => {
      console.log('[Redis] Connection closed');
      this.isConnected = false;
    });

    this.client.on('reconnecting', () => {
      this.reconnectAttempts++;
      console.log(`[Redis] Reconnecting... (attempt ${this.reconnectAttempts})`);
    });

    // Wait for connection
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.client.once('ready', resolve);
      this.client.once('error', reject);
    });

    return this.client;
  }

  /**
   * Disconnect from Redis
   */
  async disconnect() {
    if (this.client) {
      await this.client.quit();
      this.client = null;
      this.isConnected = false;
      console.log('[Redis] Disconnected');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get the Redis client
   */
  getClient() {
    if (!this.client || !this.isConnected) {
      throw new Error('Redis not connected. Call connect() first.');
    }
    return this.client;
  }

  // ==================== Basic Operations ====================

  /**
   * Set a value with optional TTL
   */
  async set(key, value, ttlSeconds = null) {
    const client = this.getClient();
    const serialized = typeof value === 'string' ? value : JSON.stringify(value);
    
    if (ttlSeconds) {
      await client.setex(key, ttlSeconds, serialized);
    } else {
      await client.set(key, serialized);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get a value
   */
  async get(key, parseJson = true) {
    const client = this.getClient();
    const value = await client.get(key);
    
    if (!value) return null;
    
    if (parseJson) {
      try {
        return JSON.parse(value);
      } catch {
        return value;
      }
    }
    return value;
  }

  /**
   * Delete a key
   */
  async delete(key) {
    const client = this.getClient();
    return await client.del(key);
  }

  /**
   * Check if key exists
   */
  async exists(key) {
    const client = this.getClient();
    return await client.exists(key) === 1;
  }

  /**
   * Set TTL on existing key
   */
  async expire(key, ttlSeconds) {
    const client = this.getClient();
    return await client.expire(key, ttlSeconds);
  }

  /**
   * Get remaining TTL
   */
  async ttl(key) {
    const client = this.getClient();
    return await client.ttl(key);
  }

  /**
   * Delete keys by pattern
   */
  async deletePattern(pattern) {
    const client = this.getClient();
    const keys = await client.keys(pattern);
    if (keys.length > 0) {
      await client.del(...keys);
    }
    return keys.length;
  }

  // ==================== Session Management ====================

  /**
   * Store session in Redis
   */
  async setSession(sessionId, sessionData, ttlSeconds = 86400) {
    const key = `session:${sessionId}`;
    await this.set(key, sessionData, ttlSeconds);
    
    // Also index by user for session listing
    const userSessionsKey = `user_sessions:${sessionData.userId}`;
    const client = this.getClient();
    await client.sadd(userSessionsKey, sessionId);
    await client.expire(userSessionsKey, ttlSeconds);
  }

  /**
   * Get session from Redis
   */
  async getSession(sessionId) {
    const key = `session:${sessionId}`;
    return await this.get(key);
  }

  /**
   * Delete session
   */
  async deleteSession(sessionId, userId = null) {
    const key = `session:${sessionId}`;
    await this.delete(key);
    
    if (userId) {
      const client = this.getClient();
      await client.srem(`user_sessions:${userId}`, sessionId);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get all sessions for a user
   */
  async getUserSessions(userId) {
    const client = this.getClient();
    const sessionIds = await client.smembers(`user_sessions:${userId}`);
    
    const sessions = [];
    for (const sessionId of sessionIds) {
      const session = await this.getSession(sessionId);
      if (session) {
        sessions.push({ id: sessionId, ...session });
      } else {
        // Clean up stale reference
        await client.srem(`user_sessions:${userId}`, sessionId);
      }
    }
    
    return sessions;
  }

  /**
   * Delete all sessions for a user
   */
  async deleteUserSessions(userId) {
    const client = this.getClient();
    const sessionIds = await client.smembers(`user_sessions:${userId}`);
    
    for (const sessionId of sessionIds) {
      await this.delete(`session:${sessionId}`);
    }
    
    await this.delete(`user_sessions:${userId}`);
    return sessionIds.length;
  }

  // ==================== Permission Caching ====================

  /**
   * Cache user permissions
   */
  async setUserPermissions(userId, tenantId, permissions, ttlSeconds = 300) {
    const key = `permissions:${userId}:${tenantId}`;
    await this.set(key, permissions, ttlSeconds);
  }

  /**
   * Get cached user permissions
   */
  async getUserPermissions(userId, tenantId) {
    const key = `permissions:${userId}:${tenantId}`;
    return await this.get(key);
  }

  /**
   * Invalidate user permissions cache
   */
  async invalidateUserPermissions(userId, tenantId = null) {
    if (tenantId) {
      await this.delete(`permissions:${userId}:${tenantId}`);
    } else {
      await this.deletePattern(`permissions:${userId}:*`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Invalidate all permissions for a tenant (e.g., when roles change)
   */
  async invalidateTenantPermissions(tenantId) {
    await this.deletePattern(`permissions:*:${tenantId}`);
  }

  // ==================== Rate Limiting ====================

  /**
   * Increment rate limit counter
   */
  async incrementRateLimit(key, windowSeconds = 60) {
    const client = this.getClient();
    const fullKey = `ratelimit:${key}`;
    
    const count = await client.incr(fullKey);
    if (count === 1) {
      await client.expire(fullKey, windowSeconds);
    }
    
    const ttl = await client.ttl(fullKey);
    
    return { count, ttl };
  }

  /**
   * Get rate limit count
   */
  async getRateLimitCount(key) {
    const client = this.getClient();
    const count = await client.get(`ratelimit:${key}`);
    return parseInt(count) || 0;
  }

  // ==================== General Caching ====================

  /**
   * Cache with automatic refresh pattern
   */
  async cacheWithRefresh(key, fetchFn, ttlSeconds = 300, refreshThreshold = 60) {
    const cached = await this.get(key);
    const ttl = await this.ttl(key);
    
    // If cache exists and not near expiration, return it
    if (cached && ttl > refreshThreshold) {
      return cached;
    }
    
    // Fetch fresh data
    const freshData = await fetchFn();
    await this.set(key, freshData, ttlSeconds);
    
    return freshData;
  }

  /**
   * Cache tenant data
   */
  async setTenant(tenantId, tenantData, ttlSeconds = 300) {
    const key = `tenant:${tenantId}`;
    await this.set(key, tenantData, ttlSeconds);
  }

  /**
   * Get cached tenant data
   */
  async getTenant(tenantId) {
    const key = `tenant:${tenantId}`;
    return await this.get(key);
  }

  /**
   * Invalidate tenant cache
   */
  async invalidateTenant(tenantId) {
    await this.delete(`tenant:${tenantId}`);
  }

  // ==================== Health Check ====================

  /**
   * Check Redis health
   */
  async healthCheck() {
    try {
      const client = this.getClient();
      const start = Date.now();
      await client.ping();
      const latency = Date.now() - start;
      
      const info = await client.info('server');
      const memoryInfo = await client.info('memory');
      
      return {
        status: 'healthy',
        latency: `${latency}ms`,
        connected: this.isConnected,
        info: {
          version: info.match(/redis_version:(\S+)/)?.[1],
          usedMemory: memoryInfo.match(/used_memory_human:(\S+)/)?.[1]
        }
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        status: 'unhealthy',
        error: error.message,
        connected: this.isConnected
      };
    }
  }
}

// Export singleton instance
module.exports = new RedisService();
