/**
 * Email Service - QAssure Platform
 * Handles sending transactional emails
 */
const nodemailer = require('nodemailer');

class EmailService {
  constructor() {
    this.transporter = null;
    this.initialized = false;
    this.from = process.env.EMAIL_FROM || 'noreply@qassure.ai';
  }

  /**
   * Initialize email transporter
   */
  async initialize() {
    if (this.initialized) return;

    const emailProvider = process.env.EMAIL_PROVIDER || 'smtp';

    if (emailProvider === 'console' || process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
      // Development: Log emails to console
      this.transporter = {
        sendMail: async (options) => {
          console.log('\n========== EMAIL ==========');
          console.log('To:', options.to);
          console.log('Subject:', options.subject);
          console.log('----------------------------');
          console.log(options.text || options.html);
          console.log('============================\n');
          return { messageId: `dev-${Date.now()}` };
        }
      };
      console.log('[EmailService] ✅ Initialized (console mode)');
    } else {
      // Production: Use SMTP
      this.transporter = nodemailer.createTransport({
        host: process.env.SMTP_HOST,
        port: parseInt(process.env.SMTP_PORT || '587'),
        secure: process.env.SMTP_SECURE === 'true',
        auth: {
          user: process.env.SMTP_USER,
          pass: process.env.SMTP_PASS
        }
      });

      // Verify connection
      try {
        await this.transporter.verify();
        console.log('[EmailService] ✅ SMTP connection verified');
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('[EmailService] ❌ SMTP connection failed:', err.message);
        throw err;
      }
    }

    this.initialized = true;
  }

  /**
   * Send email
   */
  async send(to, subject, html, text = null) {
    if (!this.initialized) {
      await this.initialize();
    }

    const mailOptions = {
      from: this.from,
      to,
      subject,
      html,
      text: text || this._stripHtml(html)
    };

    try {
      const result = await this.transporter.sendMail(mailOptions);
      console.log(`[EmailService] Email sent to ${to}: ${result.messageId}`);
      return { success: true, messageId: result.messageId };
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[EmailService] Failed to send email to ${to}:`, err.message);
      throw err;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Send verification email
   */
  async sendVerificationEmail(email, firstName, verificationToken) {
    const verifyUrl = `${process.env.APP_URL || 'http://localhost:5173'}/verify-email?token=${verificationToken}`;
    
    const html = `
      <div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto;">
        <h2 style="color: #2563eb;">Welcome to QAssure!</h2>
        <p>Hi ${firstName},</p>
        <p>Thank you for registering. Please verify your email address by clicking the button below:</p>
        <p style="margin: 30px 0;">
          <a href="${verifyUrl}" 
             style="background-color: #2563eb; color: white; padding: 12px 24px; 
                    text-decoration: none; border-radius: 6px; display: inline-block;">
            Verify Email Address
          </a>
        </p>
        <p>Or copy and paste this link into your browser:</p>
        <p style="color: #666; word-break: break-all;">${verifyUrl}</p>
        <p>This link will expire in 24 hours.</p>
        <hr style="border: none; border-top: 1px solid #eee; margin: 30px 0;">
        <p style="color: #999; font-size: 12px;">
          If you didn't create an account, please ignore this email.
        </p>
      </div>
    `;

    return this.send(email, 'Verify your QAssure account', html);
  }

  /**
   * Send password reset email
   */
  async sendPasswordResetEmail(email, firstName, resetToken) {
    const resetUrl = `${process.env.APP_URL || 'http://localhost:5173'}/reset-password?token=${resetToken}`;
    
    const html = `
      <div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto;">
        <h2 style="color: #2563eb;">Password Reset Request</h2>
        <p>Hi ${firstName},</p>
        <p>We received a request to reset your password. Click the button below to create a new password:</p>
        <p style="margin: 30px 0;">
          <a href="${resetUrl}" 
             style="background-color: #2563eb; color: white; padding: 12px 24px; 
                    text-decoration: none; border-radius: 6px; display: inline-block;">
            Reset Password
          </a>
        </p>
        <p>Or copy and paste this link into your browser:</p>
        <p style="color: #666; word-break: break-all;">${resetUrl}</p>
        <p>This link will expire in 1 hour.</p>
        <hr style="border: none; border-top: 1px solid #eee; margin: 30px 0;">
        <p style="color: #999; font-size: 12px;">
          If you didn't request a password reset, please ignore this email or contact support if you have concerns.
        </p>
      </div>
    `;

    return this.send(email, 'Reset your QAssure password', html);
  }

  /**
   * Send welcome email after verification
   */
  async sendWelcomeEmail(email, firstName, tenantName) {
    const loginUrl = `${process.env.APP_URL || 'http://localhost:5173'}/login`;
    
    const html = `
      <div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto;">
        <h2 style="color: #2563eb;">Welcome to QAssure! 🎉</h2>
        <p>Hi ${firstName},</p>
        <p>Your email has been verified and your account is now active.</p>
        <p>You've been added to <strong>${tenantName}</strong>.</p>
        <p style="margin: 30px 0;">
          <a href="${loginUrl}" 
             style="background-color: #2563eb; color: white; padding: 12px 24px; 
                    text-decoration: none; border-radius: 6px; display: inline-block;">
            Log In to QAssure
          </a>
        </p>
        <p>Need help getting started? Check out our documentation or contact support.</p>
        <hr style="border: none; border-top: 1px solid #eee; margin: 30px 0;">
        <p style="color: #999; font-size: 12px;">
          © ${new Date().getFullYear()} QAssure. All rights reserved.
        </p>
      </div>
    `;

    return this.send(email, 'Welcome to QAssure!', html);
  }

  /**
   * Send password changed notification
   */
  async sendPasswordChangedEmail(email, firstName) {
    const html = `
      <div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto;">
        <h2 style="color: #2563eb;">Password Changed</h2>
        <p>Hi ${firstName},</p>
        <p>Your password was successfully changed on ${new Date().toLocaleString()}.</p>
        <p>If you didn't make this change, please contact support immediately.</p>
        <hr style="border: none; border-top: 1px solid #eee; margin: 30px 0;">
        <p style="color: #999; font-size: 12px;">
          This is an automated security notification from QAssure.
        </p>
      </div>
    `;

    return this.send(email, 'Your QAssure password was changed', html);
  }

  /**
   * Strip HTML tags for plain text version
   */
  _stripHtml(html) {
    return html
      .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .trim();
  }
}

const getEmailService = () => {
  if (!instance) {
    instance = new EmailService();
  }
  return instance;
};

module.exports = { EmailService, getEmailService };

/**
 * Event Router - QAssure Platform
 * Routes events from Kafka to subscribers (modules) and webhooks
 */
const { getEventSubscriptionService } = require('../../services/event-subscription.service');
const { getWebhookService } = require('../../services/webhook.service');

class EventRouter {
  constructor() {
    this.subscriptionService = null;
    this.webhookService = null;
    this.handlers = new Map();
    this.initialized = false;
  }

  /**
   * Initialize the event router
   */
  async initialize() {
    if (this.initialized) return;

    this.subscriptionService = getEventSubscriptionService();
    this.webhookService = getWebhookService();
    this.initialized = true;

    console.log('[EventRouter] ✅ Initialized');
  }

  /**
   * Register an internal handler for an event pattern
   */
  registerHandler(eventPattern, handler) {
    if (!this.handlers.has(eventPattern)) {
      this.handlers.set(eventPattern, []);
    }
    this.handlers.get(eventPattern).push(handler);
    console.log(`[EventRouter] Registered handler for: ${eventPattern}`);
  }

  /**
   * Unregister a handler
   */
  unregisterHandler(eventPattern, handler) {
    if (this.handlers.has(eventPattern)) {
      const handlers = this.handlers.get(eventPattern);
      const index = handlers.indexOf(handler);
      if (index > -1) {
        handlers.splice(index, 1);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Route an event to all matching subscribers
   */
  async route(event) {
    if (!this.initialized) {
      await this.initialize();
    }

    const { type, tenantId } = event;
    const results = {
      eventId: event.id,
      eventType: type,
      internalHandlers: 0,
      subscriptions: 0,
      webhooks: 0,
      errors: []
    };

    try {
      // 1. Route to internal handlers (registered in code)
      await this._routeToInternalHandlers(event, results);

      // 2. Route to database subscriptions (modules)
      if (tenantId) {
        await this._routeToSubscriptions(event, results);
      }

      // 3. Route to webhooks (external systems)
      if (tenantId) {
        await this._routeToWebhooks(event, results);
      }

    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`[EventRouter] Error routing event ${type}:`, error.message);
      results.errors.push({ phase: 'routing', error: error.message });
    }

    return results;
  }

  /**
   * Route to internal handlers registered in code
   */
  async _routeToInternalHandlers(event, results) {
    const { type } = event;

    // Find matching handlers
    for (const [pattern, handlers] of this.handlers.entries()) {
      if (this._matchesPattern(type, pattern)) {
        for (const handler of handlers) {
          try {
            await handler(event);
            results.internalHandlers++;
          } catch (error) {
            console.error(`[EventRouter] Internal handler error for ${pattern}:`, error.message);
            results.errors.push({
              phase: 'internal',
              pattern,
              error: error.message
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Route to database subscriptions
   */
  async _routeToSubscriptions(event, results) {
    const { type, tenantId } = event;

    try {
      const subscriptions = await this.subscriptionService.getSubscribersForEvent(tenantId, type);

      for (const subscription of subscriptions) {
        try {
          // Check filters
          if (!this._matchesFilters(event, subscription.filters)) {
            continue;
          }

          // Deliver based on delivery type
          await this._deliverToSubscription(subscription, event);
          results.subscriptions++;

        } catch (error) {
          console.error(`[EventRouter] Subscription delivery error:`, error.message);
          results.errors.push({
            phase: 'subscription',
            subscriptionId: subscription.id,
            error: error.message
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`[EventRouter] Error fetching subscriptions:`, error.message);
      results.errors.push({ phase: 'subscriptions', error: error.message });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Deliver event to a subscription based on delivery type
   */
  async _deliverToSubscription(subscription, event) {
    switch (subscription.deliveryType) {
      case 'http':
        // HTTP callback
        await this._deliverHttp(subscription.callbackUrl, event);
        break;

      case 'kafka':
        // Republish to specific Kafka topic
        if (subscription.kafkaTopic) {
          await this._deliverKafka(subscription.kafkaTopic, event);
        }
        break;

      case 'internal':
        // Internal module - look for registered handler
        const moduleHandlers = this.handlers.get(`module:${subscription.moduleCode}`);
        if (moduleHandlers) {
          for (const handler of moduleHandlers) {
            await handler(event);
          }
        }
        break;

      default:
        console.warn(`[EventRouter] Unknown delivery type: ${subscription.deliveryType}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Deliver via HTTP callback
   */
  async _deliverHttp(url, event) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(url, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'X-Event-Type': event.type,
          'X-Event-Id': event.id
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(event),
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(30000)
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`[EventRouter] HTTP delivery failed to ${url}:`, error.message);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Deliver via Kafka topic
   */
  async _deliverKafka(topic, event) {
    try {
      const { getKafkaProducer } = require('../kafka/producer.service');
      const producer = getKafkaProducer();
      await producer.publish(topic, event);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`[EventRouter] Kafka delivery failed to ${topic}:`, error.message);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Route to webhooks
   */
  async _routeToWebhooks(event, results) {
    const { type, tenantId } = event;

    try {
      const webhooks = await this.webhookService.getWebhooksForEvent(tenantId, type);

      for (const webhook of webhooks) {
        try {
          await this.webhookService.queueDelivery(webhook, event);
          results.webhooks++;
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(`[EventRouter] Webhook queue error:`, error.message);
          results.errors.push({
            phase: 'webhook',
            webhookId: webhook.id,
            error: error.message
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`[EventRouter] Error fetching webhooks:`, error.message);
      results.errors.push({ phase: 'webhooks', error: error.message });
    }
  }

  /**
   * Check if event type matches a pattern
   * Supports wildcards: * matches any single segment, ** matches multiple
   */
  _matchesPattern(eventType, pattern) {
    if (pattern === '*' || pattern === '**') return true;
    if (pattern === eventType) return true;

    const patternParts = pattern.split('.');
    const eventParts = eventType.split('.');

    for (let i = 0; i < patternParts.length; i++) {
      if (patternParts[i] === '**') return true;
      if (patternParts[i] === '*') continue;
      if (patternParts[i] !== eventParts[i]) return false;
    }

    return patternParts.length === eventParts.length;
  }

  /**
   * Check if event matches subscription filters
   */
  _matchesFilters(event, filters) {
    if (!filters || Object.keys(filters).length === 0) {
      return true;
    }

    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(filters)) {
      const eventValue = this._getNestedValue(event, key);
      
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        if (!value.includes(eventValue)) return false;
      } else if (eventValue !== value) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Get nested value from object using dot notation
   */
  _getNestedValue(obj, path) {
    return path.split('.').reduce((current, key) => 
      current && current[key] !== undefined ? current[key] : undefined, obj);
  }

  /**
   * Get router statistics
   */
  getStats() {
    return {
      initialized: this.initialized,
      registeredPatterns: this.handlers.size,
      patterns: Array.from(this.handlers.keys())
    };
  }
}

// Singleton
let instance = null;
const getEventRouter = () => {
  if (!instance) {
    instance = new EventRouter();
  }
  return instance;
};

module.exports = { EventRouter, getEventRouter };

/**
 * Kafka Consumer Service - QAssure Platform
 * Subscribes to and processes events from Kafka topics
 */
const { Kafka, logLevel } = require('kafkajs');

class KafkaConsumerService {
  constructor() {
    this.kafka = null;
    this.consumer = null;
    this.isConnected = false;
    this.handlers = new Map();
    this.subscribedTopics = new Set();
  }

  /**
   * Initialize Kafka consumer
   */
  async connect(groupId = null) {
    try {
      const brokersEnv = process.env.KAFKA_BROKERS || 'localhost:29092';
      
      // Skip connection if Kafka is explicitly disabled
      if (!brokersEnv || brokersEnv.trim() === '') {
        console.log('[KafkaConsumer] ⚠️ Kafka disabled (KAFKA_BROKERS is empty)');
        this.isConnected = false;
        return false;
      }
      
      const brokers = brokersEnv.split(',');
      
      this.kafka = new Kafka({
        clientId: process.env.KAFKA_CLIENT_ID || 'qassure-api',
        brokers,
        logLevel: logLevel.WARN,
        retry: {
          initialRetryTime: 100,
          retries: 8
        }
      });

      this.consumer = this.kafka.consumer({
        groupId: groupId || process.env.KAFKA_GROUP_ID || 'qassure-consumers',
        sessionTimeout: 30000,
        heartbeatInterval: 3000,
        maxBytesPerPartition: 1048576, // 1MB
        retry: {
          retries: 10
        }
      });

      await this.consumer.connect();
      this.isConnected = true;
      console.log('[KafkaConsumer] ✅ Connected to Kafka brokers:', brokers.join(', '));

      // Handle errors
      this.consumer.on('consumer.crash', async (event) => {
        console.error('[KafkaConsumer] ❌ Consumer crashed:', event.payload.error);
        this.isConnected = false;
        // Attempt reconnection
        setTimeout(() => this.reconnect(), 5000);
      });

      this.consumer.on('consumer.disconnect', () => {
        console.warn('[KafkaConsumer] ⚠️ Disconnected from Kafka');
        this.isConnected = false;
      });

      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[KafkaConsumer] ❌ Failed to connect:', error.message);
      this.isConnected = false;
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Reconnect to Kafka
   */
  async reconnect() {
    console.log('[KafkaConsumer] Attempting to reconnect...');
    const connected = await this.connect();
    if (connected && this.subscribedTopics.size > 0) {
      await this.resubscribe();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Resubscribe to previously subscribed topics
   */
  async resubscribe() {
    for (const topic of this.subscribedTopics) {
      await this.consumer.subscribe({ topic, fromBeginning: false });
    }
    await this.startConsuming();
  }

  /**
   * Disconnect from Kafka
   */
  async disconnect() {
    if (this.consumer) {
      await this.consumer.disconnect();
      this.isConnected = false;
      console.log('[KafkaConsumer] Disconnected');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Subscribe to a topic with a handler
   */
  async subscribe(topic, handler) {
    if (!this.isConnected) {
      await this.connect();
    }

    if (!this.isConnected) {
      console.error('[KafkaConsumer] Cannot subscribe - not connected');
      return false;
    }

    try {
      // Register handler
      if (!this.handlers.has(topic)) {
        this.handlers.set(topic, []);
      }
      this.handlers.get(topic).push(handler);

      // Subscribe to topic
      await this.consumer.subscribe({ topic, fromBeginning: false });
      this.subscribedTopics.add(topic);
      
      console.log(`[KafkaConsumer] Subscribed to topic: ${topic}`);
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`[KafkaConsumer] Failed to subscribe to ${topic}:`, error.message);
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Subscribe to multiple topics
   */
  async subscribeToMany(topicHandlers) {
    for (const { topic, handler } of topicHandlers) {
      await this.subscribe(topic, handler);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Start consuming messages
   */
  async startConsuming() {
    if (!this.isConnected) {
      console.error('[KafkaConsumer] Cannot start consuming - not connected');
      return false;
    }

    try {
      await this.consumer.run({
        eachMessage: async ({ topic, partition, message, heartbeat }) => {
          const handlers = this.handlers.get(topic) || [];
          
          if (handlers.length === 0) {
            console.warn(`[KafkaConsumer] No handlers for topic: ${topic}`);
            return;
          }

          try {
            // Parse message
            const event = {
              topic,
              partition,
              offset: message.offset,
              timestamp: message.timestamp,
              key: message.key?.toString(),
              value: JSON.parse(message.value.toString()),
              headers: this._parseHeaders(message.headers)
            };

            console.log(`[KafkaConsumer] Received from ${topic}:`, event.value.type || 'event');

            // Call all handlers
            for (const handler of handlers) {
              try {
                await handler(event);
              } catch (handlerError) {
                console.error(`[KafkaConsumer] Handler error for ${topic}:`, handlerError.message);
              }
            }

            // Heartbeat to keep consumer alive
            await heartbeat();
          } catch (parseError) {
            console.error(`[KafkaConsumer] Failed to parse message from ${topic}:`, parseError.message);
          }
        }
      });

      console.log('[KafkaConsumer] Started consuming messages');
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[KafkaConsumer] Failed to start consuming:', error.message);
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Parse message headers
   */
  _parseHeaders(headers) {
    const parsed = {};
    if (headers) {
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(headers)) {
        parsed[key] = value?.toString();
      }
    }
    return parsed;
  }

  /**
   * Pause consumption for a topic
   */
  async pause(topic) {
    if (this.consumer) {
      const partitions = await this._getPartitionsForTopic(topic);
      await this.consumer.pause(partitions.map(p => ({ topic, partition: p })));
      console.log(`[KafkaConsumer] Paused consumption for: ${topic}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Resume consumption for a topic
   */
  async resume(topic) {
    if (this.consumer) {
      const partitions = await this._getPartitionsForTopic(topic);
      await this.consumer.resume(partitions.map(p => ({ topic, partition: p })));
      console.log(`[KafkaConsumer] Resumed consumption for: ${topic}`);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get partitions for a topic
   */
  async _getPartitionsForTopic(topic) {
    const admin = this.kafka.admin();
    await admin.connect();
    const metadata = await admin.fetchTopicMetadata({ topics: [topic] });
    await admin.disconnect();
    return metadata.topics[0]?.partitions.map(p => p.partitionId) || [0];
  }

  /**
   * Health check
   */
  async healthCheck() {
    return {
      connected: this.isConnected,
      subscribedTopics: Array.from(this.subscribedTopics),
      status: this.isConnected ? 'healthy' : 'disconnected'
    };
  }
}

// Singleton
let instance = null;
const getKafkaConsumer = () => {
  if (!instance) {
    instance = new KafkaConsumerService();
  }
  return instance;
};

module.exports = { KafkaConsumerService, getKafkaConsumer };

  TOPICS, 
  EVENT_TYPES,
  AuthEvents, 
  UserEvents, 
  TenantEvents, 
  ModuleEvents, 
  ApiKeyEvents,
  SystemEvents

    this.producer = getKafkaProducer();
    this.consumer = getKafkaConsumer();

   * Initialize the event service

  async initialize() {

    try {

        this.initialized = true;

  async subscribeToUserEvents(handler) {
    await this.consumer.connect();
    await this.consumer.subscribe(TOPICS.USER, handler);
  }

  async subscribeToModuleEvents(handler) {
    await this.consumer.connect();
    await this.consumer.subscribe(TOPICS.MODULE, handler);
  }

  async subscribeToAllEvents(handlers = {}) {
    await this.consumer.connect();
    
    if (handlers.auth) await this.consumer.subscribe(TOPICS.AUTH, handlers.auth);
    if (handlers.user) await this.consumer.subscribe(TOPICS.USER, handlers.user);
    if (handlers.tenant) await this.consumer.subscribe(TOPICS.TENANT, handlers.tenant);
    if (handlers.module) await this.consumer.subscribe(TOPICS.MODULE, handlers.module);
    if (handlers.apiKey) await this.consumer.subscribe(TOPICS.API_KEY, handlers.apiKey);
    if (handlers.system) await this.consumer.subscribe(TOPICS.SYSTEM, handlers.system);
    
    await this.consumer.startConsuming();
  }

  // ==========================================
  // HEALTH CHECK
  // ==========================================

  async healthCheck() {
    const producerHealth = await this.producer.healthCheck();
    const consumerHealth = await this.consumer.healthCheck();
    
    return {
      producer: producerHealth,
      consumer: consumerHealth,
      status: producerHealth.connected ? 'healthy' : 'degraded'
    };
  }
}

// Singleton
let instance = null;
const getEventService = () => {
  if (!instance) {
    instance = new EventService();
  }
  return instance;
};

module.exports = { 
  EventService, 
  getEventService,
  TOPICS,
  EVENT_TYPES
};

/**
 * Base event structure
 */
const createBaseEvent = (type, data, context = {}) => ({
  id: `evt_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`,
  type,
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  version: '1.0',
  source: 'qassure-api',
  correlationId: context.correlationId || null,
  tenantId: context.tenantId || null,
  userId: context.userId || null,
  data
});

========== FILE: ./src/infrastructure/kafka/producer.service.js ==========
/**
 * Kafka Producer Service - QAssure Platform
 * Publishes events to Kafka topics
 */
const { Kafka, Partitioners, logLevel } = require('kafkajs');

class KafkaProducerService {
  constructor() {
    this.kafka = null;
    this.producer = null;
    this.isConnected = false;
    this.connectionPromise = null;
  }

  /**
   * Initialize Kafka connection
   */
  async connect() {
    if (this.connectionPromise) {
      return this.connectionPromise;
    }

    this.connectionPromise = this._connect();
    return this.connectionPromise;
  }

  async _connect() {
    try {
      const brokersEnv = process.env.KAFKA_BROKERS || 'localhost:29092';
      
      // Skip connection if Kafka is explicitly disabled
      if (!brokersEnv || brokersEnv.trim() === '') {
        console.log('[KafkaProducer] ⚠️ Kafka disabled (KAFKA_BROKERS is empty)');
        this.isConnected = false;
        this.connectionPromise = null;
        return false;
      }
      
      const brokers = brokersEnv.split(',');
      
      this.kafka = new Kafka({
        clientId: process.env.KAFKA_CLIENT_ID || 'qassure-api',
        brokers,
        logLevel: logLevel.WARN,
        retry: {
          initialRetryTime: 100,
          retries: 8
        }
      });

      this.producer = this.kafka.producer({
        createPartitioner: Partitioners.LegacyPartitioner,
        allowAutoTopicCreation: true,
        transactionTimeout: 30000
      });

      await this.producer.connect();
      this.isConnected = true;
      console.log('[KafkaProducer] ✅ Connected to Kafka brokers:', brokers.join(', '));

      // Handle disconnection
      this.producer.on('producer.disconnect', () => {
        console.warn('[KafkaProducer] ⚠️ Disconnected from Kafka');
        this.isConnected = false;
      });

      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[KafkaProducer] ❌ Failed to connect:', error.message);
      this.isConnected = false;
      this.connectionPromise = null;
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Disconnect from Kafka
   */
  async disconnect() {
    if (this.producer) {
      await this.producer.disconnect();
      this.isConnected = false;
      console.log('[KafkaProducer] Disconnected');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Publish a single event
   */
  async publish(topic, event) {
    if (!this.isConnected) {
      await this.connect();
    }

    if (!this.isConnected) {
      console.warn('[KafkaProducer] Not connected, event not published:', topic);
      return false;
    }

    try {
      const message = {
        key: event.key || event.id || null,
        value: JSON.stringify({
          ...event,
          timestamp: event.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),
          version: '1.0'
        }),
        headers: {
          'content-type': 'application/json',
          'event-type': event.type || topic,
          'correlation-id': event.correlationId || '',
          'tenant-id': event.tenantId || ''
        }
      };

      await this.producer.send({
        topic,
        messages: [message]
      });

      console.log(`[KafkaProducer] Published to ${topic}:`, event.type || 'event');
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`[KafkaProducer] Failed to publish to ${topic}:`, error.message);
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Publish multiple events in batch
   */
  async publishBatch(topic, events) {
    if (!this.isConnected) {
      await this.connect();
    }

    if (!this.isConnected) {
      console.warn('[KafkaProducer] Not connected, batch not published');
      return false;
    }

    try {
      const messages = events.map(event => ({
        key: event.key || event.id || null,
        value: JSON.stringify({
          ...event,
          timestamp: event.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),
          version: '1.0'
        }),
        headers: {
          'content-type': 'application/json',
          'event-type': event.type || topic,
          'correlation-id': event.correlationId || '',
          'tenant-id': event.tenantId || ''
        }
      }));

      await this.producer.send({
        topic,
        messages
      });

      console.log(`[KafkaProducer] Published batch of ${events.length} to ${topic}`);
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`[KafkaProducer] Failed to publish batch to ${topic}:`, error.message);
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Publish to multiple topics
   */
  async publishToMultipleTopics(topicMessages) {
    if (!this.isConnected) {
      await this.connect();
    }

    if (!this.isConnected) {
      return false;
    }

    try {
      await this.producer.sendBatch({
        topicMessages: topicMessages.map(({ topic, events }) => ({
          topic,
          messages: events.map(event => ({
            key: event.key || event.id || null,
            value: JSON.stringify({
              ...event,
              timestamp: event.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),
              version: '1.0'
            })
          }))
        }))
      });

      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[KafkaProducer] Failed to publish to multiple topics:', error.message);
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Health check
   */
  async healthCheck() {
    return {
      connected: this.isConnected,
      status: this.isConnected ? 'healthy' : 'disconnected'
    };
  }
}

// Singleton
let instance = null;
const getKafkaProducer = () => {
  if (!instance) {
    instance = new KafkaProducerService();
  }
  return instance;
};

module.exports = { KafkaProducerService, getKafkaProducer };

/**
 * Prometheus Metrics Service - QAssure Platform
 * Exposes application metrics for monitoring
 */
const promClient = require('prom-client');

class PrometheusService {
  constructor() {
    // Create a Registry
    this.register = new promClient.Registry();
    
    // Add default metrics (CPU, memory, etc.)
    promClient.collectDefaultMetrics({
      register: this.register,
      prefix: 'qassure_'
    });

    // Initialize custom metrics
    this._initializeMetrics();
  }

  _initializeMetrics() {
    // HTTP Request metrics
    this.httpRequestDuration = new promClient.Histogram({
      name: 'qassure_http_request_duration_seconds',
      help: 'Duration of HTTP requests in seconds',
      labelNames: ['method', 'route', 'status_code'],
      buckets: [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10],
      registers: [this.register]
    });

    this.httpRequestTotal = new promClient.Counter({
      name: 'qassure_http_requests_total',
      help: 'Total number of HTTP requests',
      labelNames: ['method', 'route', 'status_code'],
      registers: [this.register]
    });

    // Authentication metrics
    this.authAttempts = new promClient.Counter({
      name: 'qassure_auth_attempts_total',
      help: 'Total authentication attempts',
      labelNames: ['type', 'status'], // type: login, refresh, api_key; status: success, failure
      registers: [this.register]
    });

    this.activeSessions = new promClient.Gauge({
      name: 'qassure_active_sessions',
      help: 'Number of active sessions',
      labelNames: ['tenant_id'],
      registers: [this.register]
    });

    // API Key metrics
    this.apiKeyUsage = new promClient.Counter({
      name: 'qassure_api_key_usage_total',
      help: 'Total API key usage',
      labelNames: ['key_id', 'tenant_id'],
      registers: [this.register]
    });

    // Database metrics
    this.dbQueryDuration = new promClient.Histogram({
      name: 'qassure_db_query_duration_seconds',
      help: 'Duration of database queries in seconds',
      labelNames: ['operation', 'table'],
      buckets: [0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.5, 1],
      registers: [this.register]
    });

    this.dbConnectionPool = new promClient.Gauge({
      name: 'qassure_db_pool_size',
      help: 'Database connection pool size',
      labelNames: ['state'], // state: total, idle, waiting
      registers: [this.register]
    });

    // Redis metrics
    this.redisOperations = new promClient.Counter({
      name: 'qassure_redis_operations_total',
      help: 'Total Redis operations',
      labelNames: ['operation', 'status'],
      registers: [this.register]
    });

    this.cacheHitRate = new promClient.Counter({
      name: 'qassure_cache_hits_total',
      help: 'Cache hit/miss counter',
      labelNames: ['cache_type', 'result'], // result: hit, miss
      registers: [this.register]
    });

    // Business metrics
    this.tenantsActive = new promClient.Gauge({
      name: 'qassure_tenants_active',
      help: 'Number of active tenants',
      registers: [this.register]
    });

    this.usersTotal = new promClient.Gauge({
      name: 'qassure_users_total',
      help: 'Total number of users',
      labelNames: ['status'],
      registers: [this.register]
    });

    // AI Gateway metrics
    this.aiCompletions = new promClient.Counter({
      name: 'qassure_ai_completions_total',
      help: 'Total AI completion requests',
      labelNames: ['provider', 'model', 'status'],
      registers: [this.register]
    });

    this.aiTokensUsed = new promClient.Counter({
      name: 'qassure_ai_tokens_total',
      help: 'Total AI tokens used',
      labelNames: ['provider', 'model', 'type'], // type: input, output
      registers: [this.register]
    });

    this.aiLatency = new promClient.Histogram({
      name: 'qassure_ai_latency_seconds',
      help: 'AI completion latency in seconds',
      labelNames: ['provider', 'model'],
      buckets: [0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 30],
      registers: [this.register]
    });

    // QMS Integration metrics
    this.qmsSyncJobs = new promClient.Counter({
      name: 'qassure_qms_sync_jobs_total',
      help: 'Total QMS sync jobs',
      labelNames: ['connection_type', 'status'],
      registers: [this.register]
    });

    this.qmsSyncDuration = new promClient.Histogram({
      name: 'qassure_qms_sync_duration_seconds',
      help: 'QMS sync job duration in seconds',
      labelNames: ['connection_type'],
      buckets: [1, 5, 10, 30, 60, 300, 600],
      registers: [this.register]
    });

    // Error metrics
    this.errors = new promClient.Counter({
      name: 'qassure_errors_total',
      help: 'Total application errors',
      labelNames: ['type', 'code'],
      registers: [this.register]
    });
  }

  /**
   * Get metrics in Prometheus format
   */
  async getMetrics() {
    return await this.register.metrics();
  }

  /**
   * Get content type for metrics
   */
  getContentType() {
    return this.register.contentType;
  }

  // ==================== Recording Methods ====================

  /**
   * Record HTTP request
   */
  recordHttpRequest(method, route, statusCode, durationSeconds) {
    this.httpRequestDuration.observe(
      { method, route, status_code: statusCode },
      durationSeconds
    );
    this.httpRequestTotal.inc({ method, route, status_code: statusCode });
  }

  /**
   * Record authentication attempt
   */
  recordAuthAttempt(type, success) {
    this.authAttempts.inc({
      type,
      status: success ? 'success' : 'failure'
    });
  }

  /**
   * Record API key usage
   */
  recordApiKeyUsage(keyId, tenantId) {
    this.apiKeyUsage.inc({ key_id: keyId, tenant_id: tenantId });
  }

  /**
   * Record database query
   */
  recordDbQuery(operation, table, durationSeconds) {
    this.dbQueryDuration.observe({ operation, table }, durationSeconds);
  }

  /**
   * Record cache access
   */
  recordCacheAccess(cacheType, hit) {
    this.cacheHitRate.inc({
      cache_type: cacheType,
      result: hit ? 'hit' : 'miss'
    });
  }

  /**
   * Record AI completion
   */
  recordAiCompletion(provider, model, success, durationSeconds, inputTokens, outputTokens) {
    this.aiCompletions.inc({
      provider,
      model,
      status: success ? 'success' : 'failure'
    });

    if (success) {
      this.aiLatency.observe({ provider, model }, durationSeconds);
      this.aiTokensUsed.inc({ provider, model, type: 'input' }, inputTokens);
      this.aiTokensUsed.inc({ provider, model, type: 'output' }, outputTokens);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Record error
   */
  recordError(type, code) {
    this.errors.inc({ type, code });
  }

  /**
   * Update active sessions gauge
   */
  setActiveSessions(tenantId, count) {
    this.activeSessions.set({ tenant_id: tenantId }, count);
  }

  /**
   * Update pool stats
   */
  setDbPoolStats(total, idle, waiting) {
    this.dbConnectionPool.set({ state: 'total' }, total);
    this.dbConnectionPool.set({ state: 'idle' }, idle);
    this.dbConnectionPool.set({ state: 'waiting' }, waiting);
  }
}

// Singleton
let instance = null;
const getPrometheusService = () => {
  if (!instance) {
    instance = new PrometheusService();
  }
  return instance;
};

/**
 * Base QMS Adapter - QAssure Platform
 * Abstract base class for all QMS integrations
 */

class BaseQMSAdapter {
  constructor(config = {}) {
    this.name = 'base';
    this.displayName = 'Base QMS';
    this.version = '1.0.0';
    this.config = config;
    this.connected = false;
    
    // Supported entity types
    this.supportedEntities = [];
    
    // Supported operations
    this.supportedOperations = ['read', 'write', 'sync'];
    
    // Rate limiting
    this.rateLimits = {
      requestsPerMinute: 60,
      requestsPerHour: 1000
    };
  }

  // ==================== Connection ====================

  /**
   * Initialize connection to QMS
   * Must be implemented by subclass
   */
  async connect() {
    throw new Error('connect() must be implemented by subclass');
  }

  /**
   * Disconnect from QMS
   */
  async disconnect() {
    this.connected = false;
  }

  /**
   * Test connection
   */
  async testConnection() {
    try {
      await this.connect();
      const result = await this.healthCheck();
      return {
        success: true,
        message: 'Connection successful',
        details: result
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: error.message,
        error: error.code || 'CONNECTION_FAILED'
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * Health check
   * Must be implemented by subclass
   */
  async healthCheck() {
    throw new Error('healthCheck() must be implemented by subclass');
  }

  // ==================== Entity Operations ====================

  /**
   * Get available entity types
   */
  getEntityTypes() {
    return this.supportedEntities;
  }

  /**
   * Get entity schema/fields
   * Must be implemented by subclass
   */
  async getEntitySchema(entityType) {
    throw new Error('getEntitySchema() must be implemented by subclass');
  }

  /**
   * Get entity by ID
   * Must be implemented by subclass
   */
  async getEntity(entityType, entityId) {
    throw new Error('getEntity() must be implemented by subclass');
  }

  /**
   * List entities with pagination
   * Must be implemented by subclass
   */
  async listEntities(entityType, options = {}) {
    throw new Error('listEntities() must be implemented by subclass');
  }

  /**
   * Create entity
   * Must be implemented by subclass
   */
  async createEntity(entityType, data) {
    throw new Error('createEntity() must be implemented by subclass');
  }

  /**
   * Update entity
   * Must be implemented by subclass
   */
  async updateEntity(entityType, entityId, data) {
    throw new Error('updateEntity() must be implemented by subclass');
  }

  /**
   * Delete entity
   * Must be implemented by subclass
   */
  async deleteEntity(entityType, entityId) {
    throw new Error('deleteEntity() must be implemented by subclass');
  }

  // ==================== Sync Operations ====================

  /**
   * Get changes since last sync
   * Must be implemented by subclass
   */
  async getChanges(entityType, since, options = {}) {
    throw new Error('getChanges() must be implemented by subclass');
  }

  /**
   * Bulk fetch entities
   */
  async bulkFetch(entityType, entityIds) {
    const results = [];
    for (const id of entityIds) {
      try {
        const entity = await this.getEntity(entityType, id);
        results.push({ id, success: true, data: entity });
      } catch (error) {
        results.push({ id, success: false, error: error.message });
      }
    }
    return results;
  }

  /**
   * Bulk create entities
   */
  async bulkCreate(entityType, entities) {
    const results = [];
    for (const entity of entities) {
      try {
        const created = await this.createEntity(entityType, entity);
        results.push({ success: true, data: created });
      } catch (error) {
        results.push({ success: false, error: error.message, data: entity });
      }
    }
    return results;
  }

  /**
   * Bulk update entities
   */
  async bulkUpdate(entityType, updates) {
    const results = [];
    for (const { id, data } of updates) {
      try {
        const updated = await this.updateEntity(entityType, id, data);
        results.push({ id, success: true, data: updated });
      } catch (error) {
        results.push({ id, success: false, error: error.message });
      }
    }
    return results;
  }

  // ==================== Field Mapping ====================

  /**
   * Transform QMS entity to QAssure format
   * Override in subclass for custom mapping
   */
  transformToInternal(entityType, externalData) {
    return externalData;
  }

  /**
   * Transform QAssure entity to QMS format
   * Override in subclass for custom mapping
   */
  transformToExternal(entityType, internalData) {
    return internalData;
  }

  // ==================== Document Operations ====================

  /**
   * Get document content
   * Must be implemented by subclass if supported
   */
  async getDocumentContent(documentId) {
    throw new Error('getDocumentContent() not supported by this adapter');
  }

  /**
   * Upload document
   * Must be implemented by subclass if supported
   */
  async uploadDocument(entityType, entityId, file, metadata = {}) {
    throw new Error('uploadDocument() not supported by this adapter');
  }

  // ==================== Utilities ====================

  /**
   * Get adapter info
   */
  getInfo() {
    return {
      name: this.name,
      displayName: this.displayName,
      version: this.version,
      connected: this.connected,
      supportedEntities: this.supportedEntities,
      supportedOperations: this.supportedOperations,
      rateLimits: this.rateLimits
    };
  }

  /**
   * Validate configuration
   */
  validateConfig(config) {
    const errors = [];
    // Override in subclass to add specific validation
    return errors;
  }

  /**
   * Handle API errors
   */
  handleError(error) {
    return {
      code: error.code || 'UNKNOWN_ERROR',
      message: error.message,
      details: error.details || null,
      retryable: this.isRetryableError(error)
    };
  }

  /**
   * Check if error is retryable
   */
  isRetryableError(error) {
    const retryableCodes = [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504];
    return retryableCodes.includes(error.status || error.code);
  }
}

module.exports = { BaseQMSAdapter };

/**
 * Elasticsearch Service
 * Provides full-text search, analytics, and audit log storage
 */

const { Client } = require('@elastic/elasticsearch');

class ElasticsearchService {
  constructor() {
    this.client = null;
    this.indexPrefix = process.env.ELASTICSEARCH_INDEX_PREFIX || 'qassure';
    this.isConnected = false;
  }

  async connect() {
    try {
      const node = process.env.ELASTICSEARCH_NODE || 'http://localhost:9200';
      
      this.client = new Client({
        node,
        requestTimeout: 30000,
        sniffOnStart: false
      });

      const health = await this.client.cluster.health();
      this.isConnected = true;
      console.log('[Elasticsearch] Connected - Cluster:', health.cluster_name, 'Status:', health.status);
      
      await this.initializeIndices();
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Elasticsearch] Connection failed:', error.message);
      this.isConnected = false;
      return false;
    }
  }

  async disconnect() {
    if (this.client) {
      await this.client.close();
      this.isConnected = false;
    }
  }

  async initializeIndices() {
    const indices = [
      { name: 'documents', mapping: this._getDocumentMapping() },
      { name: 'capas', mapping: this._getCapaMapping() },
      { name: 'training', mapping: this._getTrainingMapping() },
      { name: 'suppliers', mapping: this._getSupplierMapping() },
      { name: 'audit-logs', mapping: this._getAuditLogMapping() }
    ];

    for (const index of indices) {
      const indexName = `${this.indexPrefix}-${index.name}`;
      try {
        const exists = await this.client.indices.exists({ index: indexName });
        if (!exists) {
          await this.client.indices.create({
            index: indexName,
            body: {
              settings: {
                number_of_shards: 1,
                number_of_replicas: 0,
                analysis: {
                  analyzer: {
                    qassure_analyzer: {
                      type: 'custom',
                      tokenizer: 'standard',
                      filter: ['lowercase', 'asciifolding']
                    }
                  }
                }
              },
              mappings: index.mapping
            }
          });
          console.log('[Elasticsearch] Created index:', indexName);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('[Elasticsearch] Error creating index', indexName, error.message);
      }
    }
  }

  async indexDocument(indexType, id, document, tenantId) {
    if (!this.isConnected) return null;
    
    const indexName = `${this.indexPrefix}-${indexType}`;
    try {
      const result = await this.client.index({
        index: indexName,
        id: id,
        document: {
          ...document,
          tenant_id: tenantId,
          indexed_at: new Date().toISOString()
        },
        refresh: true
      });
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Elasticsearch] Index error:', error.message);
      return null;
    }
  }

  async bulkIndex(indexType, documents, tenantId) {
    if (!this.isConnected || documents.length === 0) return null;
    
    const indexName = `${this.indexPrefix}-${indexType}`;
    const operations = documents.flatMap(doc => [
      { index: { _index: indexName, _id: doc.id } },
      { ...doc, tenant_id: tenantId, indexed_at: new Date().toISOString() }
    ]);

    try {
      const result = await this.client.bulk({ operations, refresh: true });
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Elasticsearch] Bulk index error:', error.message);
      return null;
    }
  }

  async deleteDocument(indexType, id) {
    if (!this.isConnected) return null;
    
    const indexName = `${this.indexPrefix}-${indexType}`;
    try {
      await this.client.delete({ index: indexName, id, refresh: true });
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  async search(indexType, query, tenantId, options = {}) {
    if (!this.isConnected) return { hits: [], total: 0 };
    
    const { page = 1, limit = 20, sort, filters = {} } = options;
    const indexName = `${this.indexPrefix}-${indexType}`;

    const must = [{ term: { tenant_id: tenantId } }];

    if (query) {
      must.push({
        multi_match: {
          query,
          fields: ['title^3', 'description^2', 'content', 'name^3', '*_number'],
          type: 'best_fields',
          fuzziness: 'AUTO'
        }
      });
    }

    for (const [field, value] of Object.entries(filters)) {
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        must.push({ terms: { [field]: value } });
      } else {
        must.push({ term: { [field]: value } });
      }
    }

    try {
      const result = await this.client.search({
        index: indexName,
        body: {
          from: (page - 1) * limit,
          size: limit,
          query: { bool: { must } },
          sort: sort || [{ _score: 'desc' }, { indexed_at: 'desc' }],
          highlight: {
            fields: { title: {}, description: {}, content: {} },
            pre_tags: ['<mark>'],
            post_tags: ['</mark>']
          }
        }
      });

      return {
        hits: result.hits.hits.map(hit => ({
          id: hit._id,
          score: hit._score,
          ...hit._source,
          highlights: hit.highlight
        })),
        total: result.hits.total.value
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Elasticsearch] Search error:', error.message);
      return { hits: [], total: 0 };
    }
  }

  async globalSearch(query, tenantId, options = {}) {
    if (!this.isConnected) return { results: [], total: 0 };
    
    const { limit = 20 } = options;
    const indices = ['documents', 'capas', 'training', 'suppliers']
      .map(i => `${this.indexPrefix}-${i}`);

    try {
      const result = await this.client.search({
        index: indices,
        body: {
          size: limit,
          query: {
            bool: {
              must: [
                { term: { tenant_id: tenantId } },
                {
                  multi_match: {
                    query,
                    fields: ['title^3', 'name^3', 'description^2', '*_number^2', 'content'],
                    type: 'best_fields',
                    fuzziness: 'AUTO'
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          },
          highlight: {
            fields: { '*': {} },
            pre_tags: ['<mark>'],
            post_tags: ['</mark>']
          }
        }
      });

      return {
        results: result.hits.hits.map(hit => ({
          id: hit._id,
          index: hit._index.replace(`${this.indexPrefix}-`, ''),
          score: hit._score,
          ...hit._source,
          highlights: hit.highlight
        })),
        total: result.hits.total.value
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Elasticsearch] Global search error:', error.message);
      return { results: [], total: 0 };
    }
  }

  async getAggregations(indexType, tenantId, aggregations) {
    if (!this.isConnected) return {};
    
    const indexName = `${this.indexPrefix}-${indexType}`;

    try {
      const result = await this.client.search({
        index: indexName,
        body: {
          size: 0,
          query: { term: { tenant_id: tenantId } },
          aggs: aggregations
        }
      });

      return result.aggregations;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Elasticsearch] Aggregation error:', error.message);
      return {};
    }
  }

  async logAudit(tenantId, logEntry) {
    const id = `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
    return this.indexDocument('audit-logs', id, {
      ...logEntry,
      tenant_id: tenantId,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    }, tenantId);
  }

  async searchAuditLogs(tenantId, options = {}) {
    const { userId, action, entityType, startDate, endDate, page = 1, limit = 50 } = options;
    
    const filters = {};
    if (userId) filters.user_id = userId;
    if (action) filters.action = action;
    if (entityType) filters.entity_type = entityType;

    return this.search('audit-logs', null, tenantId, {
      page,
      limit,
      filters,
      sort: [{ timestamp: 'desc' }]
    });
  }

  async healthCheck() {
    if (!this.client) {
      return { status: 'disconnected', healthy: false };
    }

    try {
      const health = await this.client.cluster.health();
      return {
        status: health.status,
        healthy: health.status !== 'red',
        cluster_name: health.cluster_name,
        number_of_nodes: health.number_of_nodes
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return { status: 'error', healthy: false, error: error.message };
    }
  }

  _getDocumentMapping() {
    return {
      properties: {
        tenant_id: { type: 'keyword' },
        document_number: { type: 'keyword' },
        title: { type: 'text', analyzer: 'qassure_analyzer' },
        description: { type: 'text', analyzer: 'qassure_analyzer' },
        category: { type: 'keyword' },
        status: { type: 'keyword' },
        version: { type: 'keyword' },
        indexed_at: { type: 'date' }
      }
    };
  }

  _getCapaMapping() {
    return {
      properties: {
        tenant_id: { type: 'keyword' },
        capa_number: { type: 'keyword' },
        title: { type: 'text', analyzer: 'qassure_analyzer' },
        description: { type: 'text', analyzer: 'qassure_analyzer' },
        problem_statement: { type: 'text', analyzer: 'qassure_analyzer' },
        capa_type: { type: 'keyword' },
        priority: { type: 'keyword' },
        status: { type: 'keyword' },
        indexed_at: { type: 'date' }
      }
    };
  }

  _getTrainingMapping() {
    return {
      properties: {
        tenant_id: { type: 'keyword' },
        course_code: { type: 'keyword' },
        title: { type: 'text', analyzer: 'qassure_analyzer' },
        description: { type: 'text', analyzer: 'qassure_analyzer' },
        category: { type: 'keyword' },
        status: { type: 'keyword' },
        indexed_at: { type: 'date' }
      }
    };
  }

  _getSupplierMapping() {
    return {
      properties: {
        tenant_id: { type: 'keyword' },
        supplier_code: { type: 'keyword' },
        name: { type: 'text', analyzer: 'qassure_analyzer' },
        supplier_type: { type: 'keyword' },
        category: { type: 'keyword' },
        status: { type: 'keyword' },
        current_score: { type: 'float' },
        score_grade: { type: 'keyword' },
        indexed_at: { type: 'date' }
      }
    };
  }

  _getAuditLogMapping() {
    return {
      properties: {
        tenant_id: { type: 'keyword' },
        user_id: { type: 'keyword' },
        user_email: { type: 'keyword' },
        action: { type: 'keyword' },
        entity_type: { type: 'keyword' },
        entity_id: { type: 'keyword' },
        entity_name: { type: 'text' },
        changes: { type: 'object', enabled: false },
        ip_address: { type: 'ip' },
        timestamp: { type: 'date' }
      }
    };
  }
}

let instance = null;

  if (!instance) instance = new ElasticsearchService();
  return instance;

/**
 * Elasticsearch Indexing Hooks
 * Auto-index data when created/updated in PostgreSQL
 */

const { getElasticsearchService } = require('./elasticsearch.service');

class IndexingHooks {
  
  // ============================================================================
  // CAPA INDEXING
  // ============================================================================

  static async indexCapa(capa, tenantId) {
    const es = getElasticsearchService();
    if (!es.isConnected) return;

    try {
      await es.indexDocument('capas', capa.id, {
        capa_number: capa.capa_number,
        title: capa.title,
        description: capa.description,
        problem_statement: capa.problem_statement,
        root_cause: capa.root_cause,
        capa_type: capa.capa_type,
        source: capa.source,
        priority: capa.priority,
        status: capa.status,
        department: capa.department,
        owner_id: capa.owner_id,
        identified_date: capa.identified_date,
        target_date: capa.target_date,
        closed_date: capa.closed_date
      }, tenantId);
      console.log('[ES Index] CAPA indexed:', capa.capa_number);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[ES Index] CAPA index error:', error.message);
    }
  }

  static async deleteCapa(capaId) {
    const es = getElasticsearchService();
    if (!es.isConnected) return;

    try {
      await es.deleteDocument('capas', capaId);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[ES Index] CAPA delete error:', error.message);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // DOCUMENT INDEXING
  // ============================================================================

  static async indexDocument(doc, tenantId) {

        status: doc.status,
        version: doc.current_version,
        department: doc.department,
        owner_id: doc.owner_id,
        effective_date: doc.effective_date,
        next_review_date: doc.next_review_date
      }, tenantId);
      console.log('[ES Index] Document indexed:', doc.document_number);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[ES Index] Document index error:', error.message);
    }
  }

  static async deleteDocument(docId) {
    const es = getElasticsearchService();

    try {
      await es.deleteDocument('documents', docId);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[ES Index] Document delete error:', error.message);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // SUPPLIER INDEXING
  // ============================================================================

  static async indexSupplier(supplier, tenantId) {
    const es = getElasticsearchService();
    if (!es.isConnected) return;

    try {

  // ============================================================================
  // TRAINING INDEXING
  // ============================================================================

  static async indexTrainingCourse(course, tenantId) {
    const es = getElasticsearchService();

    try {
      await es.indexDocument('training', course.id, {
        course_code: course.course_code,
        title: course.title,
        description: course.description,
        category: course.category,
        training_type: course.training_type,
        status: course.status,
        duration_minutes: course.duration_minutes,
        passing_score: course.passing_score
      }, tenantId);
      console.log('[ES Index] Training course indexed:', course.course_code);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[ES Index] Training index error:', error.message);
    }
  }

  static async deleteTrainingCourse(courseId) {
    const es = getElasticsearchService();
    if (!es.isConnected) return;

    try {
      await es.deleteDocument('training', courseId);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[ES Index] Training delete error:', error.message);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // AUDIT LOG INDEXING
  // ============================================================================

  static async indexAuditLog(logEntry, tenantId) {
    const es = getElasticsearchService();
    if (!es.isConnected) return;

    try {
      await es.logAudit(tenantId, logEntry);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[ES Index] Audit log error:', error.message);
    }
  }
}

module.exports = { IndexingHooks };
