/**
 * WebSocket Service
 * Real-time notifications via Socket.io
 */

const { Server } = require('socket.io');
const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');
const { pool } = require('../../config/database');

class SocketService {
  constructor() {
    this.io = null;
    this.userSockets = new Map();
  }

  initialize(httpServer) {
    this.io = new Server(httpServer, {
      cors: {
        origin: process.env.CORS_ORIGIN || '*',
        methods: ['GET', 'POST'],
        credentials: true
      },
      pingTimeout: 60000,
      pingInterval: 25000
    });

    // Auth middleware
    this.io.use(async (socket, next) => {
      try {
        const token = socket.handshake.auth.token || 
                      socket.handshake.headers.authorization?.replace('Bearer ', '');
        
        if (!token) return next(new Error('Authentication required'));

        const decoded = jwt.verify(token, process.env.JWT_SECRET);
        const result = await pool.query(
          'SELECT id, email, tenant_id FROM users WHERE id = $1 AND is_active = TRUE',
          [decoded.sub]
        );

        if (result.rows.length === 0) return next(new Error('User not found'));

        socket.user = {
          id: result.rows[0].id,
          email: result.rows[0].email,
          tenantId: result.rows[0].tenant_id
        };
        next();
      } catch (error) {
        next(new Error('Invalid token'));
      }
    });

    this.io.on('connection', (socket) => this._handleConnection(socket));
    console.log('[Socket.io] ✅ WebSocket server initialized');
    return this.io;
  }

  _handleConnection(socket) {
    const userId = socket.user.id;
    const tenantId = socket.user.tenantId;

    console.log(`[Socket.io] User connected: ${socket.user.email}`);

    if (!this.userSockets.has(userId)) {
      this.userSockets.set(userId, new Set());
    }
    this.userSockets.get(userId).add(socket.id);

    socket.join(`user:${userId}`);
    socket.join(`tenant:${tenantId}`);

    socket.emit('connected', {
      message: 'Connected to QAssure real-time notifications',
      userId,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    });

    socket.on('mark_read', async (data) => {
      if (data.notificationId) {
        await pool.query(
          'UPDATE notifications SET is_read = TRUE, read_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2',
          [data.notificationId, userId]
        );
        socket.emit('notification_read', { id: data.notificationId });
      }
    });

    socket.on('disconnect', () => {
      console.log(`[Socket.io] User disconnected: ${socket.user.email}`);
      const userSocketSet = this.userSockets.get(userId);
      if (userSocketSet) {
        userSocketSet.delete(socket.id);
        if (userSocketSet.size === 0) this.userSockets.delete(userId);
      }
    });
  }

  emitToUser(userId, event, data) {
    if (!this.io) return;
    this.io.to(`user:${userId}`).emit(event, { ...data, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
  }

  emitToTenant(tenantId, event, data) {
    if (!this.io) return;
    this.io.to(`tenant:${tenantId}`).emit(event, { ...data, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
  }

  pushNotification(userId, notification) {
    this.emitToUser(userId, 'notification', { type: 'new', notification });
  }

  async pushUnreadCount(userId, tenantId) {
    const result = await pool.query(
      `SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM notifications 
       WHERE user_id = $1 AND tenant_id = $2 AND is_read = FALSE 
       AND is_dismissed = FALSE AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW())`,
      [userId, tenantId]
    );
    this.emitToUser(userId, 'unread_count', { count: parseInt(result.rows[0].count) || 0 });
  }

  isUserOnline(userId) {
    return this.userSockets.has(userId) && this.userSockets.get(userId).size > 0;
  }

  getStats() {
    return {
      totalConnections: this.io ? this.io.sockets.sockets.size : 0,
      onlineUsers: this.userSockets.size,
      userIds: Array.from(this.userSockets.keys())
    };
  }
}

let instance = null;
const getSocketService = () => {
  if (!instance) instance = new SocketService();
  return instance;
};

module.exports = { SocketService, getSocketService };


========== FILE: ./src/middleware/apikey.middleware.js ==========
/**
 * API Key Authentication Middleware - QAssure Platform
 * Validates API keys for module-to-platform communication
 */
const { getApiKeyService } = require('../services/api_key.service');

/**
 * Authenticate request using API Key
 * Looks for X-API-Key header
 */
const authenticateApiKey = async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const apiKey = req.headers['x-api-key'];
    
    if (!apiKey) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'MISSING_API_KEY',
          message: 'API key is required',
          hint: 'Include X-API-Key header with your request'
        }
      });
    }

    const apiKeyService = getApiKeyService();
    const result = await apiKeyService.validate(apiKey);

    if (!result.valid) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'INVALID_API_KEY',
          message: result.error || 'Invalid API key'
        }
      });
    }

    // Attach API key info to request (similar to JWT user info)
    req.apiKey = result.apiKey;
    req.user = {
      id: result.apiKey.userId,
      tenantId: result.apiKey.tenantId,
      permissions: result.apiKey.permissions,
      isApiKey: true,
      apiKeyId: result.apiKey.id,
      apiKeyName: result.apiKey.name,
      moduleId: result.apiKey.moduleId
    };

    next();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[ApiKey Middleware] Authentication error:', error);
    return res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: {
        code: 'AUTH_ERROR',
        message: 'API key authentication failed'
      }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Authenticate with either JWT or API Key
 * Tries JWT first, then API Key
 */
const authenticateAny = async (req, res, next) => {
  const authHeader = req.headers.authorization;
  const apiKey = req.headers['x-api-key'];

  // If JWT token is present, use JWT auth
  if (authHeader && authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
    const { authenticate } = require('./auth.middleware');
    return authenticate(req, res, next);
  }

  // If API key is present, use API key auth
  if (apiKey) {
    return authenticateApiKey(req, res, next);
  }

  // Neither present
  return res.status(401).json({
    success: false,
    error: {
      code: 'MISSING_CREDENTIALS',
      message: 'Authentication required',
      hint: 'Include either Authorization: Bearer <token> OR X-API-Key: <key> header'
    }
  });
};

/**
 * Check if API key has required permission
 */
const authorizeApiKey = (resource, action) => {
  return async (req, res, next) => {
    if (!req.user || !req.user.isApiKey) {
      return next(); // Not an API key request, skip
    }

    const requiredPermission = `${resource}:${action}`;
    const permissions = req.user.permissions || [];

    // Check for exact permission or wildcards
    const hasPermission = 
      permissions.includes(requiredPermission) ||
      permissions.includes('*:*') ||
      permissions.includes(`${resource}:*`) ||
      permissions.includes(`*:${action}`);

    if (!hasPermission) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'FORBIDDEN',
          message: `API key does not have permission: ${requiredPermission}`,
          required: requiredPermission,
          available: permissions
        }
      });
    }

    next();
  };
};

module.exports = {
  authenticateApiKey,
  authenticateAny,
  authorizeApiKey
};


========== FILE: ./src/middleware/auth.middleware.js ==========
/**
 * Authentication & Authorization Middleware - QAssure Platform
 * Provides JWT verification, API Key validation, permission checking, and role-based access
 */
const { getJWTService } = require('../infrastructure/auth/jwt.service');
const { getPermissionService } = require('../infrastructure/auth/permission.service');
const { getApiKeyService } = require('../services/api_key.service');

/**
 * Authenticate request using JWT or API Key
 * Checks for API Key first (X-API-Key header), then JWT (Authorization: Bearer)
 */
const authenticate = async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    // Check for API Key first
    const apiKey = req.headers['x-api-key'];
    if (apiKey) {
      return authenticateWithApiKey(req, res, next, apiKey);
    }

    // Fall back to JWT authentication
    const jwtService = getJWTService();
    
    // Extract token from header
    const authHeader = req.headers.authorization;
    const token = jwtService.extractToken(authHeader);
    
    if (!token) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'MISSING_TOKEN',
          message: 'Authentication token is required',
          hint: 'Include Authorization: Bearer <token> header OR X-API-Key: <key> header'
        }
      });
    }

    // Verify token
    const result = jwtService.verifyAccessToken(token);
    
    if (!result.valid) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: result.error.code,
          message: result.error.message
        }
      });
    }

    // Attach user info to request
    req.user = {
      id: result.payload.userId,
      email: result.payload.email,
      tenantId: result.payload.tenantId,
      roles: result.payload.roles,
      permissions: result.payload.permissions,
      sessionId: result.payload.sessionId,
      isApiKey: false
    };

    // Check if token is about to expire (5 min threshold)
    if (jwtService.isTokenExpiring(token, 300)) {
      res.set('X-Token-Expiring', 'true');
    }

    next();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[Auth Middleware] Authentication error:', error);
    return res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: {
        code: 'AUTH_ERROR',
        message: 'Authentication failed'
      }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Authenticate using API Key
 * @param {Request} req 
 * @param {Response} res 
 * @param {Function} next 
 * @param {string} apiKey 
 */
const authenticateWithApiKey = async (req, res, next, apiKey) => {
  try {
    const apiKeyService = getApiKeyService();
    const result = await apiKeyService.validate(apiKey);

    if (!result.valid) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'INVALID_API_KEY',
          message: result.error || 'Invalid API key'
        }
      });
    }

    // Attach API key info to request (similar structure to JWT user)
    req.user = {
      id: result.apiKey.userId,
      tenantId: result.apiKey.tenantId,
      permissions: result.apiKey.permissions,
      isApiKey: true,
      apiKeyId: result.apiKey.id,
      apiKeyName: result.apiKey.name,
      moduleId: result.apiKey.moduleId
    };

    next();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[Auth Middleware] API Key authentication error:', error);
    return res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: {
        code: 'AUTH_ERROR',
        message: 'API key authentication failed'
      }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Optional authentication - doesn't fail if no token
 * Useful for public routes that behave differently for authenticated users
 */
const optionalAuth = async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    // Check for API Key first
    const apiKey = req.headers['x-api-key'];
    if (apiKey) {
      const apiKeyService = getApiKeyService();
      const result = await apiKeyService.validate(apiKey);
      if (result.valid) {
        req.user = {
          id: result.apiKey.userId,
          tenantId: result.apiKey.tenantId,
          permissions: result.apiKey.permissions,
          isApiKey: true,
          apiKeyId: result.apiKey.id,
          apiKeyName: result.apiKey.name,
          moduleId: result.apiKey.moduleId
        };
      }
      return next();
    }

    // Check for JWT
    const jwtService = getJWTService();
    const authHeader = req.headers.authorization;
    const token = jwtService.extractToken(authHeader);
    
    if (token) {
      const result = jwtService.verifyAccessToken(token);
      if (result.valid) {
        req.user = {
          id: result.payload.userId,
          email: result.payload.email,
          tenantId: result.payload.tenantId,
          roles: result.payload.roles,
          permissions: result.payload.permissions,
          sessionId: result.payload.sessionId,
          isApiKey: false
        };
      }
    }
    
    next();
  } catch (error) {
    // Don't fail on optional auth errors
    next();
  }
};

/**
 * Require specific permission(s)
 * @param {string} resource - Resource name
 * @param {string} action - Action name
 * @returns {Function} Express middleware
 * 
 * Usage: authorize('users', 'read')
 *        authorize('tenants', 'write')
 */
const authorize = (resource, action) => {
  // Handle resource:action format
  if (resource && resource.includes(":") && action === undefined) {
    const parts = resource.split(":");
    resource = parts[0];
    action = parts[1];
  }
  return async (req, res, next) => {
    try {
      if (!req.user) {
        return res.status(401).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            code: 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED',
            message: 'Authentication required'
          }
        });
      }

      const requiredPermission = `${resource}:${action}`;

      // For API Key authentication, check permissions from the key
      if (req.user.isApiKey) {
        const permissions = req.user.permissions || [];
        const hasPermission = 
          permissions.includes(requiredPermission) ||
          permissions.includes('*:*') ||
          permissions.includes(`${resource}:*`) ||
          permissions.includes(`*:${action}`);

        if (!hasPermission) {
          return res.status(403).json({
            success: false,
            error: {
              code: 'FORBIDDEN',
              message: `API key does not have permission: ${requiredPermission}`,
              required: requiredPermission
            }
          });
        }
        return next();
      }

      // For JWT authentication, use permission service
      const permissionService = getPermissionService();
      
      // Super admin bypasses all permission checks
      const isSuperAdmin = await permissionService.isSuperAdmin(req.user.id);
      if (isSuperAdmin) {
        req.user.isSuperAdmin = true;
        return next();
      }

      // Check permission from token first (faster)
      if (req.user.permissions && req.user.permissions.includes(requiredPermission)) {
        return next();
      }

      // Check wildcard permissions from token
      if (req.user.permissions) {
        if (req.user.permissions.includes('*:*')) return next();
        if (req.user.permissions.includes(`${resource}:*`)) return next();
        if (req.user.permissions.includes(`*:${action}`)) return next();
      }

      // Fallback: Check database (handles permission updates since token issued)
      const hasPermission = await permissionService.hasPermission(
        req.user.id,
        req.user.tenantId,
        resource,
        action
      );

      if (!hasPermission) {
        return res.status(403).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            code: 'FORBIDDEN',
            message: `You don't have permission to ${action} ${resource}`,
            required: requiredPermission
          }
        });
      }

      next();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Auth Middleware] Authorization error:', error);
      return res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'AUTHORIZATION_ERROR',
          message: 'Authorization check failed'
        }
      });
    }
  };
};

/**
 * Require ANY of the specified permissions
 * @param {Array<{resource: string, action: string}>} permissions
 * @returns {Function} Express middleware
 * 
 * Usage: authorizeAny([
 *   { resource: 'users', action: 'read' },
 *   { resource: 'users', action: 'admin' }
 * ])
 */
const authorizeAny = (permissions) => {
  return async (req, res, next) => {
    try {
      if (!req.user) {
        return res.status(401).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            code: 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED',
            message: 'Authentication required'
          }
        });
      }

      // For API Key authentication
      if (req.user.isApiKey) {
        const userPerms = req.user.permissions || [];
        const hasAny = permissions.some(p => {
          const required = `${p.resource}:${p.action}`;
          return userPerms.includes(required) ||
                 userPerms.includes('*:*') ||
                 userPerms.includes(`${p.resource}:*`) ||
                 userPerms.includes(`*:${p.action}`);
        });

        if (!hasAny) {
          return res.status(403).json({
            success: false,
            error: {
              code: 'FORBIDDEN',
              message: 'Insufficient permissions',
              requiredAny: permissions.map(p => `${p.resource}:${p.action}`)
            }
          });
        }
        return next();
      }

      const permissionService = getPermissionService();
      
      // Super admin bypasses
      if (await permissionService.isSuperAdmin(req.user.id)) {
        req.user.isSuperAdmin = true;
        return next();
      }

      const hasAny = await permissionService.hasAnyPermission(
        req.user.id,
        req.user.tenantId,
        permissions
      );

      if (!hasAny) {
        return res.status(403).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            code: 'FORBIDDEN',
            message: 'Insufficient permissions',
            requiredAny: permissions.map(p => `${p.resource}:${p.action}`)
          }
        });
      }

      next();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Auth Middleware] Authorization error:', error);
      return res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'AUTHORIZATION_ERROR',
          message: 'Authorization check failed'
        }
      });
    }
  };
};

/**
 * Require ALL of the specified permissions
 * @param {Array<{resource: string, action: string}>} permissions
 * @returns {Function} Express middleware
 */
const authorizeAll = (permissions) => {
  return async (req, res, next) => {
    try {
      if (!req.user) {
        return res.status(401).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            code: 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED',
            message: 'Authentication required'
          }
        });
      }

      // For API Key authentication
      if (req.user.isApiKey) {
        const userPerms = req.user.permissions || [];
        const hasAll = permissions.every(p => {
          const required = `${p.resource}:${p.action}`;
          return userPerms.includes(required) ||
                 userPerms.includes('*:*') ||
                 userPerms.includes(`${p.resource}:*`) ||
                 userPerms.includes(`*:${p.action}`);
        });

        if (!hasAll) {
          return res.status(403).json({
            success: false,
            error: {
              code: 'FORBIDDEN',
              message: 'Missing required permissions',
              requiredAll: permissions.map(p => `${p.resource}:${p.action}`)
            }
          });
        }
        return next();
      }

      const permissionService = getPermissionService();
      
      // Super admin bypasses
      if (await permissionService.isSuperAdmin(req.user.id)) {
        req.user.isSuperAdmin = true;
        return next();
      }

      const hasAll = await permissionService.hasAllPermissions(
        req.user.id,
        req.user.tenantId,
        permissions
      );

      if (!hasAll) {
        return res.status(403).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            code: 'FORBIDDEN',
            message: 'Missing required permissions',
            requiredAll: permissions.map(p => `${p.resource}:${p.action}`)
          }
        });
      }

      next();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Auth Middleware] Authorization error:', error);
      return res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'AUTHORIZATION_ERROR',
          message: 'Authorization check failed'
        }
      });
    }
  };
};

/**
 * Require specific role(s)
 * @param {string|Array<string>} roles - Required role(s)
 * @returns {Function} Express middleware
 * 
 * Usage: requireRole('tenant_admin')
 *        requireRole(['tenant_admin', 'quality_manager'])
 */
const requireRole = (roles) => {
  const roleArray = Array.isArray(roles) ? roles : [roles];
  
  return async (req, res, next) => {
    try {
      if (!req.user) {
        return res.status(401).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            code: 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED',
            message: 'Authentication required'
          }
        });
      }

      // API Keys don't have roles - they have permissions
      if (req.user.isApiKey) {
        return res.status(403).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            code: 'FORBIDDEN',
            message: 'This endpoint requires user authentication with specific roles',
            requiredRoles: roleArray
          }
        });
      }

      const permissionService = getPermissionService();
      
      // Super admin bypasses
      if (await permissionService.isSuperAdmin(req.user.id)) {
        req.user.isSuperAdmin = true;
        return next();
      }

      const hasRole = await permissionService.hasAnyRole(
        req.user.id,
        req.user.tenantId,
        roleArray
      );

      if (!hasRole) {
        return res.status(403).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            code: 'FORBIDDEN',
            message: 'Required role not assigned',
            requiredRoles: roleArray
          }
        });
      }

      next();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Auth Middleware] Role check error:', error);
      return res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'ROLE_CHECK_ERROR',
          message: 'Role verification failed'
        }
      });
    }
  };
};

/**
 * Require super admin access
 */
const requireSuperAdmin = async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED',
          message: 'Authentication required'
        }
      });
    }

    // API Keys cannot be super admin
    if (req.user.isApiKey) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'FORBIDDEN',
          message: 'Super admin access required (API keys not allowed)'
        }
      });
    }

    const permissionService = getPermissionService();
    const isSuperAdmin = await permissionService.isSuperAdmin(req.user.id);

    if (!isSuperAdmin) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'FORBIDDEN',
          message: 'Super admin access required'
        }
      });
    }

    req.user.isSuperAdmin = true;
    next();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[Auth Middleware] Super admin check error:', error);
    return res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: {
        code: 'AUTH_ERROR',
        message: 'Authorization check failed'
      }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Require tenant admin access
 */
const requireTenantAdmin = async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED',
          message: 'Authentication required'
        }
      });
    }

    // API Keys cannot be tenant admin
    if (req.user.isApiKey) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'FORBIDDEN',
          message: 'Tenant admin access required (API keys not allowed)'
        }
      });
    }

    const permissionService = getPermissionService();
    
    // Super admin can act as tenant admin
    if (await permissionService.isSuperAdmin(req.user.id)) {
      req.user.isSuperAdmin = true;
      return next();
    }

    const isTenantAdmin = await permissionService.isTenantAdmin(
      req.user.id,
      req.user.tenantId
    );

    if (!isTenantAdmin) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'FORBIDDEN',
          message: 'Tenant admin access required'
        }
      });
    }

    req.user.isTenantAdmin = true;
    next();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[Auth Middleware] Tenant admin check error:', error);
    return res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: {
        code: 'AUTH_ERROR',
        message: 'Authorization check failed'
      }
    });
  }
};

module.exports = {
  authenticate,
  optionalAuth,
  authorize,
  authorizeAny,
  authorizeAll,
  requireRole,
  requireSuperAdmin,
  requireTenantAdmin
};

========== FILE: ./src/middleware/correlation.middleware.js ==========
/**
 * Correlation ID Middleware - QAssure Platform
 * Adds unique request ID for distributed tracing
 */
const crypto = require('crypto');

/**
 * Generate or extract correlation ID for each request
 */
const correlationId = (req, res, next) => {
  // Check for existing correlation ID in headers
  const existingId = req.headers['x-correlation-id'] || 
                     req.headers['x-request-id'] ||
                     req.headers['traceparent'];

  // Generate new ID if not provided
  const correlationId = existingId || generateCorrelationId();

  // Attach to request object
  req.correlationId = correlationId;
  req.requestStartTime = Date.now();

  // Add to response headers
  res.setHeader('X-Correlation-ID', correlationId);
  res.setHeader('X-Request-ID', correlationId);

  // Log request start
  if (process.env.LOG_REQUESTS === 'true') {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({
      type: 'request_start',
      correlationId,
      method: req.method,
      path: req.path,
      query: req.query,
      userAgent: req.headers['user-agent'],
      ip: req.ip || req.connection?.remoteAddress,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    }));
  }

  // Capture response finish
  res.on('finish', () => {
    const duration = Date.now() - req.requestStartTime;

    if (process.env.LOG_REQUESTS === 'true') {
      console.log(JSON.stringify({
        type: 'request_end',
        correlationId,
        method: req.method,
        path: req.path,
        statusCode: res.statusCode,
        duration: `${duration}ms`,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      }));
    }
  });

  next();
};

/**
 * Generate a unique correlation ID
 * Format: timestamp-random (e.g., 1703423456789-a1b2c3d4)
 */
function generateCorrelationId() {
  const timestamp = Date.now();
  const random = crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex');
  return `${timestamp}-${random}`;
}

/**
 * Get correlation ID from request (for use in services)
 */
const getCorrelationId = (req) => {
  return req?.correlationId || 'unknown';
};

/**
 * Create a child logger with correlation ID
 */
const createCorrelatedLogger = (req, baseLogger) => {
  const correlationId = getCorrelationId(req);
  
  return {
    info: (message, meta = {}) => {
      baseLogger.info(message, { ...meta, correlationId });
    },
    warn: (message, meta = {}) => {
      baseLogger.warn(message, { ...meta, correlationId });
    },
    error: (message, meta = {}) => {
      baseLogger.error(message, { ...meta, correlationId });
    },
    debug: (message, meta = {}) => {
      baseLogger.debug(message, { ...meta, correlationId });
    }
  };
};

module.exports = {
  correlationId,
  getCorrelationId,
  generateCorrelationId,
  createCorrelatedLogger
};

========== FILE: ./src/middleware/metrics.middleware.js ==========
/**
 * Metrics Middleware - QAssure Platform
 * Records HTTP request metrics for Prometheus
 */
const { getPrometheusService } = require('../infrastructure/metrics/prometheus.service');

/**
 * Middleware to record HTTP request metrics
 */
const metricsMiddleware = (req, res, next) => {
  const startTime = process.hrtime.bigint();

  // Capture response finish
  res.on('finish', () => {
    const endTime = process.hrtime.bigint();
    const durationNs = Number(endTime - startTime);
    const durationSeconds = durationNs / 1e9;

    // Normalize route for metrics (replace IDs with :id)
    const route = normalizeRoute(req.route?.path || req.path);

    try {
      const prometheusService = getPrometheusService();
      prometheusService.recordHttpRequest(
        req.method,
        route,
        res.statusCode,
        durationSeconds
      );

      // Record errors
      if (res.statusCode >= 400) {
        prometheusService.recordError(
          res.statusCode >= 500 ? 'server_error' : 'client_error',
          res.statusCode.toString()
        );
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // Don't let metrics recording break the app
      console.error('[MetricsMiddleware] Error recording metrics:', err.message);
    }
  });

  next();
};

/**
 * Normalize route path by replacing UUIDs and numeric IDs
 */
function normalizeRoute(path) {
  if (!path) return 'unknown';
  
  return path
    // Replace UUIDs
    .replace(/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/gi, ':id')
    // Replace numeric IDs
    .replace(/\/\d+/g, '/:id')
    // Clean up any double colons
    .replace(/:+/g, ':');
}

module.exports = { metricsMiddleware, normalizeRoute };


========== FILE: ./src/middleware/tenant.middleware.js ==========
/**
 * Tenant Middleware - QAssure Platform
 * Handles multi-tenancy isolation and context
 */
const database = require('../config/database');

// Tenant cache for performance
const tenantCache = new Map();
const CACHE_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 minutes

/**
 * Extract and validate tenant context
 */
const tenantContext = async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    let tenantId = 
      req.headers['x-tenant-id'] ||
      req.user?.tenantId ||
      req.query.tenant_id ||
      process.env.DEFAULT_TENANT_ID;

    if (!tenantId) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'MISSING_TENANT',
          message: 'Tenant context is required'
        }
      });
    }

    // Validate UUID format
    const uuidRegex = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
    if (!uuidRegex.test(tenantId)) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'INVALID_TENANT_ID',
          message: 'Invalid tenant ID format'
        }
      });
    }

    // Check cache
    const cached = tenantCache.get(tenantId);
    if (cached && cached.expiresAt > Date.now()) {
      req.tenant = cached.tenant;
      req.tenantId = tenantId;
      return next();
    }

    // Fetch from database
    const result = await database.query(
      'SELECT * FROM tenants WHERE id = $1',
      [tenantId]
    );

    if (result.rows.length === 0) {
      return res.status(404).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'TENANT_NOT_FOUND',
          message: 'Tenant not found'
        }
      });
    }

    const tenant = result.rows[0];

    if (tenant.status !== 'active' && tenant.status !== 'ACTIVE') {
      return res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'TENANT_INACTIVE',
          message: `Tenant is ${tenant.status}`
        }
      });
    }

    // Cache tenant
    tenantCache.set(tenantId, {
      tenant: {
        id: tenant.id,
        name: tenant.name,
        slug: tenant.slug,
        status: tenant.status,
        subscription_tier: tenant.subscription_tier,
        settings: tenant.settings
      },
      expiresAt: Date.now() + CACHE_TTL
    });

    req.tenant = tenantCache.get(tenantId).tenant;
    req.tenantId = tenantId;
    res.set('X-Tenant-ID', tenantId);

    next();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[Tenant Middleware] Error:', error);
    return res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: {
        code: 'TENANT_ERROR',
        message: 'Failed to resolve tenant context'
      }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Verify user has access to the requested tenant
 */
const verifyTenantAccess = async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'NOT_AUTHENTICATED', message: 'Authentication required' }
      });
    }

    if (!req.tenantId) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'MISSING_TENANT', message: 'Tenant context required' }
      });
    }

    // Super admins can access any tenant
    if (req.user.isSuperAdmin) {
      return next();
    }

    // Check if user's token tenant matches
    if (req.user.tenantId === req.tenantId) {
      return next();
    }

    // Check user_tenants table
    const result = await database.query(
      `SELECT id FROM user_tenants 
       WHERE user_id = $1 AND tenant_id = $2 AND status = 'ACTIVE'`,
      [req.user.id, req.tenantId]
    );

    if (result.rows.length === 0) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED',
          message: 'You do not have access to this tenant'
        }
      });
    }

    next();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[Tenant Middleware] Access error:', error);
    return res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: { code: 'TENANT_ERROR', message: 'Failed to verify tenant access' }
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Optional tenant context
 */
const optionalTenantContext = async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const tenantId = 
      req.headers['x-tenant-id'] ||
      req.user?.tenantId ||
      req.query.tenant_id;

    if (tenantId) {
      const result = await database.query(
        'SELECT * FROM tenants WHERE id = $1',
        [tenantId]
      );
      
      if (result.rows.length > 0) {
        const tenant = result.rows[0];
        req.tenant = {
          id: tenant.id,
          name: tenant.name,
          slug: tenant.slug,
          status: tenant.status,
          subscription_tier: tenant.subscription_tier,
          settings: tenant.settings
        };
        req.tenantId = tenantId;
      }
    }
    next();
  } catch (error) {
    next();
  }
};

/**
 * Check if tenant has a feature enabled
 */
const requireFeature = (featureName) => {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    if (!req.tenant) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'MISSING_TENANT', message: 'Tenant context required' }
      });
    }

    const settings = req.tenant.settings || {};
    if (!settings[featureName]) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'FEATURE_DISABLED',
          message: `Feature '${featureName}' is not enabled`
        }
      });
    }

    next();
  };
};

/**
 * Check subscription tier
 */
const requireSubscriptionTier = (allowedTiers) => {
  const tiers = Array.isArray(allowedTiers) ? allowedTiers : [allowedTiers];
  
  return (req, res, next) => {
    if (!req.tenant) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: { code: 'MISSING_TENANT', message: 'Tenant context required' }
      });
    }

    if (!tiers.includes(req.tenant.subscription_tier)) {
      return res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED',
          message: `Requires ${tiers.join(' or ')} subscription`
        }
      });
    }

    next();
  };
};

const clearTenantCache = (tenantId = null) => {
  if (tenantId) {
    tenantCache.delete(tenantId);
  } else {
    tenantCache.clear();
  }
};

module.exports = {
  tenantContext,
  verifyTenantAccess,
  optionalTenantContext,
  requireFeature,
  requireSubscriptionTier,
  clearTenantCache
};


========== FILE: ./src/middleware/uuid.middleware.js ==========
/**
 * UUID Validation Middleware - QAssure Platform
 * Validates UUID parameters to return 400 instead of 500 on invalid UUIDs
 */

const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

/**
 * Validates that a specific parameter is a valid UUID
 * @param {string} paramName - The name of the URL parameter to validate
 */
const validateUUID = (paramName) => {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    const value = req.params[paramName];
    
    if (value && !UUID_REGEX.test(value)) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'INVALID_UUID',
          message: `Invalid UUID format for parameter: ${paramName}`,
          details: {
            parameter: paramName,
            value: value
          }
        }
      });
    }
    
    next();
  };
};

/**
 * Validates multiple UUID parameters
 * @param {...string} paramNames - The names of URL parameters to validate
 */
const validateUUIDs = (...paramNames) => {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    for (const paramName of paramNames) {
      const value = req.params[paramName];
      
      if (value && !UUID_REGEX.test(value)) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: {
            code: 'INVALID_UUID',
            message: `Invalid UUID format for parameter: ${paramName}`,
            details: {
              parameter: paramName,
              value: value
            }
          }
        });
      }
    }
    
    next();
  };
};

/**
 * Validates UUID in request body
 * @param {string} fieldName - The name of the body field to validate
 */
const validateBodyUUID = (fieldName) => {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    const value = req.body[fieldName];
    
    if (value && !UUID_REGEX.test(value)) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'INVALID_UUID',
          message: `Invalid UUID format for field: ${fieldName}`,
          details: {
            field: fieldName,
            value: value
          }
        }
      });
    }
    
    next();
  };
};

/**
 * Auto-validates all common UUID parameter names (id, userId, tenantId, etc.)
 */
const autoValidateUUIDs = (req, res, next) => {
  const uuidParams = ['id', 'userId', 'user_id', 'tenantId', 'tenant_id', 'roleId', 'role_id', 
                      'sessionId', 'session_id', 'documentId', 'document_id', 'capaId', 'capa_id',
                      'supplierId', 'supplier_id', 'moduleId', 'module_id', 'keyId', 'key_id',
                      'signatureId', 'signature_id', 'workflowId', 'workflow_id', 'taskId', 'task_id',
                      'collectionId', 'collection_id', 'promptId', 'prompt_id', 'reportId', 'report_id',
                      'webhookId', 'webhook_id', 'templateId', 'template_id', 'courseId', 'course_id',
                      'recordId', 'record_id', 'assignmentId', 'assignment_id'];
  
  for (const paramName of uuidParams) {
    const value = req.params[paramName];
    
    if (value && !UUID_REGEX.test(value)) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: {
          code: 'INVALID_UUID',
          message: `Invalid UUID format for parameter: ${paramName}`,
          details: {
            parameter: paramName,
            value: value
          }
        }
      });
    }
  }
  
  next();
};

/**
 * Utility function to check if a string is a valid UUID
 */
const isValidUUID = (str) => {
  return UUID_REGEX.test(str);
};

module.exports = {
  validateUUID,
  validateUUIDs,
  validateBodyUUID,
  autoValidateUUIDs,
  isValidUUID,
  UUID_REGEX
};


========== FILE: ./src/middleware/validationMiddleware.js ==========
/**
 * Validation Middleware for Zod Schemas
 * Generic validation middleware factory that works with any Zod schema
 */

/**
 * Create a validation middleware function for a Zod schema
 * @param {z.ZodSchema} schema - Zod schema to validate against
 * @param {string} source - Source of data to validate ('body', 'params', 'query', default: 'body')
 * @returns {Function} Express middleware function
 */
const validate = (schema, source = 'body') => {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    try {
      // Get data from the specified source
      const data = source === 'params' 
        ? req.params 
        : source === 'query' 
        ? req.query 
        : req.body;

      // Validate data against schema
      const result = schema.safeParse(data);

      if (!result.success) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          error: 'Validation failed',
          details: result.error.errors.map(err => ({
            path: err.path.join('.'),
            message: err.message,
            code: err.code
          }))
        });
      }

      // Attach validated data to request object
      if (source === 'params') {
        req.params = result.data;
      } else if (source === 'query') {
        req.query = result.data;
      } else {
        req.body = result.data;
      }

      next();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[ValidationMiddleware] Error:', error);
      return res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Validation middleware error',
        message: error.message
      });
    }
  };
};

module.exports = {
  validate
};

 * 
 * This migration ensures all components for Module SSO Launch are in place:
 * 1. Ensures tenant_module_access table exists (created in 026)
 * 2. Ensures module_launch_tokens table exists (created in 027)
 * 3. Ensures api_keys has module_id column (added in 040)
 * 4. Ensures api_keys has key_prefix column (added in 023)
 * 5. Creates module_user role if it doesn't exist

    } else {

    }

    // ============================================================================
    // 3. Ensure api_keys has module_id column (should already exist from 040)
    // ============================================================================
    const [apiKeysModuleIdExists] = await sequelize.query(`

        WHERE table_schema = 'public'

      );

    }

    // ============================================================================

========== FILE: ./src/migrations/migrate.js ==========
/**
 * Migration Runner - Executes Sequelize migrations in order
 * Usage: npm run migrate
 * Can be imported and called programmatically: const { runMigrations } = require('./migrate.js');
 */
require('dotenv').config();
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { sequelize } = require('../config/database');

// Migration tracking table
async function createMigrationsTable() {
  await sequelize.query(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations (
      version VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY,
      applied_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )
  `);
}

async function isMigrationApplied(version) {
  const [results] = await sequelize.query(
    'SELECT version FROM schema_migrations WHERE version = $1',
    { bind: [version] }
  );
  return results.length > 0;
}

async function markMigrationApplied(version) {
  await sequelize.query(
    'INSERT INTO schema_migrations (version) VALUES ($1) ON CONFLICT (version) DO NOTHING',
    { bind: [version] }
  );
}

async function markMigrationUndone(version) {
  await sequelize.query(
    'DELETE FROM schema_migrations WHERE version = $1',
    { bind: [version] }
  );
}

async function runMigrations() {
  const isUndo = process.argv.includes('--undo');
  
  console.log(isUndo ? '🔄 Starting migration rollback...' : '🚀 Starting database migrations...');

  try {
    // Create migrations tracking table
    await createMigrationsTable();
    console.log('✅ Migration tracking table ready');

    // Get all migration files in order
    const migrationsDir = __dirname;
    const migrationFiles = fs.readdirSync(migrationsDir)
      .filter(file => file.match(/^\d{3}_.*\.js$/) && file !== 'migrate.js')
      .sort();

    if (isUndo) {
      // Undo migrations in reverse order
      for (const file of migrationFiles.reverse()) {
        if (await isMigrationApplied(file)) {
          console.log(`🔄 Rolling back: ${file}`);
          const migration = require(path.join(migrationsDir, file));
          if (migration.down) {
            await migration.down(sequelize.getQueryInterface(), sequelize.Sequelize);
            await markMigrationUndone(file);
            console.log(`✅ Rolled back: ${file}`);
          }
        }
      }
    } else {
      // Apply migrations in order
      let appliedCount = 0;
      let skippedCount = 0;

      for (const file of migrationFiles) {
        if (await isMigrationApplied(file)) {
          console.log(`⏭️  Skipping (already applied): ${file}`);
          skippedCount++;
          continue;
        }

        console.log(`📄 Running: ${file}`);
        const migration = require(path.join(migrationsDir, file));
        
        if (migration.up) {
          await migration.up(sequelize.getQueryInterface(), sequelize.Sequelize);
          await markMigrationApplied(file);
          console.log(`✅ Applied: ${file}`);
          appliedCount++;
        }
      }

      console.log(`\n📊 Migration summary: ${appliedCount} applied, ${skippedCount} skipped`);
    }

    // List tables
    const [tables] = await sequelize.query(`
      SELECT table_name 
      FROM information_schema.tables 
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' 
      ORDER BY table_name
    `);
    console.log('\n🔍 Database tables:', tables.map(t => t.table_name).join(', '));

  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Migration failed:', error.message);
    console.error(error);
    // Don't exit on migration errors - let the server start anyway
    // This allows the container to continue even if some migrations have issues
    console.warn('⚠️  Continuing despite migration error...');
    // process.exit(1); // Commented out to allow container to continue
  } finally {
    await sequelize.close();
    console.log('\n🔌 Database connection closed');
  }
}

// Run if called directly
if (require.main === module) {
  runMigrations();
}

module.exports = { runMigrations };

========== FILE: ./src/routes/ai.routes.js ==========
/**
 * AI Routes - QAssure Platform
 * Routes for AI Gateway endpoints
 */
const express = require('express');
const router = express.Router();
const aiController = require('../controllers/ai.controller');
const { authenticate, authorize } = require('../middleware/auth.middleware');

// All AI routes require authentication
router.use(authenticate);

// ==========================================
// PROVIDERS
// ==========================================

// List available providers
router.get('/providers', 
  authorize('ai:read'),
  aiController.getProviders
);

// Get provider health
router.get('/providers/:provider/health',
  authorize('ai:read'),
  aiController.getProviderHealth
);

// ==========================================
// MODELS
// ==========================================

// List available models
router.get('/models',
  authorize('ai:read'),
  aiController.getModels
);

// ==========================================
// HEALTH
// ==========================================

// Get overall AI gateway health
router.get('/health',
  authorize('ai:read'),
  aiController.getHealthStatus
);

// ==========================================
// COMPLETIONS
// ==========================================

// Create completion
router.post('/completions',
  authorize('ai:create'),
  aiController.createCompletion
);

// List completions
router.get('/completions',
  authorize('ai:read'),
  aiController.listCompletions
);

// Get completion by ID
router.get('/completions/:id',
  authorize('ai:read'),
  aiController.getCompletion
);

// ==========================================
// COSTS
// ==========================================

// Get cost summary
router.get('/costs',
  authorize('ai:read'),
  aiController.getCostSummary
);

// ==========================================
// PLAYGROUND
// ==========================================

// Test prompts without tracking
router.post('/playground',
  authorize('ai:create'),
  aiController.playground
);

module.exports = router;

/**
 * API Key Permission Routes - QAssure Platform
 * /api/v1/api-key-permissions/*

const express = require('express');
const apikeypermissionController = require('../controllers/api_key_permission_controller');
const { 
  CreateApikeypermissionSchema, 
  UpdateApikeypermissionSchema,
  ApikeypermissionParamsSchema 
} = require('../validation/api_key_permission.schema');
const { validate } = require('../middleware/validationMiddleware');
const { authenticate, authorize } = require('../middleware/auth.middleware');
const { tenantContext, verifyTenantAccess } = require('../middleware/tenant.middleware');

const router = express.Router();

// Validation middleware helper
const validateCreate = validate(CreateApikeypermissionSchema);
const validateUpdate = validate(UpdateApikeypermissionSchema);
const validateParams = validate(ApikeypermissionParamsSchema, 'params');

// Apply authentication to all routes
router.use(authenticate);
router.use(tenantContext);
router.use(verifyTenantAccess);

/**
 * GET /api/v1/api-key-permissions
 * Get all API key permissions
 */
router.get('/', 
  authorize('api_key_permissions', 'read'),
  apikeypermissionController.findAll.bind(apikeypermissionController)
);

/**
 * GET /api/v1/api-key-permissions/:id
 * Get API key permission by ID
 */
router.get('/:id', 
  validateParams,
  authorize('api_key_permissions', 'read'),
  apikeypermissionController.findById.bind(apikeypermissionController)
);

/**
 * POST /api/v1/api-key-permissions
 * Create new API key permission
 */
router.post('/', 
  validateCreate,
  authorize('api_key_permissions', 'create'),
  apikeypermissionController.create.bind(apikeypermissionController)
);

/**
 * PUT /api/v1/api-key-permissions/:id
 * Update API key permission
 */
router.put('/:id', 
  validateParams, 
  validateUpdate,
  authorize('api_key_permissions', 'update'),
  apikeypermissionController.update.bind(apikeypermissionController)
);

/**
 * DELETE /api/v1/api-key-permissions/:id
 * Delete API key permission
 */
router.delete('/:id', 
  validateParams,
  authorize('api_key_permissions', 'delete'),
  apikeypermissionController.delete.bind(apikeypermissionController)
);

module.exports = router;


========== FILE: ./src/routes/api_key_routes.js ==========
/**
 * API Key Routes - QAssure Platform
 * /api/v1/api-keys/*
 */
const express = require('express');
const router = express.Router();
const apiKeyController = require('../controllers/api_key.controller');
const { authenticate, authorize } = require('../middleware/auth.middleware');
const { tenantContext, verifyTenantAccess } = require('../middleware/tenant.middleware');
const { validate } = require('../middleware/validationMiddleware');
const {
  CreateApiKeySchema,
  UpdateApiKeySchema,
  ValidateApiKeySchema,
  ApiKeyParamsSchema,
} = require('../validation/api_key.schema');

// Apply authentication to all routes
router.use(authenticate);
router.use(tenantContext);
router.use(verifyTenantAccess);

// Validation middleware helpers
const validateCreate = validate(CreateApiKeySchema);
const validateUpdate = validate(UpdateApiKeySchema);
const validateParams = validate(ApiKeyParamsSchema, 'params');
const validateKey = validate(ValidateApiKeySchema);

/**
 * POST /api/v1/api-keys
 * Create new API key
 */
router.post('/',
  validateCreate,
  authorize('api_keys', 'create'),
  apiKeyController.create
);

/**
 * GET /api/v1/api-keys
 * List API keys
 */
router.get('/',
  authorize('api_keys', 'read'),
  apiKeyController.list
);

/**
 * POST /api/v1/api-keys/validate
 * Validate an API key (must be before :id route)
 */
router.post('/validate',
  validateKey,
  authorize('api_keys', 'read'),
  apiKeyController.validate
);

/**
 * GET /api/v1/api-keys/:id
 * Get API key by ID
 */
router.get('/:id',
  validateParams,
  authorize('api_keys', 'read'),
  apiKeyController.getById
);

/**
 * PUT /api/v1/api-keys/:id
 * Update API key
 */
router.put('/:id',
  validateParams,
  validateUpdate,
  authorize('api_keys', 'update'),
  apiKeyController.update
);

/**
 * POST /api/v1/api-keys/:id/revoke
 * Revoke API key
 */
router.post('/:id/revoke',
  validateParams,
  authorize('api_keys', 'delete'),
  apiKeyController.revoke
);

/**
 * POST /api/v1/api-keys/:id/regenerate
 * Regenerate API key
 */
router.post('/:id/regenerate',
  validateParams,
  authorize('api_keys', 'update'),
  apiKeyController.regenerate
);

/**
 * DELETE /api/v1/api-keys/:id
 * Delete API key permanently
 */
router.delete('/:id',
  validateParams,
  authorize('api_keys', 'delete'),
  apiKeyController.delete
);

module.exports = router;

========== FILE: ./src/routes/auth.routes.js ==========
/**
 * Auth Routes - QAssure Platform
 * /api/v1/auth/*
 */
const express = require('express');
const router = express.Router();
const authController = require('../controllers/auth.controller');
const { authenticate } = require('../middleware/auth.middleware');
const {
  RegisterSchema,
  LoginSchema,
  VerifyEmailSchema,
  ResendVerificationSchema,
  ForgotPasswordSchema,
  ResetPasswordSchema,
  ChangePasswordSchema,
  RefreshTokenSchema,
  SessionParamsSchema,
} = require('../validation/auth.schema');
const { validate } = require('../middleware/validationMiddleware');

// Validation middleware helpers
const validateRegister = validate(RegisterSchema);
const validateLogin = validate(LoginSchema);
const validateVerifyEmail = validate(VerifyEmailSchema);
const validateResendVerification = validate(ResendVerificationSchema);
const validateForgotPassword = validate(ForgotPasswordSchema);
const validateResetPassword = validate(ResetPasswordSchema);
const validateChangePassword = validate(ChangePasswordSchema);
const validateRefreshToken = validate(RefreshTokenSchema);
const validateSessionParams = validate(SessionParamsSchema, 'params');

// ==================== Public Routes ====================
// Registration & Verification
router.post('/register', validateRegister, authController.register);
router.post('/verify-email', validateVerifyEmail, authController.verifyEmail);
router.post('/resend-verification', validateResendVerification, authController.resendVerification);

// Login
router.post('/login', validateLogin, authController.login);
router.post('/refresh', validateRefreshToken, authController.refresh);

// Password Reset
router.post('/forgot-password', validateForgotPassword, authController.forgotPassword);
router.post('/reset-password', validateResetPassword, authController.resetPassword);

// ==================== Protected Routes ====================
// Session Management
router.post('/logout', authenticate, authController.logout);
router.post('/logout-all', authenticate, authController.logoutAll);
router.get('/me', authenticate, authController.me);
router.get('/sessions', authenticate, authController.sessions);
router.delete('/sessions/:sessionId', authenticate, validateSessionParams, authController.revokeSession);
router.post('/validate', authenticate, authController.validate);

// Password Change (authenticated)
router.post('/change-password', authenticate, validateChangePassword, authController.changePassword);

module.exports = router;

// Get revenue summary
router.get('/revenue', authorize('billing', 'read'), billingController.getRevenueSummary);

/**
 * Electronic Signature Routes
 * FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Compliant Electronic Signatures
 */

const express = require('express');
const router = express.Router();
const controller = require('../controllers/electronic-signature.controller');
const { authenticate, authorize } = require('../middleware/auth.middleware');
const {
  IdParamsSchema,
  WorkflowIdParamsSchema,
  ResourceParamsSchema,
  CreateSignatureSchema,
  VerifySignatureSchema,
  SetPinSchema,
  InvalidateSignatureSchema,
  GetUserHistoryQuerySchema,
  GetStatisticsQuerySchema
} = require('../validation/electronic-signature.schema');
const { validate } = require('../middleware/validationMiddleware');

// Validation middleware helpers
const validateParams = validate(IdParamsSchema, 'params');
const validateWorkflowIdParams = validate(WorkflowIdParamsSchema, 'params');
const validateResourceParams = validate(ResourceParamsSchema, 'params');
const validateCreateSignature = validate(CreateSignatureSchema);
const validateVerifySignature = validate(VerifySignatureSchema);
const validateSetPin = validate(SetPinSchema);
const validateInvalidate = validate(InvalidateSignatureSchema);
const validateHistoryQuery = validate(GetUserHistoryQuerySchema, 'query');
const validateStatisticsQuery = validate(GetStatisticsQuerySchema, 'query');

// All routes require authentication
router.use(authenticate);

// ============================================================================
// SIGNATURE OPERATIONS
// ============================================================================

/**
 * @route   POST /api/v1/electronic-signatures/sign
 * @desc    Create an electronic signature
 * @access  Authenticated users
 */
router.post('/sign', validateCreateSignature, controller.sign);

/**
 * @route   POST /api/v1/electronic-signatures/verify
 * @desc    Verify a signature is valid
 * @access  Authenticated users
 */
router.post('/verify', validateVerifySignature, controller.verify);

/**
 * @route   POST /api/v1/electronic-signatures/pin
 * @desc    Set or update signature PIN
 * @access  Authenticated users (own PIN only)
 */
router.post('/pin', validateSetPin, controller.setPin);

// ============================================================================
// SIGNATURE QUERIES
// ============================================================================

/**
 * @route   GET /api/v1/electronic-signatures/actions
 * @desc    Get available signature actions
 * @access  Authenticated users
 */
router.get('/actions', controller.getActions);

/**
 * @route   GET /api/v1/electronic-signatures/statistics
 * @desc    Get signature statistics for compliance reporting
 * @access  Requires audit:read permission
 */
router.get('/statistics', validateStatisticsQuery, authorize('audit:read'), controller.getStatistics);

/**
 * @route   GET /api/v1/electronic-signatures/history
 * @desc    Get current user's signature history
 * @access  Authenticated users (own history)
 */
router.get('/history', validateHistoryQuery, controller.getUserHistory);

/**
 * @route   GET /api/v1/electronic-signatures/resource/:resourceType/:resourceId
 * @desc    Get signatures for a specific resource
 * @access  Authenticated users
 */
router.get('/resource/:resourceType/:resourceId', validateResourceParams, controller.getResourceSignatures);

/**
 * @route   GET /api/v1/electronic-signatures/workflow/:workflowId/status
 * @desc    Check workflow completion status
 * @access  Authenticated users
 */
router.get('/workflow/:workflowId/status', validateWorkflowIdParams, controller.getWorkflowStatus);

/**
 * @route   GET /api/v1/electronic-signatures/:id
 * @desc    Get a specific signature
 * @access  Authenticated users
 */
router.get('/:id', validateParams, controller.getSignature);

// ============================================================================
// ADMIN OPERATIONS
// ============================================================================

/**
 * @route   POST /api/v1/electronic-signatures/:id/invalidate
 * @desc    Invalidate a signature (requires super_admin)
 * @access  super_admin only
 */
router.post('/:id/invalidate', validateParams, validateInvalidate, authorize('*:*'), controller.invalidate);

module.exports = router;

========== FILE: ./src/routes/file-attachment.routes.js ==========
/**
 * File Attachment Routes
 */

const express = require('express');
const router = express.Router();
const multer = require('multer');
const path = require('path');
const controller = require('../controllers/file-attachment.controller');
const { authenticate, authorize } = require('../middleware/auth.middleware');

// Multer configuration
const storage = multer.memoryStorage();

const fileFilter = (req, file, cb) => {
  // Block dangerous extensions
  const blockedExtensions = ['.exe', '.bat', '.cmd', '.sh', '.ps1', '.msi', '.dll'];
  const ext = path.extname(file.originalname).toLowerCase();
  
  if (blockedExtensions.includes(ext)) {
    return cb(new Error(`File type ${ext} is not allowed`), false);
  }
  cb(null, true);
};

const upload = multer({
  storage,
  fileFilter,
  limits: {
    fileSize: 100 * 1024 * 1024 // 100 MB max
  }
});

// Error handler for multer
const handleMulterError = (err, req, res, next) => {
  if (err instanceof multer.MulterError) {
    if (err.code === 'LIMIT_FILE_SIZE') {
      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'FILE_TOO_LARGE', message: 'File size exceeds 100MB limit' } });
    }
    return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'UPLOAD_ERROR', message: err.message } });
  }
  if (err) {
    return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'UPLOAD_ERROR', message: err.message } });
  }
  next();
};

// ============================================================================
// PUBLIC ROUTES (Shared file access)
// ============================================================================

router.get('/shared/:token', controller.accessSharedFile);

// ============================================================================
// AUTHENTICATED ROUTES
// ============================================================================

router.use(authenticate);

// Simple upload - returns browser-accessible URL (no DB storage)
// router.post('/upload/simple', authorize('files:write'), upload.single('file'), handleMulterError, controller.simpleUpload);
router.post('/upload/simple', upload.single('file'), handleMulterError, controller.simpleUpload);

// Upload
router.post('/upload', authorize('files:write'), upload.single('file'), handleMulterError, controller.upload);
router.post('/upload/multiple', authorize('files:write'), upload.array('files', 10), handleMulterError, controller.uploadMultiple);

// List & Retrieve
router.get('/', authorize('files:read'), controller.list);
router.get('/stats', authorize('files:read'), controller.getStorageStats);
router.get('/quota', authorize('files:read'), controller.getQuota);
router.put('/quota', authorize('files:admin'), controller.updateQuota);

router.get('/:id', authorize('files:read'), controller.getById);
router.get('/:id/download', authorize('files:read'), controller.download);
router.get('/:id/preview', authorize('files:read'), controller.preview);

// By Entity
router.get('/entity/:entity_type/:entity_id', authorize('files:read'), controller.getByEntity);

// Delete
router.delete('/:id', authorize('files:write'), controller.delete);

// Sharing
router.post('/:id/share', authorize('files:write'), controller.createShare);
router.delete('/shares/:shareId', authorize('files:write'), controller.revokeShare);

module.exports = router;

// Basic health check (no auth)
router.get('/health', (req, res) => {
  res.json({
    success: true,
    status: 'healthy',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    version: process.env.npm_package_version || '1.0.0'
  });
});

// Detailed health check (no auth)
router.get('/health/detailed', async (req, res) => {
  const health = {
    success: true,
    status: 'healthy',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    version: process.env.npm_package_version || '1.0.0',
    uptime: process.uptime(),
    services: {}
  };

  // Check PostgreSQL
  try {
    const start = Date.now();
    await database.query('SELECT 1');
    health.services.postgres = {
      status: 'healthy',
      latency: `${Date.now() - start}ms`
    };
  } catch (err) {
    health.services.postgres = {
      status: 'unhealthy',
      error: err.message
    };
    health.status = 'degraded';
  }

  // Check Redis
  try {
    const redisHealth = await redisService.healthCheck();
    health.services.redis = redisHealth;
    if (redisHealth.status !== 'healthy') {
      health.status = 'degraded';
    }
  } catch (err) {
    health.services.redis = {
      status: 'unhealthy',
      error: err.message
    };
    health.status = 'degraded';
  }

  // Memory usage
  const memUsage = process.memoryUsage();
  health.memory = {
    heapUsed: `${Math.round(memUsage.heapUsed / 1024 / 1024)}MB`,
    heapTotal: `${Math.round(memUsage.heapTotal / 1024 / 1024)}MB`,
    rss: `${Math.round(memUsage.rss / 1024 / 1024)}MB`
  };

  const statusCode = health.status === 'healthy' ? 200 : 503;
  res.status(statusCode).json(health);
});

// Prometheus metrics endpoint (no auth - typically secured at infrastructure level)
router.get('/metrics', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const prometheusService = getPrometheusService();
    const metrics = await prometheusService.getMetrics();
    res.set('Content-Type', prometheusService.getContentType());
    res.send(metrics);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Metrics] Error getting metrics:', err);
    res.status(500).send('Error collecting metrics');
  }
});

/**
 * Knowledge Routes - QAssure Platform
 * Routes for RAG/Knowledge Base endpoints
 */
const express = require('express');
const router = express.Router();
const multer = require('multer');
const knowledgeController = require('../controllers/knowledge.controller');
const { authenticate, authorize } = require('../middleware/auth.middleware');

// Configure multer for file uploads
const upload = multer({
  storage: multer.memoryStorage(),
  limits: {
    fileSize: 50 * 1024 * 1024, // 50MB limit
  },
  fileFilter: (req, file, cb) => {
    const allowedTypes = [
      'application/pdf',
      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
      'application/msword',
      'text/plain',
      'text/markdown',
      'application/json'
    ];
    
    if (allowedTypes.includes(file.mimetype)) {
      cb(null, true);
    } else {
      cb(new Error(`Unsupported file type: ${file.mimetype}`), false);
    }
  }
});

// All routes require authentication
router.use(authenticate);

// ==================== Collections ====================

// Create collection
router.post('/collections',
  authorize('ai:create'),
  knowledgeController.createCollection
);

// List collections
router.get('/collections',
  authorize('ai:read'),
  knowledgeController.listCollections
);

// Get collection by ID
router.get('/collections/:id',
  authorize('ai:read'),
  knowledgeController.getCollection
);

  authorize('ai:update'),
  knowledgeController.updateCollection

// Delete collection

// List documents in collection

// ==================== Search ====================

========== FILE: ./src/routes/security.routes.js ==========
/**
 * Security Routes
 * Password policies, access reviews, and security settings
 * FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Compliance
 */

const express = require('express');
const router = express.Router();
const controller = require('../controllers/security.controller');
const { authenticate, authorize } = require('../middleware/auth.middleware');

// All routes require authentication
router.use(authenticate);

// ============================================================================
// PASSWORD POLICY ROUTES
// ============================================================================

/**
 * @route   GET /api/v1/security/password-policy
 * @desc    Get password policy for current tenant
 * @access  Authenticated users
 */
router.get('/password-policy', controller.getPasswordPolicy);

/**
 * @route   PUT /api/v1/security/password-policy
 * @desc    Update password policy
 * @access  tenant_admin or super_admin
 */
router.put('/password-policy', authorize('security:write'), controller.updatePasswordPolicy);

/**
 * @route   GET /api/v1/security/password-policy/requirements
 * @desc    Get password requirements for UI display
 * @access  Authenticated users
 */
router.get('/password-policy/requirements', controller.getPasswordRequirements);

/**
 * @route   POST /api/v1/security/password-policy/validate
 * @desc    Validate a password against policy
 * @access  Authenticated users
 */
router.post('/password-policy/validate', controller.validatePassword);

/**
 * @route   GET /api/v1/security/password-expiry
 * @desc    Check password expiry status for current user
 * @access  Authenticated users
 */
router.get('/password-expiry', controller.checkPasswordExpiry);

// ============================================================================
// ACCESS REVIEW ROUTES
// ============================================================================

/**
 * @route   GET /api/v1/security/access-reviews/compliance-report
 * @desc    Get compliance report for access reviews
 * @access  Requires audit:read permission
 * @note    This route must come before /:id to avoid conflict
 */
router.get('/access-reviews/compliance-report', authorize('audit:read'), controller.getAccessReviewReport);

/**
 * @route   GET /api/v1/security/decision-types
 * @desc    Get available access review decision types
 * @access  Authenticated users
 */
router.get('/decision-types', controller.getDecisionTypes);

/**
 * @route   GET /api/v1/security/review-statuses
 * @desc    Get access review status types
 * @access  Authenticated users
 */
router.get('/review-statuses', controller.getReviewStatuses);

/**
 * @route   POST /api/v1/security/access-reviews
 * @desc    Create a new access review campaign
 * @access  tenant_admin or super_admin
 */
router.post('/access-reviews', authorize('security:write'), controller.createAccessReview);

/**
 * @route   GET /api/v1/security/access-reviews
 * @desc    List access reviews
 * @access  Requires security:read permission
 */
router.get('/access-reviews', authorize('security:read'), controller.listAccessReviews);

/**
 * @route   GET /api/v1/security/access-reviews/:id
 * @desc    Get access review details
 * @access  Requires security:read permission
 */
router.get('/access-reviews/:id', authorize('security:read'), controller.getAccessReview);

/**
 * @route   GET /api/v1/security/access-reviews/:id/items
 * @desc    Get users to review in an access review
 * @access  Requires security:read permission
 */
router.get('/access-reviews/:id/items', authorize('security:read'), controller.getAccessReviewItems);

/**
 * @route   POST /api/v1/security/access-reviews/:id/start
 * @desc    Start an access review
 * @access  Requires security:write permission
 */
router.post('/access-reviews/:id/start', authorize('security:write'), controller.startAccessReview);

/**
 * @route   POST /api/v1/security/access-reviews/:id/populate-items
 * @desc    Populate review items for an existing review
 * @access  Requires security:write permission
 */
router.post('/access-reviews/:id/populate-items', authorize('security:write'), controller.populateReviewItems);

/**
 * @route   POST /api/v1/security/access-reviews/:id/items/:itemId/decide
 * @desc    Make a decision on a user's access
 * @access  Requires security:write permission
 */
router.post('/access-reviews/:id/items/:itemId/decide', authorize('security:write'), controller.makeAccessDecision);

/**
 * @route   POST /api/v1/security/access-reviews/:id/bulk-certify
 * @desc    Certify all pending users at once
 * @access  Requires security:write permission
 */
router.post('/access-reviews/:id/bulk-certify', authorize('security:write'), controller.bulkCertify);

/**
 * @route   POST /api/v1/security/access-reviews/:id/execute
 * @desc    Execute review decisions (actually revoke/modify access)
 * @access  super_admin only

  IdParamsSchema,

  StartWorkflowSchema,
  TransitionWorkflowSchema,
  CancelWorkflowSchema,
  DelegateTaskSchema
} = require('../validation/workflow.schema');

const crypto = require('crypto');

// Generate password hash (password: Admin@123)
async function getPasswordHash() {
  return await bcrypt.hash('Admin@123', 12);
}

// Hash API key using SHA256 (same as ApiKeyService)
function hashApiKey(key) {
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(key).digest('hex');
}

// Cleanup SQL to drop seed data (in reverse order to respect foreign keys)
function getCleanupSQL() {
  return `
-- ============================================================================
-- Cleanup Seed Data for Module SSO Launch Testing
-- ============================================================================

-- Delete in reverse order to respect foreign key constraints

-- 1. Delete user roles (module assignments)
DELETE FROM user_roles WHERE id IN (
    'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
    'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002',
    'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003',
    'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004',
    'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005'
);

-- 2. Delete user tenants
DELETE FROM user_tenants WHERE id IN (
    'e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
    'e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002',
    'e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'
);

-- 3. Delete tenant module access
DELETE FROM tenant_module_access WHERE id IN (
    'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000011',
    'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000012'
);

-- 4. Delete API keys
DELETE FROM api_keys WHERE id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010';

-- 5. Delete modules
DELETE FROM modules WHERE module_id IN ('coc', 'aice');

-- 6. Delete users
DELETE FROM users WHERE email IN (
    'superadmin@ltts.com',
    'admin@pharmacorp.com',
    'sarah@pharmacorp.com',
    'bob@pharmacorp.com'
);

-- 7. Delete tenants
DELETE FROM tenants WHERE slug IN ('pharma-corp', 'biotech-inc');

-- 8. Delete roles (only if they're not used elsewhere)
-- Note: We use ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING in seed, so these might be system roles
-- Only delete if they were created by this seed
DELETE FROM roles WHERE code IN ('super_admin', 'tenant_admin', 'quality_analyst')
    AND id IN (
        'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
        'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002',
        'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur WHERE ur.role_id = roles.id
    );

-- ============================================================================
-- Cleanup Summary
-- ============================================================================
DO $$
BEGIN
    RAISE NOTICE '✅ Seed data cleanup completed!';
END $$;
`;
}

async function cleanupSeedData() {
  console.log('🧹 Cleaning up existing seed data...\n');

  try {
    const cleanupSQL = getCleanupSQL();
    await database.query(cleanupSQL);
    console.log('✅ Seed data cleanup completed successfully\n');
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Cleanup failed:', error.message);
    console.error(error);
    throw error;
  }
}

async function seedModuleSSO(shouldCleanup = false) {
  console.log('🌱 Starting Module SSO Launch seed data...\n');

  try {
    // Test connection
    await database.testConnection();

    // Cleanup existing seed data if requested
    if (shouldCleanup) {
      await cleanupSeedData();
    }

    // Generate password hash
    const passwordHash = await getPasswordHash();
    console.log('✅ Password hash generated');

    // Generate API key hash
    const apiKey = 'qas_testkey1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678';
    const apiKeyHash = hashApiKey(apiKey);
    console.log('✅ API key hash generated');
    console.log(`   API Key: ${apiKey}`);
    console.log(`   Key Hash: ${apiKeyHash}`);

    // Get SQL with password hash and API key hash injected
    const seedSQL = getSeedSQL(passwordHash, apiKeyHash);

    // Execute SQL seed
    await database.query(seedSQL);
    console.log('✅ SQL statements executed successfully');
    console.log('✅ Seed data created successfully!\n');
    console.log('📋 Summary:');
    console.log('   Users: superadmin@ltts.com, admin@pharmacorp.com, sarah@pharmacorp.com, bob@pharmacorp.com');
    console.log('   Tenants: Pharma Corp, BioTech Inc');
    console.log('   Modules: COC, AiCE (enabled for Pharma Corp)\n');
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Seed failed:', error.message);
    console.error(error);
    process.exit(1);
  } finally {
    await database.close();
    process.exit(0);
  }
}

// Check command line arguments
const shouldCleanup = process.argv.includes('--cleanup') || process.argv.includes('--drop');

// Run the seed
seedModuleSSO(shouldCleanup);
